name: parotid gland myoepithelium
definition: Epithelium that consists of stellate-shaped contractile cells with long dendritic processes that surround the secretory acini and intercalated ducts of the parotid gland, usually found in the glandular epithelium as a thin layer above the basement membrane but generally beneath the luminal cells; they display features of both smooth muscle and epithelium, such as numerous microfilaments with focal densities in the cytoplasmic processes, and desmosomes which attach them to the epithelial cells; their functions include contraction when the gland is stimulated to secrete, compressing or reinforcing the underlying parenchymal cells, thus aiding in the expulsion of saliva and preventing damage to the other cells.

name: lateral nasal gland
definition: Any of the lateral nasal glands (the largest nasal secretory glands in rodents) which surround the maxillary sinus located in the lateral wall adjacent to each nasal passage and are characterized by cytologic features similar to those described for the major serous salivary glands; secretory contents of the LNG drain into the nasal vestibule; the LNG is a major site for the synthesis and secretion of odorant-binding proteins that serve as odorant carriers in nasal mucus; it also, synthesizes large amounts of immunoglobulin A, which is important for immune defense of the upper respiratory tract, and testosterone and salivary androgen-binding proteins, which are likely important in olfaction and reproductive behavior.

name: parotid gland interlobular duct
definition: Any of the excretory ducts of the parotid gland which are found in the connective tissue septa i.e. between lobules.

name: deep intraparotid lymph node

name: non-transverse process-bearing vertebra

name: extensor caudae medialis muscle

The tendons course proximomedially to distolaterally and give rise to fleshy fibers that insert onto the lateral aspect of the neural arches of each of the vertebrae it crosses. The m. extensor caudae medialis is a continuation of m. semispinalis dorsi into the tail.

name: iliocaudalis muscle
definition: A muscle that attaches to the iliac crest and to a caudal vertebra.

name: hemipenis transversus muscle
definition: A muscle that overlies the hemipenis.

name: transversus perinei muscle
definition: A muscle in females that overlies the soft tissue related to the cloaca, where the hemipenes are located in males.

name: retractor penis magnus muscle
definition: A tube-like muscle attaches to the distal tip of the hemipenis and inserts onto the transverse processes of a caudal vertebra.

name: transverse process of caudal vertebra
definition: A transverse process that is part of a caudal vertebra.

sac of scrotum

name: raphe of perineum

name: temporalis fascia
definition: The temporal fascia covers the Temporalis muscle. It is a strong, fibrous investment, covered, laterally, by the Auricularis anterior and superior, by the galea aponeurotica, and by part of the Orbicularis oculi. The superficial temporal vessels and the auriculotemporal nerve cross it from below upward. Above, it is a single layer, attached to the entire extent of the superior temporal line; but below, where it is fixed to the zygomatic arch, it consists of two layers, one of which is inserted into the lateral, and the other into the medial border of the arch. A small quantity of fat, the orbital branch of the superficial temporal artery, and a filament from the zygomatic branch of the maxillary nerve, are contained between these two layers. It affords attachment by its deep surface to the superficial fibers of the Temporalis.

name: plantar nerve

name: lateral plantar nerve

name: medial plantar nerve

name: superior cerebral vein
definition: The Superior Cerebral Veins, eight to twelve in number, drain the superior, lateral, and medial surfaces of the hemispheres, and are mainly lodged in the sulci between the gyri, but some run across the gyri. They open into the superior sagittal sinus; the anterior veins runs nearly at right angles to the sinus; the posterior and larger veins are directed obliquely forward and open into the sinus in a direction more or less opposed to the current of the blood contained within it.

name: internal cerebral vein
definition: The internal cerebral veins (veins of Galen; deep cerebral veins) drain the deep parts of the hemisphere and are two in number; each is formed near the interventricular foramen by the union of the terminal and choroid veins. They run backward parallel with one another, between the layers of the tela chorioidea of the third ventricle, and beneath the splenium of the corpus callosum, where they unite to form a short trunk, the great cerebral vein; just before their union each receives the corresponding basal vein.

name: suprapreopercle

name: extension
definition: The posterior elongated region of the yolk cell that forms during the segmentation period. Kimmel et al, 1995.

name: lateral line ganglion

definition: Neuromast that is part of the mandibular lateral line. Kimmel et al, 1995. (Also see Anatomical Atlas entry for lateral line by T. Whitfield.).

name: antorbital
definition: Dermal bone positioned as the first bone of the infraorbital series. The antorbital articulates with the lacrimal or infraorbital 1 anteroventrally and the supraorbital posterodorsally. The antorbital is a paired bone.

name: immature otolith
definition: Brightly refractile stone-like organ within the otic vesicle and positioned over a sensory macula; two form in each vesicle during the late segmentation period. Kimmel et al, 1995. (Also see Anatomical Atlas entry for otolith by T. Whitfield.).

name: somite 20

name: somite 30

name: opercle
definition: Dermal bone that forms the postero-dorsal part of the opercular series. The opercle articulates with the hyomandibula antero-dorsally and with the subopercle ventrally. The opercle is a paired bone.

name: adipose fin

name: mandibular lateral line

A sensory system on the surface of the fish, consisting of small sensory patches (neuromasts) distributed in discrete lines over the body surface. The lateral line system is stimulated by local water displacements and vibrations, and detects propulsion of the fish through the water, as well as facilitating shoaling, prey capture, and predator and obstacle avoidance. (See Anatomical Atlas entry for lateral line by T. Whitfield.).

name: preopercle
definition: Dermal bone that is part of the opercular series and bears the preopercular sensory canal. The preopercle is a paired bone and typically L-shaped, with the horizontal limb overlying the interopercle and the vertical limb overlying the opercle.

name: anal fin proximal radial bone

definition: The portion of the YSL that is outside of the blastoderm margin during epiboly. Kimmel et al, 1995.

name: gill raker

name: postcleithrum

name: retroarticular

name: opercular lateral line

name: anterior lateral line nerve

definition: Bone that is an element associated with a Weberian vertebra.

name: otic lateral line
definition: One of eight distinct lateral lines in the 4-day larva positioned anterior to the ear. A sensory system on the surface of the fish, consisting of small sensory patches (neuromasts) distributed in discrete lines over the body surface. The lateral line system is stimulated by local water displacements and vibrations, and detects propulsion of the fish through the water, as well as facilitating shoaling, prey capture, and predator and obstacle avoidance. (See Anatomical Atlas entry for lateral line by T. Whitfield.).

name: intercalar
definition: Small membrane bone homologous with a cartilage bone in more basal fishes (Patterson, 1977). Situated between the exoccipital and the pterotic at point of attachment of short ligament that originates on the ventral arm of the posttemporal.

name: branchiostegal ray
definition: Dermal bone that is a flattened element that supports the branchiostegal membrane. Branchiostegal rays are generally present in a series articulating ventrally or ventro-medially with the anterior and posterior ceratobranchials whereas the most posterior ray articulates with the subopercle. The branchiostegal ray is paired.

name: caudal octavolateralis nucleus
definition: Hindbrain nucleus which is part of the medulla oblongata and is a mechanoreceptive area along with the medial octavolateralis nucleus. It is smaller than the medial octavolateralis nucleus and is located lateral to the facial and vagal lobes of the medulla oblongata. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.

name: ceratobranchial bone
definition: Endochondral bone that is bilaterally paired and forms part of the ventral branchial arches.

name: infraorbital 5
definition: Infraorbital that is the fifth bone of the infraorbital series.

name: dilatator operculi
definition: Mandibular muscle that inserts along the dorsolateral faces of the opercles. Responsible for opercular abduction.

name: epineural
definition: Some or all epineural bones ossify free from the neural arches in most teleosts. In some lower teleosts, e.g., Leptolepis, Hiodon, elopiforms and albuliforms, ossification proceeds from the attachment point of the ligament to the arch, and the epineural is a process of the neural arch. In many lower teleosts epineurals are forked proximally.

name: pelvic fin radial bone
definition: Pelvic fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: intercalarium
definition: Neural arch and Weberian ossicle that has been modified in shape relative to other neural arches. Intercalarium includes three parts: an anterolateral process (the manubrium) which is embedded in the interossicular ligament and the ascending and articulating processes.

name: intermuscular bone
definition: Axial bone which is a segmental ossification that forms in the myoseptum.

name: pharyngobranchial bone
definition: Endochondral bone of the branchial arches located medial to the epibranchials.

name: pectoral fin actinotrichium
definition: Actinotrichium that is part of the pectoral fin.

name: posttemporal
definition: Dermal bone of the secondary pectoral girdle that attaches the girdle to the skull. Its dorsal process attaches to the epiotic or epioccipital, the ventral process to the intercalar and the body articulates with the supracleithrum. The postotic sensory canal or lateral line runs within or lateral to bone.

name: nucleus lateralis valvulae
definition: Hindbrain nucleus in the tegmental region of rhombomere 1. The cells of the nucleus are granular and lie at the ventral border of the cerebellum and brain stem.

name: preural 1 vertebra
definition: Last caudal vertebra identified as the point at which the caudal vessels bifurcate, leaving the protection of the haemal arches of the caudal vertebrae and running laterally to the hypurals. This vertebra bears, commonly, a well-developed haemal arch and its spine (parhypural).

name: posterior macula
definition: Macula that is located in the developing posterior inner ear, and gives rise to the macula neglecta and the macula saccule. (See Anatomical Atlas entry for sensory patches of the ear by T. Whitfield.).

name: pterotic
definition: Endochondral bone that articulates with the autosphenotic anteriorly, the parietal dorsomedially, the prootic ventrally (and the intercalar occasionally), and the epiotic and exoccipital posteriorly. The pterotic encloses the horizontal semicircular canal of the inner ear. The lower edge of the pterotic contributes to the hyomandibular facet. The pterotic is paired.

name: kinethmoid cartilage
definition: Cranial cartilage which is a small median cartilage located between the premaxillae and anterodorsal to the ethmoid.

name: preural 2 vertebra
definition: Vertebra anterior to preural centrum 1; sometimes termed the 'antepenultimate' vertebra. Mabee and Bird, 2001.

name: sphenotic
definition: Endochondral bone that sutures with the pterosphenoid anteriorly, the prootic ventrally, the frontal bone dorso-medially, and the pterotic dorso-posteriorly. Occasionally the sphenotic sutures with the parietal bone. The sphenotic separates the orbital from the otic region. The sphenotic bears a large antero-lateral or lateral or ventro-lateral process that borders the postero-dorsal margin of the orbit. The sphenotic is a paired bone.

name: supracleithrum
definition: Dermal bone that articulates dorsally with the posttemporal and ventrally with the cleithrum. Supracleithrum is part of the secondary pectoral girdle and commonly, carries part of the lateral line canal.

name: pelvic fin actinotrichium
definition: Actinotrichium that is part of the pelvic fin.

name: uroneural
definition: Neural arch that extends along the dorso-lateral surface of the last preural centra and/or ural centra and the notochord (Arratia & Schultze, 1992). An uroneural develops as a modification of the neural arch of an ural centrum (Patterson, 1968). The series of uroneurals may include from 7 to 1 elements that are numbered from rostrad to caudad. An uroneural is a paired membrane bone.

name: valvula cerebelli
definition: Brain structure which is caudally attached to the rostral medulla oblongata and extends into the tectal ventricle. The valvula cerebelli consists of a granular and a molecular layer along with aggregations of large Purkinje and eurydendroid cells and is uniquely present in ray-finned fishes. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.

name: vertical myoseptum
definition: Connective tissue partitions developing between the myotomes. Kimmel et al, 1995.

name: autopalatine
definition: Endochondral bone that is part of the antero-lateral region of the palate. Commonly, it articulates with the maxilla anterolaterally and with the ethmoidal region medially. It may also articulate with the dermopalatine ventro-laterally and with the entopterygoid posteriorly. The autopalatine is paired.

name: barbel
definition: Surface structure which is a tactile structure found in the branchial region. Barbels are covered with epidermis rich in taste buds, and are innervated by branches of the cranial nerves.

name: basipterygium bone
definition: Basipterygium element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: posterior ceratohyal
definition: Replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates anteriorly with the anterior ceratohyal.

name: caudal motor nucleus of abducens
definition: Caudal part of the abducens nucleus that mediates motor function.

name: caudal zone of median tuberal portion of hypothalamus
claustrum cartilage
definition: Postcranial axial cartilage and Weberian ossicle that is located dorsal to the scaphium. The claustrum cartilage is bilaterally paired.

name: commissura rostral, pars dorsalis
definition: Part of the anterior commissure which is located immediately ventral to the supracommissural nucleus of area ventralis telencephali.

name: commissure of the secondary gustatory nuclei
anal fin distal radial bone
definition: Anal fin distal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: dorsal fin musculature
definition: Musculature that is part of the dorsal fin.

name: rostral motor nucleus of abducens
definition: Rostral part of the abducens nucleus that mediates motor function.

name: entopterygoid
definition: Dermal bone that forms the ventro-medial part of the palate and the antero-ventral and ventral wall of the orbit. The entopterygoid is a paired bone.

name: epibranchial bone
definition: Dorsal branchial arch bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial cartilage or bone and medially with pharyngobranchial cartilage or bone.

name: epural
definition: A free, modified neural spine of a preural or a ural vertebra that is placed between the last developed neural spine of a preural centrum and the dorsal axis (= anterior margin of first uroneural) of the caudal skeleton . An epural commonly supports one or more dorsal procurrent rays. An epural is an unpaired median perichondrally ossified bone.

name: extrascapula
definition: Dermal canal-bearing bone placed at the dorso-posterior region of the skull roof, lying on the posterior region of the pterotic and parietals, or the pterotic and epioccipital, or on the pterotic, epioccipital and occipital bones.

name: hypobranchial artery
definition: A pair of HA are connect one to each AA1. They run rostromedially until at the extreme rostro-ventral midline the two vessels merge and then run straight caudally along the ventral midline until they reach the cranial end of the ventral aorta (VA). There, the single HA passes just dorsal to the rostral end of the VA and then immediately splits again into a pair of HA. The paired HA continue caudally just to either side of the ventral midline. The HA provide blood supply to the ventral branchial region and the heart.sogai et al. 2001.

name: interopercle
definition: Dermal bone that is part of the opercular series. It is located ventro-medially to the preopercle and anterior to the subopercle. It is joined to the posterior part of the lower jaw (retroarticular) by a ligament. The interopercle is paired.

name: supraorbital bone
definition: Dermal bone that is part of the dorsal or upper border or antero-dorsal border of the orbit. The supraorbital bone may contact the orbital margin of the frontal bone medially, the antorbital antero-ventrally and the dermosphenotic posteriorly. The supraorbital bone does not carry sensory canals. The supraorbital bone is paired.

name: symplectic
definition: Replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with the hyomandibula and the quadrate.

name: ceratobranchial 5 tooth
definition: Tooth that forms on ceratobranchial 5 cartilage or bone.

name: tripus
definition: Endochondral bone, membrane bone, and Weberian ossicle that is an element of third vertebra. Anteriorly it attaches to the interosseus ligament and posteriorly it extends as a transformator process embedded in the tunica externa of the swimbladder.

name: entopterygoid vertical strut
definition: Process that is the dorsally directed, vertical process of the entopterygoid. The strut sometimes articulates with the orbitosphenoid.

name: deep cell layer (gastrulation)
definition: A multilayer of deep cells of fairly uniform thickness that forms during early epiboly (at dome stage; upon conversion of the blastodisc to the blastoderm); during gastrulation the DEL (deep cell layer) gives rise to the epiblast and hypoblast. Kimmel et al, 1995.

name: internal yolk syncytial layer
definition: The portion of the YSL that lies deep to the blastoderm during epiboly. Kimmel et al, 1995.

name: afferent portion of pharyngeal arch artery
definition: A section of a pharyngeal arch artery that delivers blood to the gills.

primordial hindbrain channel

name: lateral dorsal aorta

name: cranial division of the internal carotid artery
synonyms_exact: CrDI|rostral division of the internal carotid artery

name: basidorsal
definition: Basidorsals are bilaterally paired cartilages on the dorsolateral side of the notochord which are replaced by ossified neural arches or dorsal arcocentra. In otophysan fishes, basidorsal 1, bd2, bd3, and bd4 give rise to parts of the Weberian apparatus.

name: presumptive mesencephalic artery
definition: Precursor to mesencephalic artery.

name: ventral fin fold
synonyms_exact: anal fin fold|anal fin-fold|tail fin fold|tail fin-fold|ventral fin|ventral fin-fold

name: intestinal bulb

name: immature macula
definition: An otic sensory epithelium that will develop into the mature macula.
synonyms_exact: immature maculae|immature sensory patch|immature sensory patches

name: urogenital papilla
definition: A protuberance in front of the gential pore and behind the vent. Mature females have a well developed urogenital papillae whilst in mature males it is poorly developed. Brion et al, 2004.

name: organizer inducing center
definition: The dorsal marginal region of the YSL where maternal dorsal determinants localize. Participates in positioning the shield. Ho et al, 1999.

name: noninvoluting endocytic marginal cell cluster
definition: The NEM cell cluster lies in a superficial position of the dorsal blastoderm margin encompassing EVL cells and one or two layers of underlying deep cells. Unlike other marginal blastomeres, cells in this cluster do not participate in involution. Cooper et al, 1996.

name: ventral tooth row
definition: Tooth row that is the ventralmost row of teeth on ceratobranchial 5 bone.

name: mediodorsal tooth row
definition: Tooth row that is the mediodorsal row of teeth on ceratobranchial 5 bone, located between the dorsal tooth row and ventral tooth row.

name: dorsal tooth row
definition: Tooth row that is the dorsalmost row of teeth on ceratobranchial 5 bone.

name: tooth 1V
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the anteriormost tooth in the ventral tooth row.

name: tooth 5V
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the posteriormost tooth in the ventral tooth row.

name: tooth 4V
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is posterior to tooth 3V and anterior to tooth 5V in the ventral tooth row.

name: tooth 2V
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is posterior to tooth 1V and anterior to tooth 3V in the ventral tooth row.

name: tooth 3V
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is posterior to tooth 2V and anterior to tooth 4V in the ventral tooth row.

name: tooth 1MD
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the anteriormost tooth in the mediodorsal tooth row.

name: tooth 2MD
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is posterior to tooth 1MD and anterior to tooth 3MD in the mediodorsal tooth row.

name: tooth 1D
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the anteriormost tooth in the dorsal tooth row.

name: tooth 2D
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the posteriormost tooth in the dorsal tooth row.

name: tooth 4MD
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the posteriormost tooth in the mediodorsal tooth row.

name: tooth 3MD
definition: Ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is posterior to tooth 2MD and anterior to tooth 4MD in the mediodorsal tooth row.

name: posterior lateral line primordium
definition: A migrating group of cells originating from the posterior lateral line placode. The primordium deposits seven to nine neuromasts and interneuromasts between them during its posterior migration to the tail. Gompel et al, 2001.

name: dorsal scute
definition: Scute that is a bony plate that forms in dorsal midline of body margin between the skull and dorsal fin.

name: vertebral element 2
definition: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 1.

name: vertebral element 3
definition: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 2.

name: vertebral element 4
definition: Vertebra that is anteriorly adjacent to vertebra 5.

name: os suspensorium
definition: Endochondral bone and Weberian ossicle that is an element of the fourth vertebra that curves ventrally around the anterior head of the swim bladder.

name: roofing cartilage
definition: Cartilaginous larval structure dorsal to the four anterior-most vertebrae, which forms the connection between neural arches and supraneurals in the Weberian apparatus. Bird and Mabee, 2003.

name: collagenous dermal stroma
definition: A layer of collagen fibrils present in the imature integument in an acellular subepidermal space. At first, the fibrils are all oriented in the same direction, later they form the complex plywood-like structure that is characteristic of the dermal deep region. Le Guellec et al, 2004.

name: Weberian apparatus
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of the anteriormost vertebrae and associated structures that connect the swim bladder to the inner ear.

name: Weberian vertebra
definition: Vertebra that is part of the Weberian apparatus.

name: supraneural 2 bone
definition: Supraneural bone located dorsal to vertebra 2.

name: supraneural 3 bone
definition: Supraneural bone that is located dorsal to vertebrae 3 and 4.

name: corpuscles of Stannius
definition: Islands of eosinic cells found on the lateroventral surface of the kidney. Function is thought to be that of the parathyroid gland in other vertebrates, which are lacking in fishes. These cells secrete hypocalcin (teleocalcin) to regulate calcium metabolism.

name: basibranchial copula
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with more than one pharyngeal arch in the pharyngeal arch 3-7 skeleton.

name: anterior copula
definition: Copula that is ventral, median, and associated with pharyngeal arches 3-5.

name: posterior copula
definition: Copula that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arches 4 and 5 (pharyngeal arches 6-7).

name: basibranchial 1 bone
definition: Basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 1 (pharyngeal arch 3). Typically develops in the anterior copula cartilage.

name: basibranchial 2 bone
definition: Basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 2 (pharyngeal arch 4). Typically develops in the anterior copula cartilage.

name: basibranchial 3 bone
definition: Basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 3 (pharyngeal arch 5). Typically develops in the anterior copula cartilage.

name: basibranchial 4 bone
definition: Basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 4 (pharyngeal arch 6). Develops in posterior copula cartilage or basibranchial 4 cartilage.

name: hypobranchial 1 bone
definition: Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 1 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 1 cartilage.

name: hypobranchial 4 bone
definition: Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 4 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 4 cartilage.

name: hypobranchial 3 bone

name: hypobranchial 2 bone
definition: Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 2 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 2 cartilage.

name: ceratobranchial 1 bone
definition: Ceratobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 1 cartilage or bone.

name: ceratobranchial 5 bone
definition: Ceratobranchial bone that is the most posterior, bilaterally paired ventral pharyngeal arch bone.

name: ceratobranchial 4 bone
definition: Ceratobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

name: ceratobranchial 3 bone
definition: Ceratobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 3 cartilage or bone.

name: ceratobranchial 2 bone
definition: Ceratobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 2 cartilage or bone.

name: epibranchial 1 bone
definition: Epibranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 1 cartilage or bone and medially with pharyngobranchial cartilage or bone.

name: epibranchial 5 cartilage
definition: Epibranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and located at the articulation of epibranchial 4 cartilage or bone and the posterior tip of ceratobranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

name: epibranchial 4 bone
definition: Epibranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 4 cartilage or bone and medially with pharyngobranchial cartilage or bone.

name: epibranchial 2 bone
definition: Epibranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 2 cartilage or bone and medially with pharyngobranchial cartilage or bone.

name: epibranchial 3 bone
definition: Epibranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 3 cartilage or bone and medially with pharyngobranchial cartilage or bone.

name: pharyngobranchial 2 bone
definition: Pharyngobranchial bone, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 1 element.

name: pharyngobranchial 4 cartilage
definition: Most posterior pharyngobranchial cartilage, located medial to the epibranchials.

name: pharyngobranchial 3 bone
definition: Pharyngobranchial bone, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 2 element.

name: neural arch 2
definition: Neural arch that is the second after the neurocranium.

name: medial floor plate
definition: The medial portion of the spinal cord floor plate, located adjacent to the notochord.

name: ovarian follicle stage I
definition: Stage I follicles (less than 140 microns) are primary growth stage. Selman et al, 1993.

name: ovarian follicle stage II
definition: Stage II follicles (140-340 microns) are cortical alveolus stage. Selman et al, 1993.

name: ovarian follicle stage III
definition: Stage III (340-690 microns) are vitellogenesis. Selman et al, 1993.

name: regenerating fin/limb
definition: Fin or limb undergoing the process of regeneration.

name: coronomeckelian
definition: Tendon bone located on the median side of the lower jaw, dorsal to Meckel's cartilage and medial to the angular. The coronomeckelian forms as an ossification of the tendon of the adductor mandibulae muscle. The coronomeckelian is a paired bone.

name: sublingual bone
definition: Endochondral bone that is the median element of the ventral hyoid arch, generally lying between the paired ventral hypohyals.

name: anterior chamber swim bladder
definition: The anterior compartment of the swim bladder is thought to have acoustic resonance properties that play a key role in audition. It is connected to the posterior chamber via the dusctus communicans. Finney et al, 2006.

name: posterior chamber swim bladder
definition: The posterior compartment of the swim bladder plays a key role in buoyancy control. It is connected to the anterior chamber via the dusctus communicans. Finney et al, 2006.

name: branchiostegal ray 1
definition: Branchiostegal ray that is the anterior-most ray in the adult.

name: branchiostegal ray 3
definition: Branchiostegal ray that is the third anterior-most ray in the adult.

name: branchiostegal ray 2
definition: Branchiostegal ray that is the second anterior-most ray in the adult.

name: posterior lateral line ganglion
definition: The posterior lateral line ganglion develops from a cranial ectodermal placode and contains sensory neurons that innervate the posterior lateral line system.

name: anterior lateral line placode
definition: Dorsolateral placode that gives rise to the anterior lateral line.

name: sublingual dorsal and ventral fused
definition: Sublingual that is the single element resulting from the fusion of the sublingual dorsal ossification and sublingual ventral ossification.

name: supradorsal
definition: Supradorsals are small paired nodules of cartilage positioned at the distal ends of neural arches and the proximal end of neural spines (Arratia et al., 2001).

name: nucleus of the tract of the postoptic commissure
definition: The nucleus containing the cell bodies of neurons whose axons form the postoptic commissure.

name: intervening zone
definition: A zone of delayed differentiation at the midbrainhindbrain boundary. The IZ separates midbrain from anterior hindbrain neuronal clusters and has been described in all vertebrates. Geling et al, 2003.

name: basiventral
definition: Basiventrals are bilaterally paired cartilages lateral to the notochord which are replaced by ossified parapophyses or hemal arches.

name: neural complex of Weberian apparatus
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of supraneural 2 bone and supraneural 3 bone and their extensions, and which is part of the Weberian apparatus.

name: hemal spine
definition: Hemal spines are extensions of hemal arches in the ventral skeletogenous septum of the caudal region.

name: epibranchial bone uncinate process
definition: Epibranchials 1-3 in adults are compound elements formed by the fusion of epibranchial cartilages and the so-called uncinate processes. Posteromedially directed uncinate processes develop on the posterior edge of epibranchials 1-3. These appear as separate centers of chondrification (6.2 mm) that later fuse laterally to the posterior edges of the epibranchial cartilages (6.8 mm).

name: epithelial mesenchymal boundary of regenerating fin/limb
definition: An epithelial-mesenchymal boundary that is part of a regenerating fin/limb.

name: regeneration epithelium of fin/limb
definition: An epithelium that is part of a regenerating fin/limb.
synonyms_exact: epidermal cap of fin|wound epidermis of fin|wound epithelium of fin

name: anterior lateral line ganglion
definition: The anteror lateral line ganglia develops from cranial ectodermal placodes and contain sensory neurons that innervate the anterior lateral line system.

name: parapophysis 1
definition: Parapophysis that is the lateral projections from the first centrum in cyprinids, absent in catostomids, and absent in characiphysans (Fink and Fink, 1996).

name: parapophysis 2
definition: Parapophysis that is lateral projection from the second centrum, absent in Siluriformes (Fink and Fink, 1996).

name: neural arch 3
definition: Neural arch 3 is expanded and fused to supraneural 3 as part of a neural complex roofing and protecting the neural canal.

name: neural arch 4
definition: Neural arch 4 is expanded and fused to supraneural 3 as part of the neural complex. A reduced neural spine projects from the posterior margin of the neural complex.

name: parapophysis + rib of vertebra 4
definition: The parapophysis + rib, fused to the centrum, extends laterally then angles anteroventrally. A thin plate, the os suspensorium fuses to its median surface.
synonyms_exact: fourth pleural rib plus parapophysis|fourth rib plus parapophysis|parapophysis/rib

name: post-Weberian supraneural
definition: Posterior to the Weberian apparatus, otophysan supraneurals form as median, unpaired, rod- or platelike elements, as in other actinopterygians.

name: supraethmoid
definition: Dermal bone that first appears as paired ossifications in the membrane (dermis) dorsolateral to the ethmoid cartilage and anterolateral to the lateral ethmoids, later having the appearance of one butterfly-shaped element. Fused to the anterodorsal margin of the mesethmoid. Bordered anteriorly by the kinethmoid and posteriorly by the frontal.

name: preethmoid bone
definition: Small rounded to egg-shaped cartilage bone that sits in an anterolateral depression on the prevomer. Articulates with the autopalatine in all cypriniforms.

name: kinethmoid bone
definition: Sesamoid bone located in the premaxillary-ethmoid ligament, between the mesethmoid and the premaxilla. The kinethmoid is an unpaired median bone.

name: infraorbital 2
definition: Infraorbital that is the second bone of the infraorbital series.

name: infraorbital 3
definition: Infraorbital that is the third bone of the infraorbital series.

name: infraorbital 4
definition: Infraorbital that is the fourth bone of the infraorbital series.

name: epiotic
definition: Endochondral bone that borders that medial edge of the posttemporal fossa. The epiotics are sutured to parietals and supraoccipital dorsally, the exoccipitals ventrally and the pterotics laterally. The epiotic is a paired bone.

name: pelvic fin distal radial bone 2
definition: Pelvic fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: pelvic fin distal radial bone 3
definition: Pelvic fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: pelvic fin distal radial bone 1
definition: Pelvic fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: dorsal fin pterygiophore
definition: A range of seven to nine rod-like internal median skeletal support structures of the dorsal fin, comprised of both bone and cartilage and found between vertebrae 11 and 18.

name: anal fin pterygiophore
definition: A range of twelve to fourteen rod-like internal median skeletal support structures of the anal fin, comprised of both bone and cartilage and found between vertebrae 14 and 21.

name: pneumatic duct
definition: A duct connecting the esophagus to the posterior chamber of the swim bladder. Finney et al, 2006.

name: anterior sclerotic bone
definition: Sclerotic bone that is located anterior to the eye.

name: posterior sclerotic bone
definition: Sclerotic bone that is located posterior to the eye.

name: ductus communicans
definition: The constriction between the anterior and posterior chambers of the swim bladder. There does not appear to be an identifiable sphincter in the ductus, and therefore other musculature may regulate its opening. Finney et al, 2006.

name: apical ectodermal ridge pelvic fin
definition: Apical ectodermal ridge that is part of the pelvic fin.

name: pectoral fin endoskeletal disc
definition: A plate-like chondrogenic condensation within the pectoral fin, which subdivides into individual radials by decomposition of extracellular matrix in the inter-radial mesenchyme (Grandel and Schulte-Merker, 1998).

name: postcranial axial cartilage
definition: Cartilage which is part of the axial skeleton.

name: anterior lateral line system
definition: The anterior lateral line system develops from cranial ectodermal placodes, situated between the eye and the ear, that give rise to both the neuromasts and the anterior lateral line sensory nerves that innervate the neuromasts. The anterior lateral line system consists of small sensory patches (neuromasts) located superficially on the skin or just under the skin in fluid-filled canals on the head of all fishes and most amphibians and are innervated by several lateral line nerves, which project to the hindbrain. The anterior lateral line system is stimulated by local water displacements and vibrations, and detects propulsion of the fish through the water, as well as facilitating shoaling, prey capture, and predator and obstacle avoidance.

name: anterior lateral line
definition: The anterior lateral line consists of small sensory patches (neuromasts) located superficially on the skin or just under the skin in fluid-filled canals on the head of all fishes and most amphibians. The anterior lateral line develops from cranial ectodermal placodes situated between the eye and ear.

name: posterior lateral line system
definition: The posterior lateral line system develops from cranial ectodermal placodes, situated behind the ear, that give rise to both the neuromasts and the posterior lateral line sensory nerves that innervate the neuromasts. The posterior lateral line system consists of small sensory patches (neuromasts) located superficially on the skin or just under the skin in fluid-filled canals on the head of all fishes and most amphibians. The neuromasts are innervated by several lateral line nerves, which project primarily to the hindbrain. The posterior mechanosensory lateral line system is stimulated by local water displacements and vibrations, and detects propulsion of the fish through the water, as well as facilitating shoaling, prey capture, and predator and obstacle avoidance.

name: anterior lateral line neuromast
definition: Neuromast that is part of the anterior lateral line. Kimmel et al, 1995. (Also see Anatomical Atlas entry for lateral line by T. Whitfield.).

name: sublingual dorsal and ventral separate
definition: Anatomical cluster consisting of the paired sublingual dorsal ossification and sublingual ventral ossification.

name: sublingual dorsal ossification
definition: Sublingual that is the dorsal element paired with the sublingual ventral ossification.

name: sublingual ventral ossification
definition: Sublingual that is the ventral element paired with the sublingual dorsal ossification.

name: dorsal anterior lateral line nerve
definition: Nerve fibers originating from the dorsal anterior lateral line ganglion. These rami innervate the otic, supraorbital, and infraorbital neuromasts.

name: ventral anterior lateral line nerve
definition: Nerve fibers originating from the ventral anterior lateral line ganglion. These rami innervate the mandibular and opercular neuromasts.

name: middle lateral line nerve
definition: Nerve fibers originating from the middle lateral line ganglion. These fibers innervate the middle lateral line.

name: middle lateral line ganglion
definition: The middle lateral line ganglion develops from a cranial ectodermal placode and contains sensory neurons that innervate the middle lateral line.

name: epiphyseal bar
definition: Bilaterally paired medial bar of cartilage formed at midorbit through medial chondrification from triangles of cartilage that later form the junction of the taeniae marginales anterior, taeniae marginales posterior and the epiphyseal bar.

name: occipital arch cartilage
definition: Cranial cartilage which is a paired anterodorsal projection of the posterior end of the parachordal cartilage. It lies lateral to the notochord, just anterior to the posterior tip of the otic capsule. The bilaterally paired occipital arch cartilages fuse anterodorsally to the posterior edges of the auditory capsules and meet medially as the tectum synoticum (by 12 dpf).

name: taenia marginalis anterior
definition: Cartilage bar (bilaterally paired) that grows anteroventrally from the epiphyseal bar to join the anterolatera1 edge of the ethmoid plate.

name: trabecula communis
definition: Cartilage formed via medial fusion between bilaterally paired trabecula crani.

name: interhyal cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates dorsally with the hyosymplectic cartilage or the articulation of the hyomandibula and symplectic.

name: taenia marginalis posterior
definition: Cartilage bar (bilaterally paired) that is first visible as an anterior extension of the auditory capsule. It grows anteriorly toward the middle of the orbit where it is connected to its mate on the other side by the epiphyseal bar.

name: ceratobranchial cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that forms the largest skeletal element of the ventral branchial arches.

name: ceratobranchial 2 cartilage
definition: Ceratobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 2 cartilage or bone.

name: ceratobranchial 3 cartilage
definition: Ceratobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 3 cartilage or bone.

name: ceratobranchial 4 cartilage
definition: Ceratobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

name: ceratobranchial 1 cartilage
definition: Ceratobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 1 cartilage or bone.

name: ceratobranchial 5 cartilage
definition: Ceratobranchial cartilage that is the most posterior, bilaterally paired ventral pharyngeal arch cartilage.

name: hypobranchial cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates medially with a median skeletal element and laterally with a ceratobranchial cartilage or bone.

name: hypobranchial 4 cartilage
definition: Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

name: hypobranchial 1 cartilage
definition: Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 1 cartilage or bone.

name: hypobranchial 2 cartilage
definition: Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 2 cartilage or bone.

name: hypobranchial 3 cartilage
definition: Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 3 cartilage or bone.

name: epibranchial cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial cartilage or bone.

name: epibranchial 1 cartilage
definition: Epibranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 1 cartilage or bone.

name: epibranchial 3 cartilage
definition: Epibranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 3 cartilage or bone.

name: epibranchial 2 cartilage
definition: Epibranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 2 cartilage or bone.

name: epibranchial 4 cartilage
definition: Epibranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

name: sublingual dorsal cartilage
definition: Sublingual cartilage that is the dorsal element paired with the sublingual ventral cartilage.

name: pharyngobranchial cartilage
definition: Paired cartilages that project medially from the medial tips of epibranchials.

name: pharyngobranchial 3 cartilage
definition: Pharyngobranchial cartilage, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 2 element.

name: pharyngobranchial 2 cartilage
definition: Pharyngobranchial cartilage, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 1 element.

name: mesocoracoid cartilage
definition: Pectoral fin cartilage that is part of the embryonic primary pectoral girdle from which the mesocoracoid bone will ossify endochondrally.

name: pelvic radial cartilage
definition: Small cartilage that forms at the posterior edge of the basipterygium.

name: basipterygium cartilage
definition: Bilaterally paired small, rodlike cartilages on the ventral surface of the abdomen (present at 7.9 mm). Their posterior tips expand laterally, forming L-shaped cartilages. Medially, a posterior spur of cartilage develops, which will later ossify as the ischiac process (Weitzman 1962).

name: pelvic radial 3 cartilage
definition: Small cartilage that forms at the posterior and medial edge of the basipterygium.

name: pelvic radial 2 cartilage
definition: Small cartilage with a long posterior process and a shorter lateral one that forms at the posterior edge of the basipterygium, between radial cartilages 1 and 2.

name: pelvic radial 1 cartilage
definition: Small cartilage that forms at the posterior and lateral edge of the basipterygium.

name: sublingual cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is the median cartilage of the ventral hyoid arch, generally lying between the paired ventral hypohyals.

name: sublingual ventral cartilage
definition: Sublingual cartilage that is the ventral element paired with the sublingual dorsal cartilage.

name: neural spine 4
definition: Neural spine that is associated with the fourth vertebra.

name: abdominal scute
definition: Scute that is a bony plate that forms in the midline of ventral body margin between pectoral girdle and anal fin. Abdominal scutes may be present both anterior to and posterior to the pelvic girdle and fin.

name: manubrium
synonyms_exact: intercalarium anterior process|intercalarium horizontal process|manubrium incudus

name: premaxilla ascending process
definition: Process of the premaxilla that extends posteriorly and overlays the mesethmoid.

name: anterior dorsomedial process of autopalatine
definition: In cypriniforms the anterior portion of the palatine has a dorsomedial process which abuts against the mesethmoid. Such a process is not present in other ostariophysans or in other primitive teleosts.

name: ural vertebra 2
definition: Ural vertebra that is the second vertebra posterior to preural centrum 1. It may bear a rudimentary neural arch and sometimes a rudimentary spine or the neural arch and spine are completely absent and it may articulate or fuse with hypural 2 (polyural terminology). Ural vertebra 2 is an unpaired median bone.

name: ural centrum 2
definition: A vertebral centrum that is located immediately posterior to ural centrum 1. Ural centrum 2 is an unpaired median bone.

name: preural centrum 1+ ural centrum 1
definition: Urostyle that is the result of fusion of preural centrum 1 with the first ural centrum (of polyural terminology).

name: caudal procurrent ray
definition: Caudal fin lepidotrichium that form part of the anterior dorsal and ventral series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin that may be associated with a neural spine or an epural or an uroneural (dorsal series) and with a haemal spine of a preural vertebra (ventral series). Caudal procurrent rays are shorter than the caudal principal rays. A caudal procurrent ray is an unpaired median bone.
synonyms_exact: caudal precurrent ray|caudal procurrent lepidotrichium|caudal spiny ray|rudimentary ray

name: caudal principal ray
definition: Caudal fin lepidotrichium that is adjacent to a branched ray. Caudal principal rays may be segmented but unbranched and the main element forming the dorsal or ventral leading margin of the caudal fin or a ray that may be only segmented-and-branched and forms part of the middle-posterior region of the fin. A caudal principal ray is an unpaired median bone.
synonyms_exact: caudal fin principal ray|caudal principal lepidotrichium

name: pectoral fin radial bone
definition: Pectoral fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: pectoral fin proximal radial bone
definition: Pectoral fin proximal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: pectoral fin distal radial bone
definition: Pectoral fin distal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: propterygium cartilage
definition: The propterygium is the lateralmost or anteriormost basal cartilage that originates from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc. The bases of the pectoral lepidotrichium 1 plus the propterygium articulates with the scapula.

name: claustrum bone
definition: Endochondral bone, membrane bone, and Weberian ossicle that is located dorsal to the scaphium. The claustrum bone is bilaterally paired.

name: caudal fin upper lobe
definition: Surface structure that is the dorsal portion of the caudal fin.

name: caudal fin lower lobe
definition: Surface structure that is the ventral portion of the caudal fin.

name: maxilla ascending process
definition: Process that is the upper portion of the maxilla that rests on the posterior surface of the lateral portion of the premaxilla.

name: lateral ethmoid palatine process
definition: Lateral bony projection proximal to lateral ethmoid-palatine joint, and located anterior to orbital region and posterior to olfactory region.

name: caudal scute
definition: Scute that is a median bony plate forming anterior to procurrent caudal fin rays.

name: basipterygoid process of parasphenoid
definition: Process that is the paired process of the parasphenoid that articulates with the suspensorium.

name: autopalatine-lateral ethmoid joint
definition: Joint that articulates the autopalatine and lateral ethmoid and bones. Autopalatine-lateral ethmoid joint is paired.

name: pharyngobranchial 2 bone uncinate process
definition: Bony projection that is part of the pharyngobranchial 2 bone.

name: quadrate dorsal process
definition: An endochondral bone that is the dorsally-oriented bony extension of the quadrate, extending from the anterior portion of the bone.

name: quadrate posterodorsal process
definition: Process that is the posterior extension of the quadrate and located dorsal to the quadrate ventral process.

name: sensory canal
definition: Multi-tissue structure that is a fluid-filled canal in the integument and usually dermal bones, and contains one or more neuromast organs.

name: dorsal fin middle radial bone
definition: Dorsal fin middle radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: anal fin middle radial bone
definition: Anal fin middle radial element that is composed of bone tissue.
synonyms_exact: anal fin medial radial|medial anal-fin radial

name: sphenotic spine
definition: Process of the sphenotic. The process may project antero-laterally or laterally or ventro-laterally and it has different development in different fish groups. The sphenotic spine is paired.

name: lateral ethmoid wing
definition: Superficial and lateral bony projection anterior to orbital region. Sometimes with superficial ornamentation where in direct contact with skin.

name: trunk sensory canal
definition: Sensory canal on trunk which is posterior to the pectoral girdle and often reaching to or onto the caudal fin. The trunk sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

name: post-otic sensory canal
definition: Sensory canal between and in close proximity to the trunk sensory canal and anteriorly with the otic and preoperculo-mandibular sensory canals. The post-otic sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

name: lagenar capsule
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of a bulla formed by the exoccipital and basioccipital bones, and surrounds the lagena.

name: odontode
definition: Multi-tissue structure composed of enameloid and dentine surrounding a pulp cavity, and found either attached to dermal bone or freely in the skin.

name: type 1 odontode
definition: Odontode that is attached to dermal bone.

name: type 2 odontode
definition: Odontode that is attached to the skin and without association to dermal bone.

name: premaxillary tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to the premaxilla.

name: otic sensory canal
definition: Sensory canal between and in close proximity posteriorly with the post-otic and preoperculo-mandibular sensory canals, and anteriorly with the supraorbital and infraorbital sensory canals. The otic sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

name: supratemporal sensory canal
definition: Sensory canal that crosses over the dorsal midline and in close proximity to the contralateral post-otic sensory canals. The supratemporal sensory canal is unpaired.

name: ectopterygoid tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to the ectopterygoid bone.

name: entopterygoid tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to the entopterygoid bone.

name: pharyngobranchial 1 cartilage
definition: Most anterior pharyngobranchial cartilage, located medial to the epibranchials.

name: pharyngobranchial 1 bone
definition: Most anterior pharyngobranchial bone, located medial to the epibranchials.

name: pharyngobranchial 4 bone
definition: Most posterior pharyngobranchial bone, located medial to the epibranchials.

name: notochordal ossification
definition: Perichordal bone that surrounds the anterior tip of the notochord.

name: pharyngeal tooth plate
definition: Dermal bone of the pharyngeal arches usually bearing teeth.

name: basihyal tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to the basihyal cartilage or bone.

name: basihyal tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to the basihyal tooth plate.

name: pharyngobranchial 2 tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 2 bone.

name: pharyngobranchial 2 tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to the pharyngobranchial 2 tooth plate.

name: pharyngobranchial 3 tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 3 bone.

name: pharyngobranchial 3 tooth
definition: Tooth that is part of the pharyngobranchial 3 tooth plate.

name: upper pharyngeal 4 tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 4, and located anterior to upper pharyngeal 5 tooth plate.

name: upper pharyngeal 4 tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to the upper pharyngeal 4 tooth plate.

name: upper pharyngeal 5 tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal toothplate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 4, and located posterior to upper pharyngeal 4 tooth plate.

name: upper pharyngeal 5 tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to the upper pharyngeal 5 tooth plate.

name: upper pharyngeal tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchials 3 and 4.

name: upper pharyngeal tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to the upper pharyngeal tooth plate.

name: basibranchial tooth
definition: Tooth that is part of the basibranchial tooth plate.

name: basibranchial tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to basibranchials 1-3.

name: basibranchial 4 tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to basibranchial 4 bone.

name: basibranchial 4 tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to the basibranchial 4 tooth plate.

name: basibranchial 2 tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to basibranchial 2 bone.

name: basibranchial 2 tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to the basibranchial 2 tooth plate.

name: rudimentary neural arch
definition: Neural arch on the urostyle. It does not support a neural spine. Sanger and McCune 2002.

name: anal fin radial bone
definition: Anal fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: dorsal fin radial bone
definition: Dorsal fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: infraorbital 6
definition: Infraorbital that is the sixth bone of the infraorbital series.

name: mesethmoid cornu
definition: Bony projection that extends from the mesethmoid anteriorly. Mesethmoid cornua are paired processes each articulating with its ipsilateral premaxilla and both cornua bounding a median mesethmoid cleft.

name: mesethmoid-premaxillary joint
definition: Joint that articulates the mesethmoid and premaxilla. Mesethmoid-premaxillary joint is paired.

name: mesethmoid-nasal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the mesethmoid and nasal. Mesethmoid-nasal joint is paired.

name: mesethmoid-frontal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the mesethmoid and frontal. Mesethmoid-frontal joint is paired.

name: mesethmoid-lateral ethmoid joint
definition: Joint that articulates the mesethmoid and lateral ethmoid. Mesethmoid-lateral ethmoid joint is paired.

name: mesethmoid-vomer joint
definition: Joint that articulates the mesethmoid and vomer. Mesethmoid-vomer joint is unpaired.

name: cornu mesial process
definition: Bony projection that is mesially-directed and off the anteromedial corner of each mesethmoid cornu.

name: transcapular ligament
definition: Ligament that is attached to supracleithrum and basioccipital.

name: ossified transcapular ligament
definition: Membrane bone that is fused to supracleithrum and is jointed to basioccipital and exoccipital.

name: lateral ethmoid-ectopterygoid ligament
definition: Lateral ethmoid-ectopterygoid ligament is a ligament that connects the lateral ethmoid to the ectopterygoid.

name: bony shelf above orbit
definition: The bony shelf above orbit is an anatomical cluster formed by the dorsolateral portions of the lateral ethmoid, frontal and sphenotic bones that forms the dorsal margin of the orbit.

name: interopercular-mandibular ligament
definition: Interopercular-mandibular ligament is a ligament that connects the interopercle to an element of the lower jaw, typically the retroarticular.

name: palatine cartilage
definition: Cartilage that is separate from and anterior to the pterygoquadrate cartilage.

name: pterygoquadrate cartilage
definition: Pterygoquadrate cartilage - cartilage that is separate from and posterior to the palatine cartilage.

name: anterior cartilage of palatine
definition: Anterior cartilage of palatine - cartilage that caps the anterior end of the autopalatine bone. It is typically present in adults.

name: posterior cartilage of palatine
definition: Posterior cartilage of palatine - cartilage that caps the posterior end of the autopalatine bone. It is typically present in adults.

name: median premaxilla
definition: Dermal bone that is located in the middle of the upper jaw, independently formed by fusion of tooth bases attached to soft tissue in the middle portion of the upper lip. The median premaxilla bears teeth in adults.

name: protractor operculi
definition: Muscle located in the lateral region of the cheek, linking the lateral surface of opercle with the posterolateral margin of the suspensorium (usually the preopercle).

name: humerovertebral ligament
definition: Ligament that links the tip of the postcleithral process of the cleithrum with either the vertebral column (at the vertebral parapophysis or rib of the sixth vertebra) or with the soft tissue around the postcleithral region.

name: mediopharyngobranchial
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage, elongate and usually bifurcated posteriorly, located anteriorly on the upper branchial arches, attached to the anterior tips of the first infrapharyngobranchials. It supports rows of gill rakers on each side and is not homologous to other structures in the teleost gill-arch skeleton. One or two mediopharyngobranchials may be present.

name: gongyloid cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage present on the dorsal surface of the middle portion of the upper branchial arches, dorsal to the point of contact between the second and third infrapharyngobranchials. It is round or cylyndrical in shape. Not homologous to the mediopharyngobranchial.

name: transverse radial
definition: Endochondral bone, which may be ossified or not in adults, located immediately anteriorly to the pterygiophore series of the anal fin. The structure is usually cylindrical, and its plane of symmetry is transverse to that of pterygiophores and fin rays.

name: anal-fin stay
definition: Endochondral bone located posterior to the last anal fin pterygiophore. The anal fin stay is a median bone.

name: dorsal-fin stay
definition: Endochondral bone located posterior to the last dorsal fin pterygiophore. The dorsal fin stay is a median bone.

name: caudal-fin stay
definition: Dermal bone that is located anterior to the caudal fin procurrent rays. Caudal fin stays are unpaired median bones.

name: basibranchial 5 bone
definition: Basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 5 (pharyngeal arch 7). Develops in posterior copula cartilage or basibranchial 5 cartilage.

name: infraorbital 7
definition: Infraorbital that is the seventh bone of the infraorbital series.

name: infraorbital 8
definition: Infraorbital that is the eighth bone of the infraorbital series.

name: infraorbital 9
definition: Infraorbital that is the ninth bone of the infraorbital series.

name: infraorbital 10
definition: Infraorbital that is the tenth bone of the infraorbital series.

name: infraorbital 11
definition: Infraorbital that is the eleventh bone of the infraorbital series.

name: infraorbital 12
definition: Infraorbital that is the twelfth bone of the infraorbital series.

name: dermosphenotic
definition: Infraorbital that is the last bone of the infraorbital series, carrying the infraorbital canal, and sometimes also the supraorbital, temporal, and/or preopercular canals. The dermosphenotic is sometimes sutured or fused completely to the skull, e.g. to the autosphenotic.

name: infraorbital series
definition: Anatomical cluster that is the series of dermal bones surrounding the orbit and associated with the infraorbital sensory canal.

name: opercle-interopercle joint
definition: Joint that articulates the opercle and interopercle. Opercle-interopercle joint is paired.

name: frontal-pterotic joint
definition: Joint that articulates the frontal and pterotic. Frontal-pterotic joint is paired.

name: caudal principal ray 1
definition: Caudal principal ray that is the dorsalmost caudal principal ray of the caudal fin.

name: caudal principal ray 2
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 1.

name: caudal principal ray 3
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 2.

name: caudal principal ray 4
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 3.

name: caudal principal ray 5
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 4.

name: caudal principal ray 6
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 5.

name: caudal principal ray 7
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 6.

name: caudal principal ray 8
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 7.

name: caudal principal ray 9
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 8.

name: caudal principal ray 10
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 9.

name: caudal principal ray 11
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 10.

name: caudal principal ray 12
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 11.

name: caudal principal ray 13
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 12.

name: caudal principal ray 14
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 13.

name: caudal principal ray 15
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 14.

name: caudal principal ray 16
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 15.

name: caudal principal ray 17
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 16.

name: caudal principal ray 18
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 17.

name: caudal principal ray 19
definition: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 18.

name: vertebral element 5
definition: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 4.

name: mesethmoid ventral diverging lamella
definition: Bony projection that is the posterolaterally oriented projection on the ventral region of the mesethmoid. Mesethmoid ventral diverging lamellae are paired and posteriorly contact the lateral ethmoid bones.

name: posterior process of basipterygium
definition: Process that is the posteriorly oriented, paired projection of the basipterygium.

name: scapular foramen
definition: Foramen that is located in the scapula. The scapular foramen is paired and formed by a ring of bone.

name: coracoid foramen
definition: Foramen that is located in the coracoid.

name: anterior cranial fontanel
definition: Fontanel that is located between the contralateral frontals and anterior to the epiphyseal bar.

name: posterior cranial fontanel
definition: Fontanel that is located posterior to the epiphyseal bar, and typically located between the contralateral frontals and parietals (if present) and bordered posteriorly by the supraoccipital.

name: trigeminofacial foramen
definition: Foramen through which branches of cranial nerves V (trigeminal) and VII (facial) exit.

name: auditory foramen
definition: Foramen through which cranial nerve VIII (auditory) exits.

name: replacement tooth trench
definition: Anatomical space within a bone in which teeth develop.

name: premaxilla replacement tooth trench
definition: Replacement tooth trench that is located in the premaxilla.

name: dentary replacement tooth trench
definition: Replacement tooth trench that is located in the dentary.

name: lateral mesethmoid wing
definition: Bony projection located on the anteroventral region of the mesethmoid which articulates with the premaxilla.

name: superficial ophthalmic nerve foramen
definition: Foramen through which the superficial ophthalmic nerve passes.

name: dentary-anguloarticular joint
definition: Joint that articulates the dentary and anguloarticular. Dentary-anguloarticular joint is paired.

name: rib of vertebra 6
definition: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the sixth centrum.

name: rib of vertebra 5
definition: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the fifth centrum.

name: pre-narial cartilage
definition: The pre-narial cartilage is a cartilage that is located anterior to the anterior naris.

name: posttemporal fossa
definition: Fossa where the exoccipital forms the medial portion and the epioccipital forms the lateral margin. The posttemporal fossa in most species has two openings separated by the epioccipital bridge.

name: pectoral fin ray 1
definition: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium 1 is the leading or marginal ray of the fin and articulates with the scapula. Lepidotrichium 1 is commonly segmented but unbranched but occasionally may be a massive strong unsegmented element (e.g., spine).

name: pectoral fin ray 2
definition: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the second most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

name: pectoral fin ray 3
definition: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the third most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

name: pectoral fin ray 4
definition: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the fourth most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

name: pectoral fin ray 5
definition: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the fifth most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

name: pectoral fin ray 6
definition: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the sixth most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

name: pectoral fin ray 7
definition: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the seventh most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

name: retractor tentaculi
definition: Bilaterally paired dorsal hyoid arch muscle that retracts the maxillary barbel.

name: supraoccipital crest
definition: Process that is part of the supraoccipital. It is a posteriorly directed and unpaired median projection off the posterior margin of the supraoccipital bone.

name: autopalatine-vomer joint
definition: Joint that articulates autopalatine and vomer bones. Autopalatine-vomer joint is paired.

name: pectoral fin spine
definition: Pectoral-fin lepidotrichium 1 with mostly co-ossified and unsegmented hemitrichia that form a stiff and usually thick shaft and enlarged basal processes that moveably articulate with the pectoral girdle. The pectoral fin spine may also result from the fusion of several lepidotrichia that form a stiff shaft.

name: pelvic splint
definition: Dermal bone that is located near the lateral margin of the pelvic fin, and lateral to pelvic-fin lepidotrichium 1.

name: dorsal fin spine 1
definition: Dorsal-fin lepidotrichium 1 with co-ossified and unsegmented hemitrichia that form a stiff shaft and enlarged base that moveably articulates with first (anteriormost) dorsal-fin pterygiophore.

name: dorsal fin spine 2
definition: Dorsal-fin lepidotrichium 2 with co-ossified and unsegmented hemitrichia that form a stiff shaft and enlarged base that moveably articulates with second dorsal-fin pterygiophore.

name: pharyngobranchial 3 bone uncinate process
definition: Bony projection that is part of the pharyngobranchial 3.

name: pharyngobranchial 4 bone uncinate process
definition: Bony projection that is part of the pharyngobranchial 4.

name: orbitosphenoid-prootic joint
definition: Joint that articulates orbitosphenoid and prootic bones. Orbitosphenoid-prootic joint is paired.

name: ceratohyal foramen
definition: Foramen in the anterior ceratohyal for passage of the hyoidean artery.

name: epibranchial 2 bone uncinate process
definition: Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 2 bone.

name: epibranchial 1 bone uncinate process
definition: Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 1 bone.

name: epicentral bone
definition: Intermuscular bone that articulates with the vertebral centrum.

name: recessus lateralis
definition: Intracranial space formed by confluence of supraorbital, infraorbital, preopercular and temporal sensory canals. See also Di Dario (2004).

name: cephalic rib
definition: Modified epicentral intermuscular bone that connects the back of the skull with the pectoral girdle.

name: quadrate-hyomandibula joint
definition: Joint that articulates quadrate and hyomandibula bones. Quadrate-hyomandibula joint is paired.

name: quadrate-metapterygoid joint
definition: Joint that articulates quadrate and metapterygoid bones. Quadrate-metapterygoid joint is paired.

name: olfactory nerve foramen
definition: Foramen for the passage of the olfactory nerve or cranial nerve 1.

name: articular bone
definition: Endochondral bone that is located posterior to the dentary, medial to the angular and antero-dorsal to the retroarticular forming the lower jaw. The articular bears a dorso-posterior articular facet for the condyle of the quadrate. The articular is a paired bone.

name: intracranial diverticulum of swimbladder
definition: An anterior extension of the swimbladder that passes through a foramen in the exoccipital; part of the otophysic connection between swimbladder and inner ear.

name: preepiotic fossa
definition: Fossa that is a concavity on the dorsolateral surface of the skull roof found at least partially on the epiotic (epioccipital).

name: facial foramen
definition: Foramen through which cranial nerve VII (facial) exits.

name: trigeminal foramen
definition: Foramen through which cranial nerve V (trigeminal) exits.

name: supraorbital sensory canal
definition: Sensory canal anterior to and in close proximity to the otic and infraorbital sensory canals. The supraorbital sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

name: infraorbital sensory canal
definition: Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity to the otic and supraorbital sensory canals at their union. The infraorbital sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the infraorbital bones.

name: preoperculo-mandibular sensory canal
definition: Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity to the otic and post-otic sensory canals at their union. The preoperculo-mandibular sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the preopercle, angular and dentary bones.

name: preopercular sensory canal
definition: Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity with the otic and post-otic sensory canals at their union, and anteroventrally with the mandibular sensory canal. The preopercular sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the preopercle bone.

name: mandibular sensory canal
definition: Sensory canal anterior and ventral to and in close proximity with the preoperculo-mandibular sensory canal. The mandible sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the angular and dentary bones.

name: nuchal plate
definition: Dermal bone that is a bony expansion in the integument anterior to or flanking the dorsal fin that is part of and at the distal end of a supraneural or dorsal fin proximal radial.

name: anterior nuchal plate
definition: Nuchal plate that is unpaired and part of the supraneural and in contact, or not, with the supraoccipital crest anteriorly and middle nuchal plate posteriorly.

name: middle nuchal plate
definition: Nuchal plate that is unpaired and part of dorsal fin proximal radial 1 and usually in contact with the anterior nuchal plate and paired posterior nuchal plates.

name: dorsal fin proximal radial bone 1
definition: Dorsal fin proximal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: dorsal fin proximal radial bone 2
definition: Dorsal fin proximal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: posterior nuchal plate
definition: Paired nuchal plate that is part of dorsal fin proximal radial 2 and usually in contact with the middle nuchal plate.

name: notochord posterior region
definition: Portion of tissue that is part of the caudal fin.

name: epibranchial 3 bone uncinate process
definition: Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 3 bone.

name: epibranchial 4 bone uncinate process
definition: Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 4 bone.

name: lateral line scale
definition: Scale that is associated with the lateral line sensory canal.

name: urohyal lateral process
definition: Process that is part of the urohyal; it is the posterolaterally directed process located on the ventrolateral margin of urohyal. Urohyal lateral process is paired.
synonyms_exact: branche ventrale de l'urohyal|processus hyo-pelvien|urohyal lateral lamella|urohyal ventral wing

name: urohyal median process
definition: Process that is part of the urohyal; it is the posterodorsally directed and median process located on the dorsal margin of the urohyal.

name: premaxillary-maxillary ligament
definition: Ligament that connects the premaxilla to the maxilla.

name: primordial ligament
definition: Ligament that connects the maxilla with the lower jaw.

name: caudal fin dorsal procurrent ray
definition: Caudal procurrent ray that forms part of the anterior dorsal series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin and may be associated with a neural spine or a epural or a uroneural. A pair of hemitrichia forms each ray.
synonyms_exact: dorsal caudal procurrent ray|dorsal procurrent caudal-fin ray

name: caudal fin ventral procurrent ray
definition: Caudal procurrent ray that forms part of the anterior ventral series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin that may be associated with a neural spine or a epural or an uroneural (dorsal series) and with a hemal spine of a preural vertebra (ventral series). A caudal procurrent ray is an unpaired median bone.
synonyms_exact: precurrent ray|ventral caudal procurrent ray|ventral procurrent caudal-fin ray|ventral procurrent ray

name: pterosphenoid-orbitosphenoid joint
definition: Joint that articulates the pterosphenoid and orbitosphenoid. Pterosphenoid-orbitosphenoid joint is paired.

name: parasphenoid-basioccipital joint
definition: Joint that articulates the parasphenoid and basioccipital. Parasphenoid-basioccipital joint is unpaired.

name: premaxillary tooth row
definition: Tooth row that is on the premaxilla.

name: tip
definition: Anatomical point that is the apex of a projection or anything long and tapered; can be bony or cartilage.

name: interhyal-epihyal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the interhyal and epihyal bones, or interhyal and ceratohyal cartilages. Interhyal-epihyal joint is paired.

name: epihyal-ceratohyal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the epihyal and ceratohyal bones. Epihyal-ceratohyal joint is paired.

name: ceratohyal-dorsal hypohyal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the ceratohyal and dorsal hypohyal bones. Ceratohyal-dorsal hypohyal joint is paired.

name: ceratohyal-ventral hypohyal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the ceratohyal and ventral hypohyal bones. Ceratohyal-ventral hypohyal joint is paired.

name: dorsal hypohyal-ventral hypohyal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the dorsal hypohyal and ventral hypohyal bones. Dorsal hypohyal-ventral hypohyal joint is paired.

name: inter-ventral hypohyal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the contralateral ventral hypohyal bones or the contralateral ceratobranchial cartilages. Inter-ventral hypohyal joint is paired.

name: dorsal hypohyal-urohyal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the dorsal hypohyal and urohyal bones. Dorsal hypohyal-urohyal joint is paired.

name: ventral hypohyal-urohyal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the ventral hypohyal and urohyal bones. Ventral hypohyal-urohyal joint is paired.

name: epihyal-branchiostegal ray joint
definition: Joint that articulates the epihyal and branchiostegal ray bones. Epihyal-branchiostegal ray joint is paired.

name: ceratohyal-branchiostegal ray joint
definition: Joint that articulates the ceratohyal and branchiostegal ray bones. Ceratohyal-branchiostegal ray joint is paired.
