name: postcleithrum 1
definition: Postcleithrum that anteriorly articulates with the supracleithrum and/or the cleithrum of the pectoral girdle; most dorsal element in a series of postcleithra.

name: postcleithrum 2
definition: Postcleithrum that articulates dorsally with postcleithrum 1, ventrally with postcleithrum 3, and anteriorly with cleithrum.

name: postcleithrum 3
definition: Postcleithrum that articulates dorsally with postcleithrum 2 and, sometimes, anteriorly with cleithrum.

name: hyomandibular condyle for the opercle
definition: Process on the dorso-posterior margin of the hyomandibula cartilage or bone that articulates with a depression on the antero-dorsal margin of the opercle.

name: gill ray
definition: Gill ray is a slender, usually rod-like cartilage within a gill filament and ligamentously tied to its associated pharyngeal arch bone or cartilage.

name: hyoidean artery
definition: An artery that passes along the ventral portions of the hyoid arch; supplies oxygenated blood to the pseudobranch.

name: suprapharyngobranchial
definition: A pharyngobranchial bone that articulates with the neurocranium dorsally and epibranchial 1 and pharyngobranchial 2 ventrally; lies dorsal to other elements of the dorsal portions of the branchial arches.

name: pharyngobranchial 1 tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 1 bone.

name: epibranchial 4-upper pharyngeal toothplate joint
definition: Joint that articulates the epibranchial 4 cartilage or bone and upper pharyngeal toothplate. Epibranchial 4-upper pharyngeal toothplate joint is paired.

name: epibranchial 3-pharyngobranchial 3 joint
definition: Joint that articulates the epibranchial 3 cartilage or bone and pharyngobranchial 3 cartilage or bone. Epibranchial 3-pharyngobranchial 3 joint is paired.

name: epibranchial 3-pharyngobranchial 4 joint
definition: Joint that articulates the epibranchial 3 cartilage or bone and pharyngobranchial 4 cartilage or bone. Epibranchial 3-pharyngobranchial 4 joint is paired.

name: inter-hypobranchial 3 joint
definition: Joint that articulates the left and right hypobranchial 3 cartilages or bones. Inter-hypobranchial 3 joint is unpaired.

name: basibranchial 1 cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 1 (pharyngeal arch 3).

name: basibranchial 4 cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 4 (pharyngeal arch 6).

name: basibranchial 5 cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 5 (pharyngeal arch 7).

name: post-ceratobranchial cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and at or posterior to the juncture of the bilaterally paired ceratobranchial 5 cartilage or bone.

name: supraneural 2 cartilage
definition: Postcranial axial cartilage located dorsal to vertebra 2.

name: supraneural 3 cartilage
definition: Postcranial axial cartilage located dorsal to vertebrae 3 and 4.

name: Weberian ossicle set
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of the Weberian ossicles.

name: trunk sensory canal system
definition: Lateral line system on trunk.

name: head sensory canal system
definition: Lateral line system on head and pectoral girdle.

name: basibranchial 2 cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 2 (pharyngeal arch 4).

name: basibranchial 3 cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 3 (pharyngeal arch 5).

name: neural arch 1
definition: Neural arch that is the anteriormost neural arch.

name: rib of vertebra 2
definition: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the second centrum.

name: rib of vertebra 1
definition: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the first centrum.

name: rib of vertebra 3
definition: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the third centrum.

name: rib of vertebra 4
definition: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the fourth centrum.

name: parapophysis + rib of vertebra 3 + rib of vertebra 4
accessory neural arch
definition: Neural arch that is located posterior to the neurocranium and anterior to neural arch 1. The accessory neural arch is not associated with a vertebral centrum.

name: neural spine 1
definition: Neural spine that is associated with the first vertebra.

name: neural spine 2
definition: Neural spine that is associated with the second vertebra.

name: neural spine 3
definition: Neural spine that is associated with the third vertebra.

name: supraneural 1 bone
definition: Supraneural bone located dorsal to vertebra 1.

name: supraneural 1 cartilage
definition: Postcranial axial cartilage located dorsal to vertebra 1.

name: interhyal element
definition: Skeletal element that is bilaterally paired and articulates dorsally with the hyosymplectic cartilage or the articulation of the hyomandibula and symplectic.

name: hypobranchial element
definition: Skeletal element that is bilaterally paired and articulates medially with a median skeletal element and laterally with a ceratobranchial element.

name: hypobranchial 1 element
definition: Skeletal element that is ventral, bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 1 element laterally.

name: hypobranchial 2 element
definition: Skeletal element that is ventral, bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 2 element laterally.

name: hypobranchial 3 element
definition: Skeletal element that is ventral, bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 3 element laterally.

name: hypobranchial 4 element
definition: Skeletal element that is ventral, bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 4 element laterally.

name: ceratobranchial element
definition: Skeletal element that is bilaterally paired and forms part of the ventral branchial arches.

name: epibranchial element
definition: Skeletal element that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial element.

name: pharyngobranchial element
definition: Skeletal element of the branchial arches located medial to the epibranchials.

name: pharyngobranchial 1 element
definition: Most anterior pharyngobranchial element, located medial to the epibranchials.

name: pharyngobranchial 2 element
definition: Pharyngobranchial element, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 1 element.

name: pharyngobranchial 3 element
definition: Pharyngobranchial element, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 2 element.

name: pharyngobranchial 4 element
definition: Most posterior pharyngobranchial element, located medial to the epibranchials.

name: basibranchial 1 element
definition: Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 1.

name: basibranchial 2 element
definition: Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 2.

name: basibranchial 3 element
definition: Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 3.

name: basibranchial 4 element
definition: Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 4.

name: basibranchial 5 element
definition: Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 5.

name: pseudotympanum
definition: Anatomical structure that is formed as a hiatus in the muscles covering the anterior chamber of the swim bladder in the area of ribs 5 and 6.

name: adipose eyelid
definition: Surface structure that is a fleshy membrane covering part of the eye.

name: inter-frontal joint
definition: Joint between the left and right frontal bone.

name: aortic canal
definition: Canal that houses the dorsal aorta.

name: occipital artery foramen
definition: Foramina that allow passage of occipital arteries.

name: spiracular canal
definition: Foramen for passage of nerve supplying otic lateral line.

name: posterior myodome
definition: Fossa or chamber on posterior portion of orbital region of neurocranium that serves as attachment site for posterior extrinsic eye muscles.

name: anterior myodome
definition: Fossa or chamber on anterior portion of orbital region of neurocranium that serves as attachment site for anterior extrinsic eye musculature.

name: articular fossa of opercle
definition: Fossa of opercle that articulates with hyomandibular condyle for opercle.

name: epioccipital posterior process
definition: Process of the epioccipital that extends posteriorly, is laminar in form and is usually attached to Weberian apparatus.

name: accessory vomerine tooth plate
definition: Dermal bone that is located lateral to vomer off midline of palate. Accessory vomerine tooth plate bears teeth and may be present as one or more pairs.

name: infranuchal scute
definition: Scute that is an elongated plate associated with a ligament running between posterior nuchal plate and rib on vertebra 6. Infranuchal scute is paired and develops from its associated ligament and sensory canal tubular ossicle.

name: sensory canal tubular ossicle
definition: Dermal bone that is ring-shaped or cylindrical and surrounds a sensory canal.

name: sensory canal tubule
definition: Sensory canal that is a side branch between a sensory canal proximally and a pore at its distal end. Sensory canal tubule is bilaterally paired although often imperfectly so.

name: rostral plate
definition: Dermal bone that is located on midline of snout in skin above mesethmoid and lateral ethmoid bones. Rostral plate bears type 1 odontodes and is unpaired.

name: oral disk
definition: Lip that is expanded to form a broad, rounded cup around the mouth.

name: posterior nasal barbel
definition: Barbel that is attached to the anterior rim of the posterior nostril. Posterior nasal barbel is paired.

name: anterior nasal barbel
definition: Barbel that is associated with the anterior nostril. Anterior nasal barbel is paired.

name: maxillary barbel
definition: Barbel that is attached to the distal end of the maxilla and that originates on the side of the mouth. Maxillary barbel is paired.

name: inter-basipterygium joint
definition: Joint that articulates the left and right basipterygium cartilage or bone. Inter-basipterygium joint is unpaired.

name: vertebra 4-vertebra 5 joint
definition: Joint between the centra, and sometimes the neural arches or parapophyses of vertebra 4 and vertebra 5.

name: orbitosphenoid-lateral ethmoid joint
definition: Joint that articulates the orbitosphenoid cartilage or bone and lateral ethmoid cartilage or bone. Orbitosphenoid-lateral ethmoid joint is paired.

name: autopalatine-maxillary joint
definition: Joint that articulates the autopalatine cartilage or bone and maxilla.

name: metapterygoid-autopalatine ligament
definition: Ligament that connects the metapterygoid to the autopalatine.

name: lateral ethmoid-autopalatine ligament
definition: Lateral ethmoid-autopalatine ligament is a ligament that connects the lateral ethmoid to the autopalatine.

name: mesethmoid-premaxillary ligament
definition: Mesethmoid-premaxillary ligament is a ligament that connects the mesethmoid to the premaxilla.

name: mesethmoid-maxillary ligament
definition: Mesethmoid-maxillary ligament is a ligament that connects the mesethmoid to the maxilla.

name: hyomandibular-otic region joint
definition: Joint that articulates the hyomandibular cartilage or bone and otic region cartilage or sphenotic bone, and often pterotic bone and prootic bone. Hyomandibular-otic region joint is paired.

name: anal fin hook
definition: Process that is part of the anal fin lepidotrichium.

name: caudal fin hook
definition: Process that is part of the caudal fin lepidotrichium.

name: inter-premaxillary joint
definition: Joint that articulates the left and right premaxillary bones. Inter-premaxillary joint is unpaired.

name: skin flap
definition: Surface structure that is a portion of skin that projects or hangs from the body.

name: dentary tooth row
definition: Tooth row that is on the dentary.

name: epibranchial 1 bone proximal cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the proximal end of epibranchial 1 bone, and that usually articulates with a pharyngobranchial element. Epibranchial 1 bone proximal cartilage is paired.

name: epibranchial 2 bone proximal cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the proximal end of epibranchial 2 bone, and that usually articulates with a pharyngobranchial element. Epibranchial 2 bone proximal cartilage is paired.

name: ceratobranchial 3 bone distal cartilage
definition: Pharynbeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of ceratobranchial 3 bone, and that usually articulates with epibranchial 3 element. Ceratobranchial 3 bone distal cartilage is paired.
synonyms_exact: ceratobranchial 3 bone lateral cartilage|ceratobranchial 3 bone posterior cartilage

name: ceratobranchial 4 bone proximal cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the proximal end of ceratobranchial 4 bone, and that usually articulates with basibranchial 4 element. Ceratobranchial 4 proximal cartilage is paired.
synonyms_exact: ceratobranchial 4 bone anterior cartilage|ceratobranchial 4 bone mesial cartilage

name: ceratobranchial 4 bone distal cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of ceratobranchial 4 bone, and that usually articulates with epibranchial 4 element. Ceratobranchial 4 distal cartilage is paired.
synonyms_exact: ceratobranchial 4 bone lateral cartilage|ceratobranchial 4 bone posterior cartilage

name: ceratobranchial 5 bone distal cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of ceratobranchial 5 bone. Ceratobranchial 5 bone distal cartilage is paired.
synonyms_exact: ceratobranchial 5 bone lateral cartilage|ceratobranchial 5 bone posterior cartilage

name: hypobranchial 1 bone distal cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of hypobranchial 1 bone, and that usually articulates with ceratobranchial 1 element. Hypobranchial 1 bone distal cartilage is paired.
synonyms_exact: hypobranchial 1 bone lateral cartilage|hypobranchial 1 bone posterior cartilage

name: hypobranchial 2 bone distal cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of hypobranchial 2 bone, and that usually articulates with ceratobranchial 2 element. Hypobranchial 2 bone distal cartilage is paired.
synonyms_exact: hypobranchial 2 bone lateral cartilage|hypobranchial 2 bone posterior cartilage

name: epibranchial 3 bone uncinate process cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of epibranchial bone 3 uncinate process. epibranchial bone 3 uncinate process cartilage is paired.

name: epibranchial 4 bone uncinate process cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of epibranchial bone 4 uncinate process. Epibranchial bone 4 uncinate process cartilage is paired.

name: outer mental barbel
definition: Mental barbel that originates on the chin, in a posterolateral position relative to the inner mental barbel.

name: inner mental barbel
definition: Mental barbel that originates on the chin, in an anteromedial position relative to the outer mental barbel. The inner mental barbel is nearer to the mandibular symphysis than is the outer mental barbel.

name: parapophysis 4
definition: Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the fourth centrum. Parapophysis 4 is bilaterally paired.

name: intercostal ligament
definition: Ligament that connects one rib to another.

name: interorbital septum
definition: Anatomical cluster composed of one or more bones and tissue that separates the orbits.

name: pad
definition: Surface structure that is a portion of the integument thickened relative to surrounding area.

name: maxillary tooth row
definition: Tooth row that is on the maxilla.

name: hyomandibula-metapterygoid joint
definition: Joint that articulates the hyomandibula bone and metapterygoid bone.

name: vertebral element 6
definition: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 5.

name: vertebral element 7
definition: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 6.

name: vertebral element 8
definition: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 7.

name: centrum 1
definition: Centrum that is part of vertebra 1.

name: centrum 2
definition: Centrum that is part of vertebra 2.

name: centrum 3
definition: Centrum that is part of vertebra 3.

name: centrum 4
definition: Centrum that is part of vertebra 4.

name: centrum 5
definition: Centrum that is part of vertebra 5.

name: centrum 6
definition: Centrum that is part of vertebra 6.

name: mandibular-hyoid median cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is a spherical mass of cartilage located between the mandibular symphysis and ventral hyoid arch. Mandibular-hyoid median cartilage is unpaired.

name: epibranchial arborescent organ
definition: Anatomical cluster that is an outgrowth of the soft tissue around the dorsolateral corner of a branchial arch that is internally supported by a core of rigid cartilage-like tissue. Epibranchial arborescent organ is paired.

name: lateral bone
definition: Membrane bone extending between a transverse process of the second proximal dorsal-fin radial and the pleural rib of the sixth vertebra. Lateral bone is paired.

name: branched anal fin ray
definition: Anal fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched.

name: branched pectoral fin ray
definition: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched and segmented.

name: gill raker row
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of adjacent gill rakers constituting a row and is part of a ceratobranchial or epibranchial element of the branchial arches. Gill raker row is paired.

name: papilla
definition: Surface structure that is a small, fleshy protuberance.

name: parietal-supraoccipital
definition: Compound dermal and endochondral bone that results from the fusion of the paired dermal parietal bones and the median endochondral supraoccipital. Forms the dorso-posterior element of the dermatocranium.

name: posttemporal-supracleithrum
definition: Dermal bone that results from the fusion of the dermal posttemporal and the dermal supracleithrum. Forms the upper skeletal element of the pectoral girdle between the cleithrum and neurocranium. Posttemporal-supracleithrum is paired.

name: posterior cleithral process
definition: Process arising from the posterior or postero-dorsal margin of the cleithrum dorsally adjacent to the insertion of the pectoral fin. Posterior cleithral process is paired.

name: posterior dentation of pectoral fin spine
definition: Process that is tooth-like or thorn-like and arising from the posteriorly-facing margin of the abducted pectoral spine.
synonyms_exact: pectoral fin spine posterior dentation|posterior denticle of pectoral fin spine|posterior serration of pectoral fin spine|posterior thorn of pectoral fin spine|posterior tooth of pectoral fin spine

name: anterior dentation of pectoral fin spine
definition: Process that is tooth- or thorn-like and arising from the anteriorly-facing margin of the abducted pectoral spine. Anterior dentation of pectoral fin spine is usually present on the proximal and/or middle section of the pectoral fin spine.

name: anterior distal serration of pectoral fin spine
definition: Process that is retrorse, thorn-like and arising from the anteriorly-facing margin of the abducted pectoral spine. Anterior distal serration of pectoral fin spine is usually present on the distal section of the pectoral fin spine.

name: posterior dentation of dorsal fin spine 2
definition: Process that is tooth or thorn-like and arising from the posteriorly-facing margin of the abducted dorsal-fin spine 2.
synonyms_exact: dorsal fin spine 2 posterior dentation|posterior denticle of dorsal fin spine 2|posterior serration of dorsal fin spine 2|posterior thorn of dorsal fin spine 2|posterior tooth of dorsal fin spine 2

name: anterior dentation of dorsal fin spine 2
definition: Process that is tooth- or thorn-like and arising from the anteriorly-facing margin of the abducted dorsal-fin spine 2.
synonyms_exact: anterior denticle of dorsal fin spine 2|anterior serration of dorsal fin spine 2|anterior thorn of dorsal fin spine 2|anterior tooth of dorsal fin spine 2|dorsal fin spine 2 anterior dentation

name: canal plate
definition: Dermal bone that is ventral to the preopercle and bears a portion of the preopercular sensory canal.

name: axillary pore
definition: Pore that is located ventral to the posterior cleithral process and medial to the pectoral fin. Axillary pore is at the end of a duct from an integumentary gland.

name: supraneural 4 bone
definition: Supraneural dorsal to neural spine 4.

name: neural lamina
definition: Neural lamina is a median, vertical ridge or bony septum between neural spine 3 and neural spine 4 on the dorsal side of the Weberian vertebra. Neural lamina is unpaired.

name: medial cartilage of palatine
definition: Pharyngeal cartilage that caps the medial margin of the palatine at the autopalatine-lateral ethmoid joint.

name: hyoideomandibular nerve
definition: Nerve that is a branch of cranial nerve VII that passes through or around the suspensorium to innervate muscles and sensory organs on or near pharyngeal arch 2.

name: lateral fontanel of frontal
definition: Fontanel within the frontal bone near the frontal-sphenotic joint. Lateral fontanel of frontal is paired.

name: dentary foramen
definition: Foramen located on the dentary for passage of the mandibular nerve.

name: ascending limb of ceratobranchial 5 bone
definition: Process that is the dorsally directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 bone.

name: ascending limb of ceratobranchial 5 cartilage
definition: Process that is the dorsally directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 cartilage.

name: pharyngobranchial tooth plate
definition: Dermal bone of upper pharyngeal arches associated with pharyngobranchial bones or cartilages, usually bearing teeth.

name: pharyngobranchial 4 tooth plate
definition: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 4.

name: anterior limb of ceratobranchial 5 bone
definition: Process that is the anterior and medially directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 bone part of ceratobranchial 5 bone.

name: anterior limb of ceratobranchial 5 cartilage
definition: Process that is the anterior and medially directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 cartilage.

name: pterotic-posttemporal-supracleithrum
definition: Bone that is a fusion of the pterotic, posttemporal, and supracleithrum bones.

name: hypomaxilla
definition: Dermal bone bearing teeth located between the distal end of the premaxilla and the middle of the maxilla. The hypomaxilla is a paired bone.

name: ascending process of the parasphenoid
definition: Process that is the lateral projection of the parasphenoid arising and articulating with the more dorsal portions of the neurocranium, usually at the level of the prootic.

name: dermethmoid
definition: Dermal bone of the dorsal surface of the olfactory region. Dermethmoid can be paired or median.

name: second preethmoid bone
definition: Endochondral bone found between the preethmoid and maxilla.

name: mental barbel
definition: Barbel that originates on the chin.

name: pectoral fin proximal radial bone 1
definition: Pectoral fin proximal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: pectoral fin proximal radial bone 2
definition: Pectoral fin proximal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: pectoral fin proximal radial bone 3
definition: Pectoral fin proximal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: pectoral fin proximal radial bone 4
definition: Pectoral fin proximal radial 4 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: ventral keel of coracoid
definition: Process on the ventral surface of the horizontal limb of the coracoid, close to and parallel to the coracoid-cleithrum joint. Ventral keel of coracoid is paired.

name: orbital foramen
definition: Foramen in the bone or cartilage comprising the anterior wall of the orbit, and through which passes at least the deep ophthalmic branch of cranial nerve V (trigeminal).

name: lateral ethmoid-frontal joint
definition: Joint that articulates the lateral ethmoid and frontal. lateral ethmoid-frontal joint is paired.

name: prootic-pterosphenoid joint
definition: Joint that articulates the prootic and pterosphenoid. prootic-pterosphenoid joint is paired.

name: prootic-exoccipital joint
definition: Joint that articulates the prootic and exoccipital. Prootic-exoccipital joint is paired.

name: basioccipital-exoccipital joint
definition: Joint that articulates the basioccipital and exoccipital. Basioccipital-exoccipital joint is paired.

name: dilatator fossa
definition: Fossa located on the neurocranium that is formed from portions of the sphenotic, frontal and pterotic bones.

name: inter-coracoid joint
definition: Joint between the right and left coracoid bones of the pectoral girdle.

name: parapophysis 6
definition: Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the sixth centrum.

name: parapophysis 5
definition: Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the fifth centrum.

name: posterior limb of parapophysis 4
definition: Process that arises and projects posterolaterally from parapophysis 4. Posterior limb of parapophysis 4 is bilaterally paired.
synonyms_exact: posterior branch of parapophysis 4|posterior wing of parapophysis 4

name: anterior limb of parapophysis 4
definition: Process that arises and projects anterolaterally from parapophysis 4. Anterior limb of parapophysis 4 is bilaterally paired.
synonyms_exact: anterior branch of parapophysis 4|anterior wing of parapophysis 4|Mullerian ramus|Müllerian ramus

name: scale circulus
definition: Fine ridge on surface of scale, often parallel to the circumference of scale.

name: prootic depression
definition: Shallow area that exists on the prootic.

name: bony plate
definition: Dermal bone that is located on or subjacent to the surface anywhere on the body and that is not part of the general complement of scales, dermal bone of the dermatocranium, postcranial axial skeleton or paired fin skeleton. Bony plate may exist singly, or as unpaired or paired clusters or series.

name: vertebra 5-vertebra 6 joint
definition: Joint between the centra, and sometimes the neural arches or parapophyses.

name: vertebra 6 - vertebra 7 joint
definition: Joint between the centra, and sometimes the neural arches or parapophyses of vertebra 6 and vertebra 7.

name: gill opening
definition: Anatomical space that is the external opening of a gill slit connecting the pharyngeal cavity to the exterior. Gill opening is usually paired and located on the lateral or ventral surfaces of the head.

name: Weberian complex centrum
definition: Centrum that is the fusion of centra 2-4.

name: predorsal vertebra
definition: Vertebra that is positioned between the vertebra immediately anterior to the first dorsal-fin pterygiophore to the anteriormost vertebra.

name: branched caudal fin ray
definition: Caudal fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched.

name: nuchal plate series
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one type of nuchal plate in an individual.

name: uroneural 1
definition: Uroneural that is the anteriormost element of the uroneural series.

name: ural centrum 1
definition: A vertebral centrum that is immediately posterior to preural vertebra 1. Ural centrum 1 is an unpaired median bone.

name: auditory fenestra
definition: Opening in the neurocranium to allow communication between the swimbladder and the inner ear.

name: upper hypural set
definition: Anatomical cluster including hypural 3 and more dorsal hypurals that supports the dorsal series of principal caudal lepidotrichia or rays. The upper hypural set articulates or fuses to ural centra 3, 4 or 5 (polyural terminology) or ural centrum 2 (diural terminology) depending on the teleost subgroup. The upper hypural set is composed of unpaired median bones.

name: lower hypural set
definition: Anatomical cluster including hypurals 1 and 2 that supports part of the ventral principal caudal lepidotrichia or rays and that separates from the dorsal hypural set through the hypural diastema. The lower hypural set articulates or fuses to ural centra 1 and 2 (polyural terminology) or ural centrum 1 (diural terminology) depending on the teleost subgroup. The lower hypural set is composed of unpaired median bones.

name: distal cartilage of posterior process of basipterygium
definition: Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal margin or tip of posterior process of basipterygium and projects posteriorly.

name: internal anterior process of basipterygium
definition: Process that is bony and arises from anteromedial corner of basipterygium and projects anteriorly or anteromedially.
synonyms_exact: internal anterior arm of basipterygium|internal arm of the basipterygium|mesial anterior arm of basipterygium|mesial anterior process of basipterygium

name: distal cartilage of internal anterior process of basipterygium
definition: Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal tip of internal anterior process of basipterygium.

name: middle anterior process of basipterygium
definition: Process that is bony and arises from anterior margin of basipterygium between internal anterior process of basipterygium and external anterior process of basipterygium. Middle anterior process of basipterygium projects anteriorly or anteromedially.

name: distal cartilage of middle anterior process of basipterygium
definition: Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal tip of middle anterior process of basipterygium.

name: external anterior process of basipterygium
definition: Process that is bony and arises from anterolateral corner of basipterygium and projects anteriorly or anteromedially.
synonyms_exact: external anterior arm of basipterygium|external arm of basipterygium|lateral anterior process of basipterygium|lateral pelvic process

name: distal cartilage of external anterior process of basipterygium
definition: Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal tip of external anterior process of basipterygium.

name: lateral process of basipterygium
definition: Process that is bony and arises from lateral margin of basipterygium lateral to pelvic fin lepidotrichium 1 and projects laterally or anterolaterally.

name: lateropterygium
definition: Bone that is attached or adjacent to lateral margin of basipterygium and anterior to pelvic fin lepidotrichium 1. The lateropterygium is a paired bone.

name: hypural plate
definition: Perichondrally ossified bone that results from the fusion of two or more hypurals and support a variable number of principal caudal lepidotrichia. The hypural plate is an unpaired median bone.

name: leptocephalous larva
definition: Larval stage in some teleosts before metomorphosis.

name: spina occipitalis
definition: Process that is a ventral projection from the supraoccipital that extends between the exoccipitals to the dorsal margin of the foramen magnum.

name: basal fulcrum
definition: Fulcrum that is large, laterally expanded, paired or unpaired, scale-like, and that precedes the base of a fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

name: fringing fulcrum
definition: Fulcrum that is a small, paired dermal structure associated with the marginal, leading rays of paired and/or unpaired fins. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

name: pleurostyle
definition: Postero-dorsal process of preural vertebra 1 or postero-dorsal process of the compound terminal centrum. The pleurostyle is a paired membrane bone.

name: ural centrum
definition: A vertebral centrum that is posterior to preural vertebra 1 and consequently the most posterior vertebral centra. Ural centrum is a unpaired median bone.

name: pelvic axillary process
definition: Anatomical cluster consisting of only a bony element or a combination of a bony element and one or more scales, or only modified scales, which lies in a fin fold at the base of the uppermost ray.

name: pectoral axillary process
definition: Pectoral axillary process is an elongate structure formed by one or more additional postcleithra or modified scales or a combination of both, that is firmly attached to a skin fold above the articular condyle of the uppermost pectoral fin ray or lepidotrichium 1.

name: interhaemal bone
definition: A small bone articulating distally with the haemal arch or a short haemal spine.

name: gular plate
definition: Dermal bone located on the ventral surface of the skull and positioned between the two rami of the lower jaw. Anteriorly the gular attaches to the symphysis of the lower jaw through fibrous connective tissue. The gular is an unpaired median bone.

name: median caudal cartilage
definition: Cartilage associated with hypurals.

name: rostral cartilage
definition: Median chondrified cartilage bound to premaxillary ascending process by a rostro-premaxilla ligament.

name: dorsal fin pterygiophore 1
definition: Dorsal fin pterygiophore that is the anteriormost pterygiophore of the dorsal fin.

name: ventromedial opening of posttemporal fossa
definition: A third opening of the posttemporal fossa posteriorly located relative to the fossa. It is bordered completely by the epiocciptial, or by both the epioccipital and exoccipital.

name: bony plate series
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one bony plate in an individual.

name: sensory canal pore series
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one sensory canal pore.

name: lateral line scale series
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one lateral line scale.

name: branchiostegal ray series
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of the branchiostegal rays within an individual.

name: epibranchial series
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of the epibranchial elements within an individual.

name: ceratobranchial series
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of the ceratobranchial elements within an individual.

name: electrosensory lateral line lobe
definition: Anatomical structure located in the hindbrain that receives primary electroreceptor input.

name: eminentia granularis
definition: Anatomical structure that is a subdivision of the cerebellum; it is the location of some lateral line nerve synapses.

name: medullary command nucleus
definition: Anatomical structure that consists of two neuron types: pacemaker cells and relay cells. The medullary command nucleus commands the timing of the electric organ discharge.

name: buccal papilla
definition: Papilla that is part of the mouth.

name: cotylephore
definition: Multi-tissue structure that is a transient outgrowth of tissue on skin brooding fish that acts as an attachment site for embryos.

name: ovipositor
definition: Organ that functions in egg deposition.

name: scale radius
definition: Erosion channel that radiates out from the growth center (focus) of the scale across and through the circuli.

name: pouch scale
definition: Scale that forms part of the posterior border of the caudal-fin organ. Pouch scales are usually hypertrophied.

name: nuptial tubercle
definition: Surface structure that is a small protuberance on the surface of the body. Nuptial tubercles primarily function to facilitate contact between individuals for breeding.

name: caudal-fin organ
definition: Organ that consists of a pouch located on the ventral caudal-fin lobe, opening posteriorly, and composed of glandular tissue. The caudal-fin organ presumably functions to secrete pheromones during courtship.

name: caudal-fin ray pump
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of thickened caudal-fin rays modified into a pumping mechanism associated with the caudal-fin organ.

name: myorhabdoid bone
definition: Intermuscular bone that is located in the dorsal and ventral forward flexures of the myoseptum.

name: caudal rod
definition: Multi-tissue structure that is a cartilaginous or collagenous bar supporting the caudal appendage.

name: caudal appendage
definition: Multi-tissue structure that is region of the body posterior to the last anal-fin ray.

name: dorsal organ
definition: Surface structure that is a midsaggital strap of flattened ectodermal tissue extending along the posterodorsal midline.

name: annular ligament
definition: Ligament that is in the eye and is located at the angle between the cornea and the iris.

name: anterior swim bladder bud
definition: Portion of tissue that forms from the swim bladder epithelium at the anterior end of the swim bladder.

name: vertebral element 9
definition: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 8.

name: vertebral element 10
definition: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 9.

name: vertebral element 11
definition: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 10.

name: vertebral element 12
definition: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 11. May have hemal arch and rib.

name: opercular cavity
definition: Anatomical space which is located beneath the operculum and external to the gills.

name: caudal basal fulcrum
definition: Basal fulcrum that precedes a caudal fin lobe. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

name: ural centrum 3
definition: A vertebral centrum that is located immediately posterior to ural centrum 2 (polyural terminology). Ural centrum 3 articulates with hypural 3 ventrally. Ural centrum 3 is an unpaired median bone.

name: ural centrum 4
definition: A vertebral centrum that is located immediately posterior to ural centrum 3 (polyural terminology) and may fuse to ural centrum 3 early in ontogeny. Ural centrum 4 articulates with hypural 4 ventrally. Ural centrum 4 is an unpaired median bone.

name: ural vertebra
definition: Vertebra that is incomplete or rudimentary and may bear a rudimentary neural arch and sometimes a rudimentary spine or the neural arch and spine are completely absent. Ural vertebrae are one of the last bony elements of the vertebral column, usually smaller than the preural centra. Ural vertebrae are numbered beginning from anterior (1) to posterior (2, 3, 4, etc.). Ural vertebra is an unpaired median bone.

name: ural vertebra 1
definition: Ural vertebra that is located directly posterior to preural centrum 1. It may bear a rudimentary neural arch and sometimes a rudimentary spine or the neural arch and spine are completely absent and it may articulate or fuse with hypural 1 (polyural terminology). Ural vertebra 1 is an unpaired median bone.

name: caudal principal ray set
definition: Anatomical cluster including all segmented-and-branched rays plus one unbranched but segmented ray located at the leading margin in each lobe of the caudal fin (Hubbs and Lagler, 1947) and that associates with endoskeletal elements such as hypurals and hemal spines of preural centra 1 and 2 (Arratia, 2008). Caudal principal rays are counted from the dorsalmost one ventrally. Caudal principal rays are unpaired median bones.

name: caudal procurrent ray set
definition: An anatomical cluster of short rays, shorter than the principal ones, which form the anterior dorsal and ventral series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin that may be associated with neural spines, epurals and uroneurals (dorsal series) and haemal spines of preural vertebrae (ventral series) (Arratia, 2008). The anteriormost procurrent rays are commonly unsegmented, but the posteriormost ones are usually segmented. The procurrent rays are numbered from caudal to rostral direction. The caudal procurrent ray series is an unpaired median series.
synonyms_exact: caudal precurrent rays|caudal spiny rays|rudimentary rays

name: pseudourostyle
definition: An elongate lateral process ventrally placed to the proximal region of the pleurostyle. The pseudourostyle is paired.

name: stegural
definition: Modified neural arch, probably of ural centrum 4, formed by a bony base that may extend along the dorso-lateral surfaces of ural centra and preural centra 1 or 2 and by a well-developed antero-dorsal membranous projection that extends lateral to the base of epural(s) and anterior toward the neural arches and/or spines of preural centra 1 or 2 (Arratia and Schultze, 1992). The stegural is a paired bone.

name: preural centrum 1 + ural centrum 1 + ural centrum 2
definition: Urostyle that is the result of fusion of preural centrum 1 with ural centra 1 and 2.

name: octaval nerve motor nucleus
definition: Hindbrain nucleus which consists of cell bodies whose axons exit the hindbrain via cranial nerve VIII and innervate hair cells of the lateral line and inner ear. The neurons of these nuclei are unusual in that they extend both contra- and ipsilateral dendrites.

name: rostral octaval nerve motor nucleus
synonyms_exact: ROLE|rostral cranial nerve VIII motor nucleus

name: climbing fiber
definition: Portion of tissue that consists of afferent axons from the inferior olive and synapsing with Purkinje cells within the molecular layer of the valvula cerebelli and corpus cerebelli.

name: dorsolateral motor nucleus of vagal nerve
definition: Motor nucleus of vagal nerve that is located within the dorsolateral portion of rhomobomere 8.

name: dorsolateral septum
definition: Portion of tissue that grows in from the dorsolateral wall of the otic vesicle, forming a dorsolateral partition between the developing anterior and posterior semicircular canals.

name: epidermal placode
definition: Portion of tissue that is a thickening and reshaping of the epidermal basal stratum cells beneath which fibroblasts accumulate to form the scale primordium.

name: hypobranchial muscle
definition: Head muscle that originates on the anterior region of the cleithrum and inserts on the urohyal. The hypobranchial forms initially as left and right parts that later fuse together forming a cone shape.

name: intermediate nucleus
definition: Diencephalic nucleus which is located between the dorsal hypothalamus and the caudal tuberal nucleus and does not contain tyrosine hydroxylase immunoreactive cells.

name: medial motor nucleus of vagal nerve
parallel fiber, teleost
definition: A parallel fiber results from the axon of a cerebellar granule cell ascending through the molecular layer where it does not bifurcate and synapses on the dendritic branches of Purkinje cells and stellate cells. The parallel fibers in teleost fish do not bifurcate in contrast to other vertebrates.

name: preglomerular nucleus
definition: Diencephalic nucleus which is located in the caudal tuberculum. The preglomerular nuclei make up most of the migrated nuclei within the caudal tuberculum. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.

name: presumptive cardiac ventricle primitive heart tube
supratemporal commissure
definition: Lateral line canal that that crosses the supratemporal region posterior to the openings of the endolymphatic ducts and connects the lateral canals of each side.

name: ocular side
definition: Organism subdivision that is the side of the body possessing eyes.

name: blind side
definition: Organism subdivision that is the side of the body lacking eyes.

name: premaxillary-maxillary joint
definition: Joint that articulates the premaxilla and maxilla. Premaxillary-maxillary joint is paired.

name: interarcual cartilage
definition: Pharyngeal arch cartilage located between uncinate process of epibranchial 1 and pharyngobranchial 2.

name: ctenoid scale
definition: Scale that possesses cteni (discrete spines).

name: transforming ctenoid scale
definition: Ctenoid scale with two or three alternating rows of cteni marginally and truncated cteni submarginally. (Roberts 1993).

name: Jakubowski's organ
definition: Neuromast of the supraorbital sensory canal in the nasal bone. It is innervated by the buccal nerve rather than by the supraorbital nerve, which invariably innervates neuromasts of the supraorbital canal. (Johnson and Patterson 1993).

name: pectoral fin distal radial bone 1
definition: Pectoral fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: pectoral fin distal radial bone 2
definition: Pectoral fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: pectoral fin distal radial bone 3
definition: Pectoral fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: preopercle-opercle joint
definition: Joint that articulates the preopercle and opercle. Preopercle-opercle joint is paired.

name: body marking
definition: Surface structure that is a visible mark on the body resulting from pigmentation.

name: cycloid scale
definition: Scale that is smooth-edged, round or oval and composed of acellular dermal bone lacking small spines on the posterior exposed edge. (from http://www.briancoad.com/Dictionary/introduction.htm).

name: fulcrum
definition: Dermal bone that is typically associated with a fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

name: epaxial basal fulcrum
definition: Basal fulcrum that is positioned at the dorsal or anterodorsal margin of the caudal fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

name: hypaxial basal fulcrum
definition: Basal fulcrum that is positioned at the anteroventral margin of the caudal fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.
synonyms_exact: hypaxial basal fulcra|ventral basal fulcra|ventral basal fulcrum

name: fish scute
definition: Dermal bone that is an unpaired, scale-like structure. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

name: mid cerebral vein
definition: The mesencephalic veins (MsV) enter the mid cerebral veins (MCeV) at the dorsal midline. THe MCeVs originate at the dorsal midline, proceede lateraly in a ventral direction to drain into the paired primordial midbrain channels (PHBC). ogai et al. 2001., Kimmel et al. 1993.

name: pseudobranchial artery
definition: A vascular loop attached to the efferent part of the mandibular arch that forms at 3.5 dpf. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: concurrent branch afferent branchial artery
definition: The branch of the afferent branchial artery that continues posteriodorsally. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: recurrent branch afferent branchial artery
definition: The anterioventral proceeding branch of the afferent branchial artery. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: primordial midbrain channel
definition: The vessel between the anterior cerebral vein and the mid cerebral vein. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: central artery
definition: Arteries that irrigate the forebrain and midbrain Isogai et al. 2001.

name: cerebellar central artery
definition: Extend upward from the PCS, branch to provide an arterial feed to the hindbrain, then drain back down into the PHBC Isogai et al. 2001.

name: opercular artery
definition: The opercular artery arises from the hyoid stump on the first aortic arch, then follows the lateral margin of the operculum (gill covering) ventrally to reconnect into the proximal part of the first aortic arch. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: dorsal longitudinal anastomotic vessel
definition: Trunk vessel that connects to the primitive hindbrain channel and the basilar artery at the caudal end of the medulla oblongata. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: primary head sinus
definition: Main route for venous drainage of the anterior and mid cerebral veins as well as portions of the primordial hindbrain channel. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: posterior cerebral vein
definition: Vein that drains the dorsal longitudinal vessel and the caudal portions of the venous capillary network of the medulla oblongata. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: rostral blood island
definition: Hematopoietic tissue derived from the cephalic mesoderm. Predominantly produces myeloid cells. de Jong and Zon 2005.

name: dorsal longitudinal vein
definition: Vessel that connects to the primitive hindbrain channel and the basilar artery at the caudal end of the medulla oblongata. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: optic vein
definition: Vein that connects to the hyaloid vein that drains the eye. External to eye. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: parachordal vessel
definition: Vessels run longitudinally along the horizontal myoseptum. These vessels are not functional until after lumenization which occurs near 4 dpf. Isogai et al. 2003.

name: supraintestinal artery
definition: A continuation of the anterior mesenteric artery, which branches out from the dorsal aorta just caudal to the pronephric glomus. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: optic artery
definition: The artery that carries blood to the eye. It branches from the internal carotid artery and enters the eye ventrally through the optic fissure. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: primitive prosencephalic artery
definition: Vessel that branches from cranial division of the internal carotid artery, extending laterally around the rostral end of the head. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: prosencephalic artery
definition: After the primitive prosencephalic artery forms it becomes disconnected from the cranial division of the internal carotid artery and instead it connects to the anterior mesencephalic central artery and the communicating vessels of the palatocerebral artery.

name: palatocerebral artery
definition: The PLA branches ventrally from the CrDI. It extends rostrally along the base of mid- and forebrain, then loops medially and links to the corresponding vessel from the other side of the embryo. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: communicating vessel palatocerebral artery
definition: Connect the palatocerebral artery with the prosencephalic artery. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: anterior mesencephalic central artery
definition: Arteries that irrigate rostral regions of the midbrain. They extend between the Basial communicating artery to the anterior cerebral vein. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: median palatocerebral vein
definition: Drains the PLA loop proceeds straight caudally along the cranial midline just above the pharynx, just below the diencephalon. Forms a 'T' with the palatocerebral veins. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: palatocerebral vein
definition: Vein that drains the median palatocerebral vein into the optic vein. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: bulbus arteriosus outer layer
definition: Composed of scattered layers of interrupted elastic lamina. Hu et al. 2001.

name: bulbus arteriosus middle layer
definition: Composed of 7-10 layers of helically arranged smooth muscle cells surrounded by a fine network of collagen, reticular, and elastic fibrils. Hu et al. 2001.

name: bulbus arteriosus inner layer
definition: Composed of subendothelium with longitudinally oriented collagen, reticular fibrils, elastic fibers, and smooth muscle cells bound by a thin endothelial layer. Hu et al. 2001.

name: central cardiac conduction system
definition: Cardiac conduction system, characterized by slow impulse propagation and prolonged refractory periods.

name: peripheral cardiac conduction system
definition: Portion of the cardiac conduction system, with rapid impulse propagation.

name: middle mesencephalic central artery
definition: Project rostrally and dorsally from the AMCtA to to irrigate the midportion of the midbrain Isogai et al. 2001.

name: posterior mesencephalic central artery
definition: Project dorsally from BCA to irrigate the caudal part of midbrain Isogai et al. 2001.

name: anterior mesenteric artery
definition: Unpaired artery departing from dorsal aorta, typically supplying the small intestine.

name: metencephalic artery
definition: These arteies branch dorsally from both sides of the posterior communicating artery looping up to join with the opposite MtA as well as with both middle cerebral veins at the dorsal midline of the head. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: nasal artery
definition: The nasal arteries start at the internal carotid artey and travel rostrally, passing along the right and left walls of the nasal sac at the most rostral end of the head. From the nasal sac, the NA flows into the nasal veins. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: posterior mesenteric artery
definition: Unpaired artery departing from dorsal aorta that typically supplies the large intestine.

name: swim bladder artery
definition: An elaborate set of vessels that branche off caudally from the anterior mesenteric artery just after the dorsal aorta. The SBA vascular loops are located on the ventral side of the swim bladder. Isogai et al. 2001.

name: central ray artery
definition: Positioned in the intraray mesenchym between the hemirays of the lepidotrichia,. Huang et al. 2003.

name: ray vein
definition: Lie flanking and just lateral to the fin ray, in the interray mesenchyme. Huang et al. 2003.

name: intervessel commissure
definition: Vessels that travel between artery and veins or vein and vein in a single ray.

name: interray vessel
definition: Vessels that travel between veins in adjacent rays.

name: dorsal lateral line neuromast
definition: Neuromast that is part of the dorsal lateral line. Kimmel et al, 1995. (Also see Anatomical Atlas entry for lateral line by T. Whitfield.).

name: primary posterior lateral line primordium
definition: Primordium that forms the first neuromasts of the posterior lateral line. This primordium travels at 1.5-1.7 somites/hour and deposits neuromast that are polarized along the antero-posterior axis.

name: secondary posterior lateral line primordium
definition: Second lateral line primordium. These primordia moves at 0.2 somites/hour and deposite neromasts that are polarized in a dorso-ventral direction.

name: anterior lateral line primordium
definition: A migrating group of cells originating from an anterior lateral line placode. The primordium deposits neuromasts and interneuromasts between them during its migration.

name: middle lateral line primordium
definition: A migrating group of cells originating from the middle lateral line placode. The primordium deposits neuromasts with interneuromasts between them.

name: barbel primordium
definition: A surface structure that will eventually grow to form a barbel. The primordium is rich in taste buds. The final location for taste buds present in the primordium is the distal tip of the mature barbel.

name: intestinal bulb epithelium
definition: Intestinal epithelium which lines the lumen of the intestinal bulb.

name: primary dental epithelium
definition: Epithelium that surrounds a primary tooth. This epithelium is committed to formation of replacement teeth.

name: ampullary nerve
definition: A branch of the 8th cranial nerve that innervates the cristae ampullaris.

name: distal epidermal cap of regenerating fin/limb
definition: Part of regeneration epithelium at the tip of the fin/limb [ZFA,modified].

name: basal regeneration epithelium of regenerating fin/limb
definition: Layer of the wound epidermis that surrounds the blastema in the fin or limb[ZFA,modified].

name: extrahepatic duct
definition: Bile duct that collects from the intrahepatic ducts and feeds into the common bile duct.

name: ventral liver lobe
definition: Portion of the liver which develops on the fish's ventral side.

name: choroid plexus vascular circuit
definition: Cranial vasculature where the posterior cerebral veins and the trans-choroid plexus branch form a circuit around the 4th ventricle choroid plexus.

name: median fin radial bone
definition: Median fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: median fin proximal radial bone
definition: Median fin proximal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

name: inter-parietal joint
definition: Fibrous joint connecting the parietal bones.

name: intervillus pockets
definition: A portion of tissue formed between the base of the intestinal villi that is part of the intestinal epithelium where intestinal stem cells are located. In the intestine no crypts are present, but, the regions between the villi, the intervillus pockets, have a crypt-like function. Cells are produced in the intervillus pockets and shed from the villus tips.

name: continuous capillary
definition: Capillary that has endothelial cells that provide an uninterrupted lining, and only allow small molecules, like water and ions to diffuse through tight junctions which leave gaps of unjoined membrane which are called intercellular clefts.
synonyms_exact: continuous blood vessel endothelium|continuous capillary vessel

name: fenestrated capillary
definition: Capillary that has pores in the endothelial cells (60-80 nm in diameter) that are spanned by a diaphragm of radially oriented fibrils and allow small molecules and limited amounts of protein to diffuse.

name: hyomandibula-opercle joint
definition: Synovial joint that articulates the hyomandibula and the opercle.

name: pterotic fossa
definition: Fossa on the pterotic where the hyomandibula articulates.

name: erector muscle
definition: Muscle that moves parts of the body in a superior direction to an erect position. Antagonistic to depressor muscle.

name: preopercle horizontal limb-symplectic joint
definition: Joint that articulates the posterior edge of the preopercle horizontal limb with the symplectic.

name: hypophyseal fenestra
definition: Space enclosed by the trabeculae cranii. The anterior tip of the notochord extends into the posterior region of the hypophyseal fenestra.

name: depressor muscle
definition: A muscle that moves body parts into an inferior direction or lowered position. Antagonistic to erector muscle.

name: immature gonad
definition: Immature reproductive tissue that has not undergone final maturation into either testis or ovary. During gonadal development, the gonad may be transiently intersexual where there is a parallel presence of both oocytes and spermatocytes.

name: intestinal mucosal muscle
definition: A thin layer of smooth muscle immediately beneath the base of the villi which permits the intestinal mucosa to dynamically move and fold.

name: hyomandibular foramen
definition: Foramen in the hyomandibula that allows passage of the anterior lateral line nerve and the facial nerve (cranial nerve VII).

name: preopercle vertical limb-hyomandibula joint
definition: Joint that articulates the anterior edge of the preopercle vertical limb and the hyomandibula.

name: enteric circular muscle
definition: Smooth muscle of the enteric muscle system in which the cells are aligned perpendicular to the lumen of the gut.

name: distal late tubule
definition: Portion of the renal tubule which is just posterior to the distal early tubule.

name: pronephric glomerular capsule epithelium
definition: Simple squamous epithelium that lines the capsule of the pronephric glomerulus.

name: fin fold pectoral fin bud
definition: Fin fold of the pectoral fin bud, resulting from mesenchyme migration into the apical fold.

name: pectoral fin fold
definition: The functional webs of the paired fins. They arise as a consequence of apical fold (AER) expansion and of migration of the distal mesenchyme. The fin folds are delimited by a dorsal and a ventral striated epidermis. The cells of the epidermal basal stratum are positioned on a basement membrane. Directly beneath the basement membrane of each side there is an array of actinotrichs, fibers of the extracellular matrix which act as supportive elements of the larval fin folds.

name: posterior recess
definition: Posterior protrusion of the third ventricle.

name: endohypothalamic tract
definition: CNS white matter, axonal tract interconnecting catecholaminergic cell groups in the posterior tuberculum and hypothalamus.

name: extrapancreatic duct
definition: Portion of the pancreatic duct, external to the pancreas body that connects the pancreas with the hepatopancreatic ampulla.

name: pars superior ear
definition: The dorsal part of the ear. Comprises the three semicircular canals, which connect to the utricle.

name: pars inferior ear
definition: The ventral portion of the ear. It contains the saccule and the laguena which are the primary auditory organs.

name: transverse canal
definition: Duct that crosses the midline connecting the sacculi.

name: inner ear foramen
definition: Foramen in the inner ear.

name: dorso-rostral cluster
definition: Early-forming telencephalic neural cluster. Neurons of the dorso-rostral cluster (drc) extend axons to form the supra-optic tract (SOT) and the anterior commissure (AC). Ross et al., 1992.

name: ventro-rostral cluster
definition: Early-forming neural cluster located in the rostral diencephalon. At 19 h, axons arising from the vrc grow caudally to pioneer the tract of the postoptic commissure (TPOC). Ross et al., 1992.

name: ventro-caudal cluster
definition: Early-forming neural cluster of the ventral midbrain. At 16 h, axons of the vcc grow caudally to pioneer the medial longitudinal fasciculus (MLF), which is part of the larger ventral longitudinal tract (VLT). Later, neurons from this cluster project axons rostrally into the tract of the post-optic commissure (TPOC). Ross et al., 1992.

name: epiphysial cluster
definition: Early-developing neuronal cluster of the epiphysis. By 24 hpf the pioneer axon of the dorsoventral diencephalic tract (DVDT) has arisen from the ec and grown ventrally. As this axon encounters axons of the TPOC, it makes a near-90 rostral turn and grows rostrally among axons of the TPOC growing in the opposite direction. Ross et al., 1992.

name: hemal prezygapophysis
definition: Hemal prezygapophyses are paired, anteromedially directed processes arising from the bases of hemal arches, ligamentously joined to the hemal postzygapophyses of the preceding vertebra. Posterior caudal vertebrae close to the caudal fin lack hemal prezygopophyses.

name: preplacodal ectoderm
definition: Non neural ectoderm that surrounds the presumptive neural plate and gives rise to neurogenic placodes.

name: hyohyoideus
definition: Is a hyoid muscle that inserts at the most anterior basibranchial and also at the posterior ends of the ceratohyals and functions in jaw closure.

name: dorsal adductor hyomandibulae
definition: Is a hyoid muscle that attaches to the dorsomedial faces of the hyosymplectics.

name: pillar of the anterior semicircular canal
synonyms_exact: anterior hub of the semicircular canal|anterior pillar|anterior pillar of the semicircular canal

name: pillar of the lateral semicircular canal
synonyms_exact: lateral hub of the semicircular canal|ventral bar|ventral pillar|ventral piller of the semicircular canal

name: anal fin proximal radial element
definition: Rod-like internal median skeletal support elememts of the anal fin, which articulate with the distal radial elements.

name: radial element
definition: Radial elements are the internal skeletal supports of the median and paired fins.

name: pelvic fin radial element
definition: Pelvic fin radial elements are internal skeletal supports of the pelvic fin.

name: basipterygium element
definition: Endochondral element that is paired and supports the pelvic fin. The basipterygium has a posteromedial process called the ischiac process (Wietzman 1962).

name: anal fin distal radial element
definition: Rod-like internal median skeletal support elements of the anal fin, which articulate with the lepidotrichia distally.

name: dorsal fin distal radial element
definition: Rod-like internal median skeletal support elements of the dorsal fin, which articulate with the lepidotrichia distally.

name: dorsal fin proximal radial element
definition: Rod-like internal median skeletal support elements of the dorsal fin, which articulate with the distal radial elements.

name: pectoral fin radial element
definition: Pectoral fin radial elements are the internal skeletal supports of the pectoral fin which develop from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc, supports the pectoral lepidotrichia or fin rays and connects the lepidotrichia with the primary pectoral girdle.

name: pectoral fin proximal radial element
definition: Pectoral fin radial element which develops from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc, supports a few pectoral lepidotrichia or fin rays and connects the lepidotrichia and distal radial elements with the primary pectoral girdle (scapula and coracoid).

name: pectoral fin distal radial element
definition: Pectoral fin radial element that sometimes ossifies, develops from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc, and is located at the proximal region of a lepidotrichium, between its hemitrichia. Pectoral fin distal radial element is paired.

name: dorsal fin middle radial element
definition: Dorsal fin radial element that is the rod-like internal median skeletal support element of the dorsal fin located between the dorsal fin proximal radial element and dorsal fin distal radial element.

name: anal fin middle radial element
definition: Anal fin radial element that is the rod-like internal median skeletal support element of the anal fin located between the anal fin proximal radial element and anal fin distal radial element.

name: anal fin radial element
definition: Anal fin radial elements are internal skeletal supports of the anal fin.

name: dorsal fin radial element
definition: Dorsal fin radial elements are internal skeletal supports of the dorsal fin.

name: pectoral fin proximal radial element 1
definition: Pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

name: pectoral fin proximal radial element 2
definition: Pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the second most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

name: pectoral fin proximal radial element 3
definition: Pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the third most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

name: pectoral fin proximal radial element 4
definition: Pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the fourth most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

name: median fin radial element
definition: Radial element that is part of a median fin.

name: alary cartilage
definition: Paired, cup-shaped cartilage that are dorsal to the septomaxillae and anterior to the oblique cartilage. The anterior, convex face of each alary cartilage is synchondrotically fused to the superior prenasal cartilage and the ventral edge is fused to the superior margin of the crista intermedia.

name: alary process of premaxilla
definition: Dorsal process that extends toward the nasal bone. The posterior (inner) face of each alary process is concave and is invested dorsomedially by the superior prenasal cartilage and ventromedially by the inferior prenasal cartilage.

name: alveolar foramen
definition: Foramen for the R. alveolaris of Nerve VII and the alveolar artery.

name: angulosplenial coronoid process
definition: Point of insertion of the adductor mandibulae musculature.

name: anterior maxillary process
definition: Process that extends anteriorly from the planum triangulare and invests the medial face of the pars facialis of the maxilla.

name: anterior nasal wall
definition: Paired, vertical, and relatively straight plates that form the anterior limit of the nasal capsule.

name: anterior process of pars palatina of maxilla
anterior ramus of pterygoid
definition: In a triradiate pterygoid, the process that extends anteriorly towards the maxilla.

name: basal process of palatoquadrate
definition: Process that extends medially from the ventromedial corner of the palatoquadrate cartilage and articulates or fuses to the anterior wall of the otic capsule via the basitrabecular process.

name: basicranial fenestra
definition: Ventral opening of the neurocranium.

name: Bidder's organ
definition: Anatomical structure which forms from an enlargement of the anterior portion of each gonad in all male bufonid larvae and consists of ovarian tissues.

name: braincase and auditory apparatus
definition: The part of the skull that encloses the brain and surrounds the inner ear.

name: capsular process
definition: Narrow process of the skeletal support that projects forward.

name: cartilago ectochoanalis
definition: Lateral cartilaginous border of the fenestra endochoanalis.

name: cartilago orbitalis
definition: Lateral wall of chondrocranial braincase between lamina orbitonasalis and pila metoptica.

name: cavum inferius
definition: Accessory cavity located ventral to the cavum principale and cavum medius.

name: cavum medius
definition: Small accessory cavity located between the cavum principale and cavum inferius.

name: cavum principale
definition: The largest part of the nasal cavity, containing the olfactory epithelium.

name: hyale
definition: Anterior-lateral projections from the corpus of the hyoid apparatus.

name: crista contacta
definition: Thin, horizontal ridge that extends medially from the corpus of the septomaxilla; it lays on the lamina inferior.

name: crista intermedia
definition: Paired, oblique plates of cartilage located ventral to the alary cartilages. The dorsomedial margin of each crista intermedia is fused to the transitional zone between the septum nasi and the tectum nasi, whereas the ventrolateral margin bears two laminae, the lamina superior and the lamina inferior.

name: crista subnasalis
definition: Ventral crest of the paries nasi.

name: crista supraorbitalis
definition: Short and blunt process that extends posteriorly from the posteromedial margin of the postnasal wall, on the anterodorsal corner of the orbit above the medial orbitonasal foramen.

name: dilatatio alaris
definition: Flange that extends ventrally from about the middle portion of the margo mandibularis.

name: extremitas anterior
definition: Large anterior outgrowth of the septomaxilla that is directed into the space between the alary cartilage and the lamina inferior.

name: fenestra endochoanalis
definition: Opening on the ventral aspect of the nasal capsule. It contains the apertura nasalis interna.

name: fenestra endonarina communis
definition: Opening on the anterolateral aspect of the nasal capsule. It contains the apertura nasalis externa.

name: fenestra lateralis nasi
definition: Opening on the lateral side of the nasal capsule.

name: fenestra nasobasalis
definition: Small opening at the anterior tip of the nasal capsule, on the floor of the cavum inferius. It is located medially to the base of the inferior prenasal cartilage and serves for the passage of the ramus medialis narium and arteria orbitonasalis.

name: fenestra nasolateralis
definition: Elongated opening located on the lateral side of the nasal capsule.

name: fenestra prechoanalis
definition: Large opening of the nasal floor anterior to the fenestra endochoanalis.

name: footplate of pars media plectri
definition: Independent, horizontal bar of cartilage located on the anterior part of the fenestra ovalis in front of the pars interna plectri.

name: frontoparietal fontanelle
definition: Dorsal opening of the neurocranium.

name: hyolaryngeal complex
definition: Complex formed by two units, the hyoid and laryngeal apparatuses, which are both derived from the larval hyobranchial skeleton.

name: inferior prenasal cartilage
definition: Elongate cartilage that extends anteroventrally from the solum nasi to abut the ventral portion of the posterior aspect of the alary process of the premaxilla. It was first described by Wiedersheim in 1876.

name: infrarostral cartilage
definition: Larval lower jaw lies anterior to Meckels cartilage.

name: lamella alaris
definition: Dorsal plate of the squamosal.

name: lamina inferior
definition: Lateral expansion of the crista intermedia that serves as the floor of the cavum medium.

name: lamina nariochoanalis
definition: Free, dorsal margin of the lamina inferior.

name: lamina precerebralis
definition: Posterior face of septum nasi.

name: lamina superior
definition: Lateral expansion of the crista intermedia that serves as the roof of the cavum medium.

name: margo mandibularis of pterygoid
definition: Ventrally directed margin that connects the anterior and posterior rami of the pterygoid.

name: margo orbitalis of maxilla
definition: Dorsal margin of the maxilla between the frontal and zygomatico-maxillary processes.

name: margo orbitalis of pterygoid
definition: Margin that connects the anterior and medial rami of the pterygoid.

name: margo orbitalis of squamosal
definition: Anterior margin of the squamosal that takes part in the formation of the orbit.

name: margo tympanicus of pterygoid
definition: Margin that connects the posterior and medial rami of the pterygoid.

name: maxillopalatine
definition: A compound bone consisting of maxilla and palatine, can also contain a prefrontal and/or lacrimal; present in adult Gymnophiona.

name: medial orbitonasal foramen
definition: Opening on the postnasal wall for the medial branch (= ramus medialis nasi) of the ophthalmicus nerve.

name: medial ramus of pterygoid
definition: In a triradiate pterygoid, the process that extends medially towards the otic capsule.

name: median prenasal process
definition: Anterior projection of the septum nasi that protrudes through the anterior nasal wall.

name: nasopremaxilla
definition: A compound bone consisting of premaxilla, nasal and sometimes septomaxilla in adult members of Caeciliidae and Typhlonectidae.

name: oblique cartilage
definition: Semi-circular cartilaginous sheet that lies lateral to the side of the septum nasi.

name: orbitonasal foramen
definition: Foramen that forms a passage for one of the branches of the trigeminal nerve into the nasal region.

name: os basale
definition: A bone that forms both the floor of the braincase and the posterior part of the skull.

name: otic plate of pterygoid
definition: Osseous expansion of the posterior and medial rami of the pterygoid.

name: otic ramus of squamosal
definition: Ramus (process) that extends medially toward the otic capsule.

name: otoccipital
definition: Fused prootic and exoccipital bones.

name: palatine process of the pars facialis of the maxilla
paranasal commissure
definition: Cartilaginous bridge that extends posteriorly to the anterolateral corner of the posterior nasal wall.

name: cultriform process
definition: Process that extends anteriorly from the orbitotemporal region.

name: subotic alae
definition: Paired processes extending lateraly from the posterior body of the parasphenoid that, when present, support the otic capsules ventrally.

name: paries nasi
definition: Paired, elongate, ventrolaterally-orieted cartilaginous structures that extend to the premaxilla-maxilla articulation.

name: pars articularis of mandibular arch
definition: Posterior end of Meckel's cartilage that forms the articular head of the mandibular arch.

name: pars interna plectri
definition: Plate-like structure that lies in the fenestra ovalis. It arises within the membrana opercularis in the posterior part of the fenestra.

name: perilymphatic system
definition: Consists of enlarged cistern against which the operculum and footplate of the columella rest in the oval window. Together with the endolymphatic systems comprises the membranous labryinth of the inner ear. Duellman and Trueb 1994.

name: pila antoptica
definition: A strut of cartilage  extending dorsally from the basal plate and with other similar cartilages forming the sides of the brain case. The pila antoptica is posterior to pila metoptica together with which it may enclose the foramen for the ocular motor nerve and opthalmica magna artery.

name: pila metoptica
definition: A strut of cartilage  extending dorsally from the basal plate and with other similar cartilages forming the sides of the brain case. The pila metoptica is anterior to pila antoptica together with which it may enclose the foramen for the ocular motor nerve and opthalmica magna artery. Anterior to the pila antoptica is the pila preoptica (another pillar of cartilage) between these two cartilages emerges the optic and trochlear nerves.

name: planum terminale
definition: Vertical plate of cartilage that is fused posterodorsally to the oblique cartilage and anteriorly to the lamina inferior.

name: planum triangulare
definition: Cartilaginous, distal expansion of the lamina orbitonasalis that invests the pars facialis of the maxilla medially.

name: plectral apparatus
definition: Complex sound-conducting anatomical structure.

name: posterior maxillary process
definition: Process that extends posteriorly from the planum triangulare and invests the maxilla laterally and the anterior ramus of the pterygoid medially.

name: posterior ramus of pterygoid
definition: In a triradiate pterygoid, the process that extends posterolaterally towards the jaw articulation.

name: postnasal wall
definition: Paired, anteriorly concave structures that form the posterior limit of nasal capsule. It consists of two parts: a ventral piece, the lamina orbitonasalis, and a dorsal plate that is part of the tectum nasi.

name: prearticular coronoid process
definition: Point of insertion of the masticatory musculature.

name: preorbital process of the pars facialis of the maxilla
processus ascendens plectri
definition: Cartilaginous or ligamentous connection between the pars externa plectri and the crista parotica.

name: processus infrafenestralis
definition: Posterior part of the corpus of the septomaxilla; the posterior surface of the processus infrafenestralis is in contact with the oblique cartilage.

name: processus lingualis of pterygoid
definition: Dorsolateral process of the of the medial ramus of the pterygoid.

name: processus posterior of maxilla
definition: Posterior, toothless portion of the maxilla by which it usually comes in contact with the quadratojugal.

name: processus pterygoideus of maxilla
definition: Posterior end of the pars palatina of the maxilla that is in contact with the anterior ramus of the pterygoid.

name: processus zygomatico-maxillaris
definition: Posterodorsal extension of the maxilla by which it establishes contact with the squamosal.

name: pseudodentary
definition: Compound bone of adult Gymnophiona, consisting of dentary, coronoid and mentomeckelian.

name: pterygoid process of palatoquadrate
definition: Process that extends anteriorly from the anterolateral margin of the palatoquadrate and articulates or synchondrotically fuses to the posterior end of the posterior maxillary process.

name: recessus marsupiatus of premaxilla
definition: Is a recess on the surface of the premaxilla near to the base of the pars facialis.

name: recessus vaginiformis
definition: Is a space on the interior surface of the pars facialis of the maxilla.

name: retroarticular process
definition: Bony process that is part of the articular and is the point of insertion of the m. interhuoideus posterior.

name: rostral process
definition: Is a process of the nasal bone directed anteriorly towards the rostrum.

name: septum semicircularium anterior
