definition: The anterior connective tissue partition between walls of otic capsule around which the membranous semicircular canals pass.

name: septum semicircularium laterale
definition: The lateral connective tissue partition between walls of otic capsule around which the membranous semicircular canals pass.

name: septum semircularium posterior
definition: The posterior connective tissue partition between walls of otic capsule around which the membranous semicircular canals pass.

name: skeletal support for eminentia olfactoria
definition: Elevation of the dorsal surface of the solum nasi medial to the fenestra endochoanalis that provides support for the eminentia olfactoria.

name: solum nasi
definition: Unpaired, horizontal plate that forms the floor of the nasal capsule.

name: sphenethmoid
definition: Endochondral bone that forms the anterior portion of the braincase and forms from one ossification center on each side of the orbital cartilage.

name: sulcus dentalis of maxilla
definition: Groove located between the pars dentalis and the bases of the maxillary teeth.

name: sulcus dentalis of premaxilla
definition: Groove located between the pars dentalis and the bases of the premaxillary teeth.

name: sulcus for Meckels cartilage
definition: A groove on the palatoquadrate that is occupied by the Meckel's cartilage.

name: superior prenasal cartilage
definition: Paired, elongate cartilages that extend anteroventrally to abut the dorsomedial margin of the posterior face of the alary process of the premaxilla. The function of these cartilages is to transmit the movement of the premaxilla to the alary cartilages during the closure of the apertura nasalis externa.

name: suprasphenoid
definition: Endochondral ossification of the dorsomedial portion of the braincase.

name: taenia tecti marginalis
definition: Cartilaginous connection between the orbital cartilage and otic capsules.

name: tectum nasi
definition: Roof of the nasal capsule, confluent with lamina orbitonasalis posteriorly and united to septum nasi.

name: tympanosquamosal
definition: Central, funnel-shaped, ossified portion of the tympanic annulus fused to the squamosal bone.

name: ventral ramus of squamosal
definition: Longest of the three squamosal rami; it invests the dorsolateral margin of the palatoquadrate. The distal end of the ventral ramus invests the quadrate and articulates with the quadratojugal.

name: zygomatic ramus of squamosal
definition: Ramus (process) that projects anteriorly from the dorsal body of the squamosal and forms part of the posterior margin of the orbit.

name: arcus praeoccipitalis
definition: Skeletal structure that separates the inferior and superior perilymphatic foramina.

name: processus lingularis of nasal skeleton
definition: Rod-shaped process that extends caudally from the inferior edge of the planum terminale.

name: corpus
definition: Basal part of the septomaxilla.

name: margo libera
definition: Anterior, rounded portion of the corpus of the septomaxilla.

name: crista interna
definition: Sharp ridge that extends medially from the basal part of the processus infrafenestralis; it separates the diverticulum proncipale from the diverticulum medium.

name: crista praeopercularis
definition: Synchondrotic or synostotic connection between the footplate of the pars media plectri and the ventral margin of the fenestra ovalis.

name: anterior process of vomer
definition: Process that extends anterolaterally toward the maxilla-premaxilla articulation.

name: processus frontalis of maxilla
definition: Anterio portion of the maxilla that may contact the nasal and take part in the formation of a groove for the nasolacrimal duct.

name: lamina anterior of maxilla
definition: Most anterior part of the maxilla, which is in contact with the premaxilla.

name: fossa maxillaris
definition: Depression lacated on the inner surface of the maxilla between the palatine process and the pars palatina.

name: pars glenoidalis of quadratojugal
definition: Portion of the quadratojugal that makes contact dorsally with the distal portion of the squamosal.

name: pars jugalis
definition: Anterior part of the quadratojugal that is in contact with the processus posterior of the maxilla.

name: processus dorsalis of lamella alaris
definition: Dorsal process of the lamella alaris located at the anterior end of the margo orbitalis; a narrow ligament that runs from the frontoparietal is attached to it.

name: processus posterodorsalis of lamella alaris
definition: Posterior process of the lamella alaris.

name: dentigerous process
definition: Tooth-bearing process of the vomer.

name: prechoanal process
definition: Process that extends laterally from the anterior process; its bifurcation from the postchoanal process occurs at the level of the dentigerous process.

name: postchoanal process
definition: Process that extends laterally from the anterior process; its bifurcation from the prechoanal process occurs at the level of the dentigerous process.

name: margo choanalis
definition: Margin between the prechoanal and postchoanal process. It bounds the fenestra endochoanalis.

name: crista vomeri
definition: Ridge on the dorsal surface of the vomer that runs from the anterior to the postchoanal processes of the vomer; it takes part in the fixation of the bone to the lateral margin of the solum nasi.

name: processus posterior of parasphenoid
definition: Posterior projection of the median part of the parsphenoid, which may extend over the posterior margins of the subotic alae.

name: hyoid plate
definition: Azygous or paired bone that occurs on the ventral surface of the hyoid plate.

name: pars reuniens
definition: Area of fusion of the ceratohyals.

name: hyoglossal sinus
definition: Is the space along the anterior edge of the hyoid plate between the hyale and through which passes the hyoglossus muscle as it passes dorsally into the tongue.

name: anterolateral process of hyoid plate
definition: Processes that flank the hyales laterally and extend anterolaterally from the anterolateral margin of the hyoid plate. They are formed as a result of new cartilaginous growth lateral to the basibranchial.

name: posterolateral process
definition: Paired processes that extend posterolaterally from the posterolateral margin of the hyoid plate. These processes are formed as a result of new cartilaginous growth lateral to the basibranchial and hypobranchial plate.

name: posteromedial process
definition: Cartilaginous, paired processes that extend posterolaterally from the posterior margin of the hyoid plate. These processes invest the laryngeal apparatus and are ossified in the adult.

name: bronchial process
definition: Paired processes that extend posteroventrally from the anterolateral margins of the cricoid ring.

name: esophageal process
definition: Median process located on the posterior end of the cricoid cartilage.

name: manubrium of hyale
definition: Proximal section of the hyale.

name: sinus nervi hypoglossi
definition: Depression that houses the hypoglossus nerve and is located between the anterolateral process and the proximal part of the hyale.

name: foramen nervi hypoglossi
definition: Foramen that houses the hypoglossus nerve and is located between the anterolateral process and the proximal part of the hyale.

name: processus confluens
definition: Strip of cartilage that forms the lateral margin of the foramen nervi hypoglossi.

name: prominentia apicalis dorsalis
definition: Anterior end of the arytenoid cartilage.

name: prominentia apicalis ventralis
definition: Posterior (cardiac) end of the arytenoid cartilage.

name: pedicel
definition: Paired stalks located dorsolateral to the vertebral centrum that provide support to the lateral margins of the neural arch laminae.

name: atlantal cotyle
definition: Anterior, single or paired concave facets for articulation with the condyle(s) of the urostyle.

name: posterior intervertebral notch
definition: Indentation on the anterior margin of the pedicel. When two vertebrae articulate, the anterior notch of one vertebra and the posterior notch of the other create a bilateral intervertebral space.

name: intervertebral space
definition: Space formed by the anterior and posterior intervertebral notches. The intervertebral spaces accommodate the spinal nerves as they emerge from the spinal canal.

name: anterior intervertebral notch
definition: Indentation on the posterior margin of the pedicel. When two vertebrae articulate, the anterior notch of one vertebra and the posterior notch of the other create a bilateral intervertebral space.

name: pleurapophysis
definition: Paired processes that represent the rib attachments to the vertebra plus the ribs.

name: procoelous
definition: Holochordal vertebral centra that are concave anteriorly and convex posteriorly; they bear a condyle on the posterior end for the articulation with the posterior adjacent vertebral centrum, forming a ball-and-socket joint that allows extensive motion in most directions.

name: opisthocoelous
definition: Ectochordal or stegochordal vertebral centra that are convex anteriorly and concave posteriorly; they bear a condyle on the anterior end for the articulation with the posterior adjacent vertebral centrum, forming a ball-and-socket joint that allows extensive motion in most directions.

name: epichordal
definition: Vertebral centrum that originates from ossification of the dorsal portion of the perichordal tube; the resulting element tends to be depressed in cross section.

name: perichordal
definition: Vertebral centrum that originates from ossification of the entire perichordal tube; the resulting element is cylindrical in cross section and may have an open (notochord retained) or solid center.

name: heterocoelous
definition: Vertebral centrum that bears saddle-shaped articular surfaces at both ends, having a convexity in the right-left axis and a concavity in the dorsoventral axis. This morphology allows great lateral and vertical flexion.

name: acoelous
definition: Vertebral centrum with flat ends. Between successive vertebrae there is a fibrocartilaginous intervertebral body with a gel-like core, the nucleus pulposus, which is derived from the embryonic notochord. Acoelous vertebrae seem especially suited to receive and distribute compressive forces within the vertebral column.

name: amphicoelous
definition: Ectochordal, biconcave or terminally flat vertebral centrum. This design seems to allow limited motion in most directions. An intervertebral body (which may or may not be independent from the adjacent centra) fills the cavity between successive centra. The intervertebral body usually is formed by soft material that may be derived, at least in part, from the embryonic notochord.

name: ectochordal
definition: Spool-shaped vertebral centrum with an open center in which the notochord lies.

name: holochordal
definition: Spool-shaped vertebral centrum with a solid center. All traces of the notochord dissapear.

name: stegochordal
definition: Vertebral centrum that is depressed dorsoventrally and solid. All traces of the notochord dissapear.

name: haemal arch lamina
definition: Paired plates that form the haemal arch. The lateral margin of each lamina is firmly attached to the ventral surface of the caudal vertebral centrum and the medial end fuses to the medial end of the opposite lamina.

name: nucal keel
definition: Longitudinal process found in all cervical vertebrae, except the atlas, for the attachment of dorsal head musculature.

name: foramen nutritium
definition: Opening on the lateral side of the vertebra for the passage of blood vessels.

name: mid-dorsal keel
definition: Ridge-shaped structure present on the dorsomedial surface of the neural arch lamina; this structure is produced at the point of junction of the contralateral sides of each neural arch.

name: sacral condyle
definition: Anterior, paired convex facets for articulation with the cotyle(s) of the urostyle.

name: urostyle cotyle
definition: Anterior, single or paired concave facets for articulation with the sacral condyle(s).

name: webbing of bone in vertebral column
definition: In anurans, pair of bony plates that connect the posteromedial margins of the sacral diapophyses with the lateral margins of the anterior portion of the urostyle.

name: urostyle ridge
definition: Longitudinal crest on the dorsal side of the urostyle formed by the caudal neural arches.

name: suprascapula
definition: Paired, cartilaginous elements located in the dorsolateral shoulder region. Each suprascapula is a flat broad blade that extends medially.

name: pars acromialis
definition: Prominent structure (anteromedial head) that forms the anterior section of the ventral margin of the scapula.

name: pars glenoidalis of scapula
definition: Concave structure (posteromedial head) that forms the posterior head of the ventral margin of the scapula. The pars glenoidalis articulates with the humerus, and comprises the dorsal portion of the glenoid fossa.

name: crista dorsalis humeri
definition: Small hooked process on the dorsal aspect of the humeral shaft; it does not extend on to the glenoid head. The m subscapularis is inserted on it.

name: zonal area
definition: All those parts of the pectoral girdle ventral and medial to the glenoid fossa.

name: omosternum
definition: Proximal portion of the prezonal element of the pectoral girdle. It may be a flat, midventral cartilaginous structure or a calcified or bony element elaborated into a stylum.

name: epicoracoid
definition: Paired, flat cartilaginous arches that compose the central portion of the zonal area, unites the clavicle and coracoid of each half of the pectoral girdle, and form the medial margins of the pectoral fenestrae.

name: epicoracoid bridge
definition: A pair of cartilaginous expansions (one from each epicoracoid cartilage) that project anteriorly. They articulate anteriorly with the omosternum.

name: acetabular depression
definition: The central, most concave portion of the acetabulum, which remains open.

name: ilial ridge
definition: Longitudinal crest on the dorsal side of the shaft of the ilium.

name: ilial shaft
definition: Anterior rod that articulates with the sacrum.

name: glenoid foramen
definition: Opening on the glenoid fossa.

name: epicoracoid horn
definition: A pair of cartilaginous expansions (one from each epicoracoid cartilage) that project posteriorly. They articulate with the sternum by means of grooves, pouches or fossae in the dorsal surface of the sternum and provide a site for the insertion of a pair of muscles derived from the m. rectus abdominis.

name: supracoracoid foramen
definition: Opening on the scapulocoracoid bone through which passes the n. supracoracoideus and the corresponding artery and vein.

name: pectoral fenestra
definition: Ovoid space on the pectoral girdle limited anteriorly by the procoracoid, medially by the epicoracoid, and posteriorly by the coracoid.

name: incisura coracoidea
definition: Notch that separates the cartilaginous regions of the procoracoid and coracoid.

name: fovea capitis of humerus
definition: Ovoid roughened pit, which is situated a little below and behind the center of the head, and serves as a site of attachment for ligaments.

name: ulnar condyle
definition: Semi-elliptical ball located at the lower end of the humerus, adjacent to the humeral ball.

name: trochlear groove of humerus
definition: Furrow between the humeral head and the ulnar condyle.

name: fossa cubitalis ventralis
definition: Depresion on the distal end of the humerus, just anterior to the humeral head, in which the end of the radius fits when the forelimb is flexed.

name: collum antibrachii
definition: In a fused radio-ulna, the proximal portion of the compound bone (where the sulcus longitudinalis is barely evident or absent) is a cylindrical pillar.

name: anterior ramus of cleithrum
definition: Subdivision of the cleithrum that extends along the anterior edge of the suprascapula.

name: anomocoelous
definition: Stegochordal slightly biconcave or flat terminally vertebral centrum. Each intervertebral cartilage is subdivided anteriorly and posteriorly, producing a free intervertebral element between adjacent vertebrae. This element subsequently ossifies and remains free.

name: displasiocoelous
definition: Vertebral column in which the first seven vertebrae have holochordal centra and the intervertebral cartilages are posteriorly subdivided in the procoelous manner. The eighth presacral vertebra has a holochordal centrum and the intervertebral cartilage is subdivided in the opisthocoelous manner. Thus, the first seven presacral vertebrae are concave anteriorly and convex posteriorly, whereas the eighth is biconcave.

name: imbricate neural arch
definition: Overlapping neural arches that obscure the spinal cord dorsally.

name: non-imbricate neural arch
definition: Neural arches that do not overlap, thus exposing the spinal cord dorsally.

name: presacral shield
definition: Dorsal, dermal plate of bone that overlies the presacral vertebrae. Such shield usually has irregular, sculptured surfaces, frequently is broadly expanded, and may be composed of several separate plates.

name: cartilago paraglenoidalis
definition: Strip of cartilage that separates the coracoid from the scapula.

name: intercotylar space
definition: Space between the atlantal cotyles.

name: caput glenoidale
definition: Convex articular facet of the vertebral centrum for the articulation with the adjacent centrum.

name: fossa glenoidalis
definition: Concave articular facet of the vertebral centrum for the articulation with the adjacent centrum.

name: sulcus articularis lateralis
definition: In a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the lateral canal between the carina distalis and the carina medialis.

name: sulcus articularis medialis
definition: In a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the medial canal between the carina medialis and the carina proximalis.

name: carina proximalis
definition: In a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the proximal ridge.

name: carina medialis
definition: In a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the medial ridge.

name: carina distalis
definition: In a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the distal ridge.

name: parasagittal processes
definition: Paired, posteriorly directed process at the posterior margin of each neural arch lamina.

name: accessory articulation
definition: Paired, additional vertebral articulations located medial to the intervertebral space, adjacent to the vertebral centrum.

name: fissura sagittalis
definition: Medial groove in the longitudinal ridge of the urostyle formed by the incomplete dorsal fusion of the caudal neural arches.

name: glenoid end of clavicle
definition: Lateral end of the clavicle, which usually lies in close proximity to the pars acromialis of the scapula, and occassionally may fuse to it.

name: sulcus pro cartilagine praecoracoidealis
definition: Canal on the posterior aspect of the clavicle that accomodates the anterior margin of the procoracoid cartilage.

name: glenoid head of coracoid
definition: Lateral end of the coracoid, which forms the medial portion of the glenoid fossa.

name: sternal head of coracoid
definition: Medial end of the coracoid, which is synchondrotically fused to the epicoracoid cartilage.

name: margo fenestralis
definition: Anterior margin of the coracoid, which forms the posterior edge of the pectoral fenestra.

name: margo posterior
definition: Posterior margin of the coracoid.

name: margo anterior of scapula
definition: Anterior margin of the scapula.

name: margo clavicularis
definition: Inferior margin of the pars acromialis of the scapula, which articulates with the clavicule.

name: margo posterior of scapula
definition: Posterior margin of the scapula.

name: margo suprascapularis
definition: Superior margin of the scapula, which articulates with the suprascapula.

name: pars suprascapularis
definition: Superior portion of the scapula, which is thinner than the rest of the shaft.

name: sinus interglenoidalis
definition: Notch or indentation between the pars glenoidalis and pars acromialis of the scapula.

name: tenuitas cristaeformis
definition: Leading (anterior) portion of the scapula, which is thinner than the rest of the shaft.

name: crista longitudinalis scapula
definition: Longitudinal ridge on the medial (inner) face of the scapula.

name: margo anterior of cleithrum
definition: Anterior margin of the anterior ramus of the cleithrum.

name: margo posterior of cleithrum
definition: Posterior margin of the posterior ramus of the cleithrum.

name: margo scapularis
definition: Lateral margin of the suprascapula, which articulates with the scapula.

name: margo vertebralis
definition: Medial margin of the suprascapula, which lies dorsal to the vertebral column.

name: spina acromioidea
definition: Small process of the lamina recurvata that extends laterally toward the scapular-suprascapular articulation.

name: anterior lamina recurvata
definition: Portion of the anterior ramus of the cleithrum that invest the anterior margin of the suprascapula, extending onto its dorsal surface.

name: sinus dorsalis
definition: Notch or indentation between the anterior and posterior rami of the cleithrum.

name: posterior lamina recurvata
definition: Portion of the posterior ramus of the cleithrum that invests the posterior margin of the suprascapula, extending onto its dorsal surface.

name: crista lateralis humeri
definition: Ridge on the lateral aspect of the humeral shaft located just anterior to the radial (lateral) epicondyle.

name: crista medialis humeri
definition: Ridge on the medial aspect of the humeral shaft that extends from the level of the middle portion of the shaft to ulnar (medial) epicondyle.

name: crista radii
definition: Small ridge on the lateral aspect of the radial shaft, located at the level of the collum antibrachii.

name: capitulum of radius
definition: Lateral portion of the proximal (upper) articular surface of the radius that consists of an eminence with a rounded apex.

name: capitulum ulnae
definition: Small eminence on the distal articular head of the ulna.

name: sulcus longitudinalis
definition: In a fused radio-ulna, longitudinal furrow that demarcates the area of fusion of both elements. This sulcus is deep in the distal portion of the compound bone, but barely evident or absent at the proximal end.

name: element Y of fore mesopodium
definition: Oval carpal element that is located on the anteromedial side of the radiale and the anterolateral side of the ulnare. Anteriorly, it articulates with carpals 1 through 4 (or 2 through 5 according to some authors). It is also recognized as centrale by some authors. This element originates from one, two, or three condensation centers. Occasionally it may fuse to carpal 2(1), carpal 3(2), the ulnare, or other elements.

name: intercalary element of fore digit
definition: Small elements present in all digits of the manus, when present in a taxon. Each intercalary element articulates with the anteroventral end of the penultimate phalanx proximally and the distal phalanx distally.

name: foramen perforans carpi
definition: Opening for the passage of the perforans carpi artery from the ventral to the dorsal side. It perforates the compound ulnare + intermedium.

name: pubo-ischium
definition: Composite element formed by the fusion of the ischium and pubis.

name: epileon
definition: Dorsal extremity of the ilial shaft, which remains cartilaginous.

name: agger limitans anterior of ilium
definition: Shelf-like expansion of the ilial corpus that forms the anterior border of the acetabulum.

name: agger limitans anterior of ischium
definition: Shelf-like expansion of the ischium that forms the posterior border of the acetabulum.

name: ilial protuberance
definition: Small, dorsolaterally projecting knob located just anterior to the supra-acetabular expansion and about the level of the anterior border of the acetabulum.

name: preacetabular expansion
definition: Ventral portion of the ilial corpus, located anteroventral to the acetabulum.

name: fossula tuberis superioris
definition: Small depression dorsal to the proximal portion of the collum ilei and ventral to the ilial protuberance.

name: collum ilei
definition: Cyllindrical pillar that originates anterior to the acetabulum and extends to the ilial shaft.

name: pars cylindriformis ilei
definition: Elongate, cylindrical structure on the ventral side of the shaft of the ilium that extends through its entire length.

name: crista ischii
definition: Crest on the posterior side of the ischium, which may also extend to the posteroventral aspect of pubis.

name: spina pelvis posterior
definition: Small, rounded process on the anterodorsal margin of the ischium, just posterior to the area of articulation with the ilium.

name: spina pelvis anterior
definition: Small, rounded process on the anteroventral margin of the preacetabular expansion of the ilial corpus.

name: intumescentia bilateralis inferior
definition: Small protuberance on the ischium, located close to its posteroventral margin.

name: intumescentia bilateralis superior
definition: Small protuberance on the ischium, located at the level of the superior margin of the acetabulum and close to its posterior margin.

name: incisura terminalis
definition: Small indentation on the posterior margin of the ischium, ventral to the intumescentia bilateralis superior.

name: crista hypertrophica ischium
definition: Large protuberance on the dorsal aspect of the ischium that extends from the ischio-ilium articulation to the spina pelvis posterior.

name: interilial region
definition: Area of convergence of the ilial shafts. When the preacetabular ilium is narrow, the interilial configuration is V-shaped or narrowly rounded, whereas when the interilial region is broadly expanded the interilial configuration is U-shaped.

name: recessus coccygealis
definition: Area dorsal to the pelvic girdle symphysis, between the dorsal portions of the ilial corpora, where lies the posterior terminus of the urostyle.

name: epipubis
definition: Small prepubic element formed by a plate of cartilage (which may calcify in the adult) that is synchondrotically united with the pubis.

name: ypsiloid cartilage
definition: Y-shaped cartilage lying in the middle line, anterior to the pubo-ischium with which it articulates. It lies dorsal to the rectus abdominis muscle with which it articulates.

name: femoral ridge
definition: Low crest that arises just behind the acetabular head and extends distally for about one-third the length of the femoral shaft.

name: foveal depression
definition: Ovoid roughened pit situated on the dorsal and anteroventral surface of the acetabular head wherein the ligaments attaching the bone to the acetabulum are inserted.

name: trochanteric crest
definition: Paired ridges on the ventral surface of the femoral shaft that run toward the femoral trochanter; the posterior crest is less developed.

name: tibial crest
definition: Ridge that arises from the dorso-masial side of the extensor surface of the tibia. It receives the insertion of the tendon of the extensor ilio-tibialis muscle.

name: apophysis distalis of tibiofibula
definition: Swelling on the extensor surface of the distal head of the tibiofibula.

name: caput ossis cruris
definition: Proximal head of the tibiofibula that articulates with the distal head of the femur.

name: sulcus pro musculo extensori cruris brevis
definition: Small canal on the proximal head of to the tibiofibula, lateral to the apophysis distalis, for the insertion of the cruris brevis muscle.

name: eminentia arcuata
definition: Small crest on the extensor surface of the proximal head of the tibiofibula (tibial side).

name: sulcus distalis ossis cruris
definition: In a fused tibiofibula, longitudinal furrow in the distal portion of the compound bone that demarcates the area of fusion of both elements.

name: sulcus proximalis ossis cruris
definition: In a fused tibiofibula, longitudinal furrow in the proximal portion of the compound bone that demarcates the area of fusion of both elements.

name: foramen nutritium exterius
definition: Foramen for the tibial artery and vein and the deep peroneal nerve; it pierces through the midpoint of the shaft of the tibiofibula.

name: spatium intertarsale
definition: Separation of the tibiale and fibulare along their longitudinal axia.

name: apophysis proximalis
definition: Swelling on the extensor surface of the proximal compound head of the tibiale and fibulare.

name: apophysis distalis of tibiale fibulare
definition: Swelling on the extensor surface of the distal compound head of the tibiale and fibulare.

name: element Y of hind mesopodium
definition: Oval tarsal element that is located on the anteromedial side of the tibiale. Anteriorly, it articulates with the proximal prehallux, tarsals 1, 2, and 3.

name: prehallux skeleton
definition: One to three or four elements located ventral and medial to the metatarsal of digit I. When more than one elements are present, they are smaller than the proximal prehallux.

name: intercalary element of hind digit
definition: Small elements present in all digits of the pes, when present in a taxon. Each intercalary element articulates with the anteroventral end of the penultimate phalanx proximally and the distal phalanx distally.

name: foramen perforans tarsi
definition: Small opening between the centrale and fibulare that allows the perforans tarsi artery to pass from the ventral to the dorsal side of the ankle.

name: zonal element
definition: All those parts of the pectoral girdle in the central region of the zonal area.

name: prezonal element
definition: All those parts of the pectoral girdle that lie anterior to the zonal area.

name: postzonal element
definition: All those parts of the pectoral girdle that lies posterior to the zonal area.

name: arciferal girdle
definition: Pectoral girdle in which the epicoracoid cartilages are elaborated into posteriorly directed epicoracoid horns. Most arciferal pectoral girdles are characterized by fusion of the epicoracoid cartilages in the interclavicle region. Posterior to the clavicles, the epicoracoids usually are free and overlapping.

name: firmisternal girdle
definition: Pectoral girdle that lacks epicoracoid horns. The sternum is fused to the pectoral arch, and the epicoracoid cartilages of each half of the girdle are fused to one another. The midzonal length of the girdle is shorter than that of an arciferal girdle, but pre- and postzonal elements tend to be longer.

name: pseudofirmisternal girdle
definition: Modified arciferal pectoral girdle in which the fusion of the epicoracoid cartilages in the interclavicle region is extended posteriorly. Thus, the cartilages no longer overlap freely, and functionally a partially firmisternal condition is created.

name: pseudoarciferal girdle
definition: Modified firmisternal pectoral girdle in which the epicoracoid cartilages are partly free and overlapping; however, the epicoracoids are fused to one another and the sternum postermodially.

name: inscriptional rib
definition: Three pairs of cartilaginous elements posterior to the sternum that lie in the myosepta of the ventral trunk musculature.

name: articular process
definition: Paired processes located on the anterior end of the cricoid cartilage.

name: posterior ramus of cleithrum
definition: Laminar subdivision of the cleithrum that extends along the ventral (lateral) midbody of the suprascapula.

name: os triangulare
definition: Small, broadly triangular bar of bone lying across the ventral side of the pharynx at the junction of the M. genio-hyoideus and the M. rectus cervicis superficialis.

name: anterior radial
definition: Paired, horn-like processes of basibranchial I that protrude in an antero-dorso-lateral direction, being more or less embedded in the tongue musculature. These elements contitute the hypohyals.

name: posterior radial
definition: Paired, horn-like processes of basibranchial I that protrude in an antero-dorso-lateral direction, being more or less embedded in the tongue musculature. They arise secondarily during metamorphosis, and are therefore not strictly part of the visceral skeleton.

name: ceratobranchials II--IV
definition: Paired bars that articulate with hypobranchial II. Reduction of loss of these elements is common in salamanders.

name: hypobranchial I
definition: Paired bar that articulates with basibranchial I. It forms the anterior portion of the posterior cornu of the hyoid.

name: ceratobranchial I
definition: Paired bar that articulates with, or is fused to, hypobranchial I. It forms the posterior portion of the posterior cornu of the hyoid.

name: hypobranchial II
definition: Paired bar that articulates anteriorly with basibranchial I and posteriorly with ceratobranchials II--IV.

name: external integument structure
definition: Structures of the dermis, epidermis, glands and pigment cells recognizable on the external surfaces of the integument.

name: basale commune (carpal)
definition: Amalgamation of distal carpals 1 and 2.

name: angulosplenial
definition: Dermal bone of anuran lower jaw investing lingual and ventral surfaces of Meckel's cartilage; forming coronoid process and articulating with palatoquadrate posteriorly.

name: head external integument structure
definition: Dermal, epidermal, glandular and pigment structures of the external head integument.

name: body external integument structure
definition: Dermal, epidermal, glandular and pigment structures of the body integument.

name: limb external integument structure
definition: Dermal, epidermal, glandular and pigment structures of the limb integument.

name: tail external integument structure
definition: Dermal, epidermal, glandular and pigment structures of the tail integument.

name: suprarostral cartilage
definition: Larval upper jaws articulate with trabecular horns.

name: basale commune (tarsal)
definition: Amalgamation of distal tarsals 1 and 2.

name: pit organ
definition: Mechanoreceptive organ of the lateral line, smaller than neuromasts, they are located on the surface of the epidermis. These receptors receive afferent and efferent innervation.

name: larval chondrocranium
definition: Cartilaginous larval skull.

name: M. glutaeus magnus
definition: Originates from the superior process of the ilium and inserts on the aponeuronis of the M. cruralis.

name: M. tensor fasciae latae
definition: Originates on the ventro-lateral aspect of the ala ossis ilei and the ventral surface of the iliacus externus. Inserts on the lateral surface of the cruralis, the dorso-lateral surface of the gluteus magnus, and on the aponeurosis of the cruralis.

name: M. sartorius
definition: Originates on the ventral pelvic rim, the pubic region, and the ventral surface of the adductor longus. The insertion bifurcates distally; the ventral portion attaches to the aponeurosis of the cruralis and the dorsal part attaches to the distal attachment of the gracilis major, the semitendinosus, and to the aponeurosis of the cruralis.

name: M. semitendinosus
definition: Originates by two tendons: one on the postero-ventral aspect of the pelvic rim, the other, a dorsal tendon from the postero-dorsal pelvic rim under the ventral edge of M. semimembranosus. Inserts on the ventral surface of the tibiofibula.

name: protandrous hermaphroditic organism
definition: Sequential hermaphroditic organism that produces gametes first of the male sex, and then later of the female sex.

name: protogynous hermaphroditic organism
definition: Sequential hermaphroditic organism that produces gametes first of the female sex, and then later of the male sex.

name: centrale 1
definition: Distal-most centrale when two are present.

name: M. quadratus femoris
definition: Originates on the ventro-lateral border of the ischium and inserts on the ventro-medial surface of the femur at the base of caput femoris.

name: M. gemellus
definition: Originates from the dorso-lateral margin of the ischium and inserts on the medial surface of the femur.

name: dermal annular fold
definition: A dermal fold surrounding the body reflecting body segmentation. Found in Caecilians.

name: centrale (fore)
definition: Rectangular cartilage or bone between the distal basal commune and the proximal intermedium.

name: anterior quadratocranial commissure
definition: Cartilage that bridges palatoquadrate to ethmoid region.

name: M. gracilis major
definition: Originates by a broad tendon from the postero-ventral surface of the pelvic rim and inserts by two tendons. One broad tendon inserts on the knee aponeurosis, and in part on the ventro-medial surface of the tibiofibula. The other long tendon inserts on the posterior surface of the tibiofibula just below the proximal head.

name: M. gracilis minor
definition: Originates from the pelvic rim just ventral to the anus and merges with M. gracilis major. M. gracilis minor also attaches to the skin.

name: M. semimembranosus
definition: Originates on the ventro-lateral surface of the ischium below the anus and inserts on the ventro-medial aspect of the femur and the head of the tibiofibula by a stout tendon, which is formed by the ventral origin of the plantaris longus.

name: intermedium (fore)
definition: Quadrangular cartilage or bone lying between the preaxial radiale and the postaxial ulnare in the proximal level of the mesopodium.

name: M. ileo-fibularis
definition: Originates from the ventral border of the ala ossis ilei just posterior to the origin of M. glutaeus maximus. Insterts in the aponeurosis covering the knee joint.

name: M. pyriformis
definition: Originates on the dorso-lateral border of the distal urostyle and inserts on the dorsal surface of the crista femoris. This muscle inserts between the M. ilio-fibularis/M. glutaeus magnus and M. semimembranosus.

name: centrale 2
definition: The proximal-most rectangular cartilage or bone when two centralelia are present.

name: M. ileo-femoralis
definition: Originates from the postero-ventral surface of the ala ossis ilei and from the insertion tendon of M. ileo-fibularis. Inserts along the dorso-medial border of the femur.

name: M. iliacus internus
definition: Muscle originates on the ventral border of the ala ossis ilei to insert on the dorso-medial surface of the femur.

name: M. iliacus externus
definition: Originates on the ventral and lateral surfaces of the ala ossis ilei and inserts on the postero-dorsal face of the caput femoris.

name: M. pulmonum proprius
definition: Originates along the connective tissue covering the dorsal surface of the lung and inserts on the dorsal surface of the femur. Muscle found only in Pipa.

name: M. tibialis posticus
definition: Originates on the entire medial surface of the shaft of the tibiofibula. Inserts on the tibiale by a long tendon proximo-lateral to the insertion of the medial belly of M. tibialis anticus longus.

name: M. tibialis anticus longus
definition: Originates on the ventro-lateral surface of the medial condyle of the femur. Its tendon extends in a groove over the knee in the lateral surface of the tibiofibular head, and penetrates the M. peroneus tendon. Insertion is by a lateral and medial head on the dorso-lateral surface of the fibulare and the medial border of the proximal end of the tibiale respectively.

name: M. extensor cruris brevis
definition: Originates by a slender tendon from the ventral surface of the medial condyle of the femur and passes over the knee to insert as a fleshy belly on the ventro-lateral surface of the tibiofibula.

name: M. tibialis anticus brevis
definition: Originates from the dorso-lateral surface of the tibiofibula and inserts on the proximo-medial surface of the tibiale dorsal to the medial head of M. tibialis anticus longus.

name: basitrabecular process
definition: A process of the otic capsule that will bridge to the palatoquadrate basal process.

name: villosities
definition: Small hair or nipple like projection on the integument.

name: quadratoethmoid process
definition: Process that projects from anterior margin of commissure as site of attachment for quadratoethmoid ligament.

name: M. tarsalis posticus
definition: Originates on the medial border of the ligamentum calcanei and inserts along the ventral surface of the tibiale.

name: M. plantaris profundus
definition: Originates on the medial half of the ligamentum calcanei and inserts along the dorsal surface of the aponeurosis plantaris and extends to the level of the base of the prehallux.

name: anterodorsal lateral line nerve (ADLLN)
definition: Sensory nerve of the anterior lateral line component. It develops from the preotic anterodorsal placode. ADLLN branches into two rami innervating orbital lines of neuromasts.

name: anteroventral lateral line nerve (AVLLN)
definition: Sensory nerve of the anterior lateral line component. It develops from preotic anteroventral placode. AVLLN innervates lower jaw lines of neuromasts.

name: posterior lateral line nerve (PLLN)
definition: Sensory nerve of the posterior lateral line component. It develops from de postotic posterior placode. PLLN innervates the trunk lines of neuromasts.

name: quadrato-orbital commissure
definition: Cartilage that bridges palatoquadrate muscular process to dorsal orbitonasal plate.

name: musculus levator bulbi
definition: Cranial nerve V innervated; ventral to the eye.

name: middle lateral line nerve (MLLN)
definition: Sensory nerve of the posterior lateral line component. It develops from the postotic middle placode. MLLN innervates neuromasts located over the otic capsule and the suprabranchial line of neuromasts.

name: fringe on postaxial edge of finger IV
taeniae tecti marginalis
definition: Compose lateral rim of frontoparietal fenestra, ventrally confluent with orbital cartilages, posteriorly confluent with tectum synoticum.

name: taenia tecti transversalis
definition: Cartilaginous connection that partitions frontoparietal fenestra into anterior and posterior regions. Often persists form larva into adults.

name: orbital cartilages
definition: Forms lateral walls of braincase, confluent posteriorly with otic capsules via taenia tecti marginalis and anteriorly with lamina orbitonasalis via sphenethmoid commissure.

name: taenia tecti medialis
definition: Cartilaginous connection between the taenia tecti transversalis to the tectum synoticum, and subdividing the parietal fenestra into left and right fenestrae. Often persist from larva to adult.

name: M. cruralis
definition: Originates from the anterior surface of the hip joint capsule between the iliacus internus and the pectineus. Inserts by an aponeurosis attaching to the condyles of the femur and on the head of the cruris. This continues over the cruris to cover the tibialis anticus longus and peroneus to insert on the dorsal surface of those muscles.

name: trabecular horn
definition: Anterior extensions.

name: occipital arch
definition: Posterior chondrocranium forming ventral and lateral margins of foramen magnum, medial to otic capsules.

name: odontoids
definition: Toothlike processes found on the mandible of some anurans; can be formed by dentary or dentary + mentomeckelian bones; odontoids lack enamel and dentine present in true teeth.

name: fringe on postaxial edge of toe V
subarticular tubercles
definition: Is a integumentary structure located on the ventral surface of the hand and/or foot. Found at the junction between, in the hand, the metacarpal and most proximal phalanx of the digit and between phalanges, and in the foot between the metatarsal and most proximal phalanx of the digit and between phalanges.

name: mediale
definition: A recurrent variant of salamanders; a rhomboidal cartilage lying immediately postaxial from the centrale or centrale 1.

name: lateral appendix
definition: A small lateral diverticulum of the nasal cavity found in anuran larvae.

name: lateral recess
definition: A part of the inferior cavity of the olfactory organ, found in anurans.

name: vasculature of respiratory integument
definition: Blood vessels in respiratory skin.

name: postminimus
definition: A rounded  cartilage lying in the postaxial margin of the mesopodium, adjacent to the distal end of the fibulare.

name: Nobelian rod
definition: Either of a pair of cartilaginous rods that support the intromittent organ of male Ascaphus, and are attached to the posteroventral part of the pelvic girdle.

name: phallodeum
definition: Eversible phalloid portion of the cloaca that is inserted in the female's vent during copulation. Found in male Caecillians.

name: intromittent organ (Ascaphus type)
definition: A tail like posterior extension of the cloaca supported by a pair of Nobelian rods.

name: inner fin tissue
definition: Part of the fin consisting of a supporting core of mesenchyme and extracellular matrix.

name: outer fin tissue
definition: Part of the fin consisting of flattened epidermal cells elevated into a keel-like structure.

name: mesonephric late distal segment
definition: The site of bicarbonate resorption in the adult kidney. It is equivalent to the convoluted distal segment of metanephric nephrons.

name: capillary system of liver
definition: The smallest of the blood vessels, parts of the microcirculation, of the liver.

name: M. extensor digitorum communis longus
definition: It arises on the lateral epicondyle of the humerus by two heads: the lateral one arises by a thin tendon in common with the m.extensor carpi ulnaris with fibers proximally fused. The internal one arises by a short tendon in common with proximally fused fibers of the m. extensor carpi radialis. It divides distally in two heads: the external head inserts with a long and thin tendon on the metacarpal V, at the same point of insertion of the m. abductor brevis dorsalis digiti V; the internal one inserts by a thin tendon on the proximal region of the metacarpal IV, between the m. extensor brevis superficialis digiti IV and the m. extensor brevis medius digiti IV (Pristimantis bogotensis).

name: dorsal marginal zone
definition: Marginal zone that is a key embryonic tissue region of the early gastrula stage embryo and that houses the Spemann-Mangold organizer.

name: muscular artery
definition: Part of the external carotid which delivers blood to the mm rectus cervicis and interhyoideus posterior.

name: lateral pretrosal artery
definition: Part of the internal carotid which supplies blood to the ear and branches to two additional arteries.

name: mandibular artery
definition: Part of lateral pretrosal artery which supplies blood to the roof of the mouth.

name: cutaneus artery
definition: Artery which supplies blood to the thymus and parotoid region.

name: coeliaco-mesenteric artery
definition: This artery has many branches which supply blood to various organs in the viscus.

name: gastrico-linealis
definition: Major branch which supplies blood to the spleen and dorsal wall of the stomach.

name: duodeno-pancreatic artery
definition: Major branch which supplies blood to pancreas and duodenum.

name: duodeno-hepatic artery
definition: Major branch supplying blood via many smaller branches to the liver, duodenum, ventral wall of the stomach, and gall bladder.

name: oviduct artery
definition: One of three arteries which are part of the renal artery supplying blood to the anterior, middle, and posterior parts of the oviduct.

name: postcaval vein
definition: One of three major veins which enter the sinus venosus.

name: precaval vein
definition: Either of a pair of veins which enter on either side of the sinus venosus.

name: lateral vein
definition: Either of the veins which collect blood from the trunk and skin and drain into the subclavian vein.

name: cutaneus magnus
definition: Anterior part of the lateral vein.

name: ventral abdominal vein
definition: A vein formed by the combination of veins in the pelvic region which collects blood from the liver, stomach, intestines, and gall bladder.

name: Jacobson's vein
definition: Either of a pair of veins which receives many small vesicles from the kidney and collects blood from the oviducal vein.

name: oviducal vein
definition: Vein which collects blood from the oviduct.

name: M. plantaris longus
definition: Originates by two heads, one from the dorso-distal border of the aponeurosis covering the knee and the other from two tendinous branches along the medial border of the knee joint. Inserts by a thick, broad tendon to form the aponeurosis plantaris.

name: bronchial tube
definition: Either of the short tubes which bifurcate posteriorly from the trachea and lead into the lungs.

name: ovisac
definition: Part of the ovary consisting of a thin sheath of connective tissue enclosing the ovarian follicles.

name: median pars intermedia
definition: Region of the adenohypophysis which secretes melanophore-stimulating hormone, affecting the integumentary chromatophores.

name: pila preoptica
definition: A strut of cartilage  extending dorsally from the basal plate and with other similar cartilages forming the sides of the brain case. Posterior to the pila preoptica is the pila antoptica between these two cartilages emerges the optic and trochlear nerves.

name: prenasal (amphibians)
definition: A dermal bone that forms anterior to the premaxillae between the maxillae and articulates with the nasals posteriorly.

name: basibranchial I
definition: Bilaterally unpaired ventral element with which articulates with lateral paired elements.

name: mandibular arch neural crest
definition: Anterior most migratory stream of cranial neural crest.

name: basibranchial II
definition: Unpaired medial element that articulates with the anterior basibrachial I (if present).

name: vasa efferentia
definition: Sperm travel through these 4 or 5 fine ducts which pass through the mesorchium from the testis to the sexual kidney.

name: hyoid arch neural crest
definition: Population of cranial neural crest that give rise to hyoid arch elements.

name: cloacal papilla
definition: A small, ridge-like projection from the antero-ventral wall of the cloacal chamber.

name: amphibian cloacal gland
definition: A structure that surrounds the cloacal opening, consisting of a mass of coarse tubules.

name: granular gland
definition: A gland that contains toxic secretions within the lumen. In frogs and salamanders, this is the larger of the two types of gland, the other being the mucuous gland[Kardong].

name: laryngo-tracheal chamber
definition: Muscular vestibule between the pharynx and lungs, lying between the posterior cornua of the hyoid.

name: cartilago lateralis of aryngo-tracheal chamber
definition: A series of semicircular cartilages on the side of the laryngo-tracheal chamber.

name: constrictor laryngis externus
definition: Involved in the movement of the arytenoid cartilages; see also dilatator laryngis and constrictor laryngis anterior.

name: dilatator laryngis
definition: Involved in the movement of the arytenoid cartilages; see also constrictor laryngis externus and constrictor laryngis anterior.

name: constrictor laryngis anterior
definition: Involved in the movement of the arytenoid cartilages; see also constrictor laryngis externus and dilatator laryngis.

name: subarticular sesamoid
definition: Is an endochondral structure located on the ventral to the junction between, in the hand, the metacarpal and most proximal phalanx of the digit and between phalanges, and in the foot between the metatarsal and most proximal phalanx of the digit and between phalanges. Typically subarticular sesamoids are found with the subarticular tubercles.

name: egg capsule
definition: Protective membranes that surround amphibian embryos.

name: cephalodorsosubpharyngeus
definition: Hyobranchial muscle used in swallowing.

name: levator bulbi
definition: One of the principal muscles used in swallowing.

name: ramus nasalis lateralis
definition: Ramule of ophthalmic nerve (see also ramus nasalis medialis). The first branch of ophthalmic nerve gives rise to two ramules that border the naris and innervate the surrounding tissue.

name: ramus nasalis medialis
definition: Ramule of ophthalmic nerve (see also ramus nasalis lateralis). First branch gives rise to two ramules that border the naris and innervate the surrounding tissue.

name: rectus cervicis
definition: Retracts the hyoid and, therefore, the tongue.

name: subhyoideus
definition: Hyobranchial muscle that is a deep, visceral muscle associated with tongue movement.

name: subarcualis rectus I
definition: Deep, visceral muscle associated with tongue movement.

name: ramus nasalis internus
definition: Distal part of the opthalmicus profundus gives rise to 2 ramules: palatinus and cutaneous.

name: m. intertransversarius capitus superior
definition: Muscle of the neck involved in the movement of the head, see also m. intertransversarius capitis inferior.

name: ramule palatinus
definition: Ramules that descends towards the buccal roof and give rise to several short branches that anastomose with palatine ramus of the facial nerve.

name: m. intertransversarius capitis inferior
definition: Muscle of the neck involved in the movement of the head, see also m. intertransversarius capitis superior.

name: ramules cutaneous
definition: Many branches of the maxillary ramus that terminate in the integument of the maxillary region.

name: trunk maxillary-mandibularis
definition: Portion of the trigeminal nerve where the maxillary and mandibular rami run together prior to bifurcating.

name: ramule palatonasalis
definition: Descends and branches to the buccal roof where it anastomoses with the palatine ramus of the facial nerve.

name: m. rhomboideus anterior
definition: Muscle which originates on the posterior surface of the frontoparietal and the anterior part of the dorsal fascia. Inserts on the ventral surface of the anteromedial corner of the suprascapula.

name: bony nodule of terminal phalanx of hind digit
definition: Endochondral element distal to terminal phalanx of hind digit.

name: proximal-most prepollical element
definition: Is the proximal-most prepollical element.

name: distal-most prepollical element
definition: Is the distal-most prepollical element.

name: fetal tooth
definition: Type of deciduous dentition found in foetuses and altricial juveniles of some caecilians.

name: m. opercularis
definition: Muscle which arises from the dorsal m. levator scapulae and extends between the operculum and suprascapula.

name: m. cucullaris
definition: Muscle which originates on the prootic and the otic ramus of the squamosal and inserts on the anterior border of the suprascapula.

name: ramus posterior profundus of V3
definition: In the adult anuran, this innervates the muscles levator mandibulare internus and longus.

name: m. rhomboideus posterior
definition: Muscle which originates from the transverse process of presacral vertebrae IV and insert on the dorso-medial surface of the suprascapula.

name: m. serratus superior
definition: Muscle which originates from the transverse process of presacral vertebrae IV and inserts on the dorso-medial surface of the suprascapula beneath the insertion M. rhomboideus posterior.

name: m. serratus medius
definition: Muscle which originates from the transverse process of presacral vertebrae III and inserts on the central and medial surface of the suprascapula.

name: m. serratus inferior
definition: Muscle which originates as a posterior and anterior head. The posterior head originates from the transverse process and cartilaginous epiphysis of presacral vertebra IV. The anterior head originates on the same parts of presacral vertebrae III. Both insert on the medial surface of the suprascapula near its postero-ventral edge.

name: levator mandibulae externus
definition: Jaw muscle responsible for the closing of the jaw, and innervated by the mandibular nerve.

name: m. latissimus dorsi
definition: Muscle which originates from the ventral surface of the dorsal fascia and inserts on the deltoid crest of the humerus.

name: levator mandibulae longus
definition: Jaw muscle responsible for the closing of the jaw, and innvervated by ramus posterior profundus of V3.

name: m. dorsalis scapulae
definition: Muscle which originates on the lateral surface of the suprascapulae and inserts on the deltoid crest of the humerus.

name: levator mandibulae articularis
definition: Muscle which is responsible for the closing of the jaw, and is innervated by mandibular nerve.

name: levator mandibulae lateralis
definition: Responsible for the closing of the jaw, and innvervated by the mandibular nerve.

name: m. interscapularis
definition: Muscle which originates from the ventro-medial surface of the suprascapula and inserts on the ventral surface of the scapula.

name: levator mandibulae externus superficialis
definition: Responsible for the closing of the jaw.

name: levator mandibulae externus profundus
definition: Jaw muscle which is responsible for the closing of the jaw.

name: m. sternoepicoracoideus
definition: Muscle which originates on the anterior border of the distal part of the sternal horn and inserts antero-medially on the postero-dorsal surface of the epicoracoid cartilage.

name: dilated medial process of metacarpal IV
ramus hyomandibularis
definition: The posttrematic branch of the facial nerve, both motor and sensory in function.

name: ramus palatinus
definition: Sensory branch of facial nerve from palatal region.

name: levator quadrati
definition: Responsible for the closing of the jaw, and innervated by the trigeminal nerve.

name: M. coracoradialis
definition: Muscle which originates from the omosternum and epicoracoid cartilage and inserts on the proximal radioulna.

name: ramus muscularis of glossopharyngeus nerve
definition: Branchiomotor branch of the glossopharyngeus nerve innervating the m. subarcuales rectus I.

name: otic opercular element
definition: Round, flat bone or cartilage that lies in the fenestra ovalis and articulates with the columella.

name: M. coracobrachialis longus
definition: Muscle which originates as a long belly from the dorsal coracoid near the sternum and inserts on the shaft of the humerus.

name: M. coracobrachialis brevis
definition: Muscle which originates on the dorsal surface of the coracoid and scapula and inserts on the deltoid crest of the humerus.

name: M. flexor carpi ulnaris
definition: Muscle which originates from the medial condyle of the humerus and inserts on the carpus.

name: ramus anterior of CN VIII
definition: Formed by fibers from the anterior semicircular canal and sacculus.

name: ramus posterior of CN VIII
definition: Composed of two rami: a short ventral ramus innervating the cochlea (lagena and papille basilar), and a long dorsal ramus innervating the posterior semicircular canal.

name: M. palmaris longus
definition: Originates from the medial epicondyle of the humerus and inserts on the palmar aponeurosis.

name: M. palmaris profundis
definition: Originates on the ulnar aspect of the radioulna and inserts on the palmar aponeurosis.

name: M. flexor antibrachii medialis
definition: Originates on the medial epicondyle of the humerus and inserts on the radial aspect of the radioulna.

name: ramus auricularis of the vagus nerve
definition: An afferent branch of the vagus nerve.

name: M. ulnocarpalis
definition: Originates along distal third of the ulna and inserts on the ulnare.

name: M. flexor antibrachii lateralis superficialis
definition: Originates as a superior and inferior head. The superior head originates on the outer edge of the humerus and the inferior head originates on the lateral epicondyle of the humerus. Both bellies converge to form a tendon, which inserts on the carpus and the extensor tendon of digit I.

name: M. flexor antibrachii lateralis profundus
definition: Originates on the lateral epicondyle of the humerus and inserts on the lower ridge of the radioulna.

name: M. coccygeosacralis
definition: Originates on the lateral surface of the urostyle and inserts on the neural arch of the sacrum or on the sacral diapophysis.

name: M. coccygeoiliacus
definition: Originates on the lateral surface of the urostyle and passes ventral to the sacral diapophysis to insert on the anterior and medial surfaces of the ilial shaft.

name: M. iliolumbaris
definition: Originates on the anterior and lateral aspect of the ilial shaft and inserts on the transverse processes of presacral vertebrae IV-VII.

name: descending branch of the vagus nerve
definition: Major branch of the vagus supplying parasympathetic innervation to viscera.

name: ramus muscularis of vagus nerve
definition: Motor nervous branch of the vagus innervating m. subarcualis rectus I.

name: ramus recurrens
definition: Branch of the vagus nerve that separates from the vagus well postcranially, then continues anteriorly to innervate the larynx.

name: ramus superficial ophthalmic
definition: Dorsal branch of ADLLN that innervates supraorbital line of neuromasts.

name: M. coccygeocutaneus
definition: Originates from the posterior tip of the urostyle and inserts on the cloacal musculature and the overlying skin.

name: ramus buccal
definition: Ventral ramus of the ADLLN that innervates the infraorbital line of neuromasts.

name: laryngeus ventralis
definition: A branch of the vagus nerve innervating heart, stomach, and lung muscle.

name: ramus mandibularis externus
definition: Runs together with motor fibers of the hyomandibular trunk of VII. The mandibularis externus of AVLLN branches into three ramules .

name: M. dorsalis trunci
definition: Originates on the postero-dorsal edge of the postzygopophyses and insert on the dorsal surface of the neural arch of the posterior, adjacent vertebra.

name: jugal ramule
definition: This ramule innervates the jugal line of neuromasts and is the dorsal branch of the ramus mandibularis externus.

name: m. oblique externus
definition: Originates on the posterior margin of the suprascapula and the epaxial fascia and inserts ventrally on the lateral fascia of the M. rectus abdominus and the ilial shaft.

name: m. oblique internus
definition: A muscular sheet in which the fibers run in right angles to those of the m. oblique externus, slanting downward anteriorly. This is one of three sheets composing the flank musculature.

name: muscle rectus abdominis superficialis
definition: A component of the rectus abdominal muscle that is some taxa.

name: musculus rectus abdominis profundus
definition: A component of the rectus abdominal muscle that is some taxa (see comment) forms a disctinct and separate muscle.

name: m. ypsiloideus anterior
definition: Hypaxial muscle in which contraction elevates the ypsiloid cartilage; originates from the anterior edge of the lateral process of the ypsiloid cartilage and insert on the anteriorly adjacent inscription.

name: oral ramule
definition: Medial branch of the ramus mandibularis externus. This ramule innervates the oral and angular lines of neuromasts.

name: preopercular ramule
definition: Ventral branch of the ramus mandibularis externus. This ramule have a superior and an inferior division, both innervating the preopercular line of neuromasts.

name: ramus supraotic
definition: Small ramus of the MLLN that innervates neuromasts located at the posterior margin of the otic capsule.

name: m. ypsiloideus posterior
definition: Contraction depresses the ypsiloid cartilage; arises from the anterodorsal edge of the pubis deep to the m. rectus abdominis profundus and spreads anteriorly in a fan shape to insert on the lateral edges of the shaft and the posterior edges of the lateral processes of the ypsiloid cartilage .

name: ramulus suprabranchialis anterior
definition: Ramulus that innervates the suprabranchial line of neuromasts.

name: ramulus suprabranchialis posterior
definition: Ramulus innervating the suprabranchial line of neuromasts.

name: ramus lateral
definition: Ventral division of the trunk of the PLLN, this prominent ramus extends over the lateral trunk and caudal musculature innervating the lateral line of neuromasts.

name: ramus ventral
definition: This ramus leaves the postotic ganglionic complex together with the third branchial ramus of X. This ramule innervates the ventral line of neuromasts.

name: m. flexor indicis superficialis proprius
definition: Originates on the internal border of the distal carpal 5-4-3 and inserts on the distal end of phalynx I.

name: hepatic peritoneum
definition: Peritoneum that surrounds the liver.

name: gastrointestinal peritoneum
definition: Peritoneum that surrounds the stomach and intestines.

name: hyoquadrate process
definition: A projection on the suboccular arch, ventral to the muscular process, that serves as the articulation point for the lateral process of the ceratohyal of the hyobranchial skeleton.

name: occipito-petrosal
definition: Fusion of the occipital segment or occipital ring and otic capsule (Francis, 1934).

name: occipital segment
definition: Metameric segment forming the back of the skull.

name: posterolateral supplementary element
definition: A muscle slip arising from the ventral surface of the mandible by means of the ligament near the site of mandibular articulation. The fibers pass anteromedially and attach upon the ventral surfaces of the principal element of the m. intermandibularis (Tyler, 1971).

name: apical supplementary element
definition: A muscle slip arising from the lingual surface of the mandible on each side of the m. submentalis. The fibers pass posteromedially and attach upon the median raphe of the principal element (Tyler, 1971).

name: anterolateral supplementary element
definition: A muscle slip arising from the lingual surface of the mandible on the anterior portion of the bone. The fibers pass anteriorly, parallel to the mandible, and attach upon the ventral surface of the m. submentalis (Tyler, 1971).

name: permanent cartilage
definition: Chondrogenic element that is composed of cartilage that is not replaced.

name: mineralized skeletal tissue
definition: Skeletal tissue that is mineralized.

name: mineralized extracellular matrix
definition: Extracellular matrix that is mineralized.

name: integumentary papilla
definition: Odontogenic papilla that is located in the integument.

name: oropharyngeal papilla
definition: Odontogenic papilla located along the jaws or pharyngeal skeleton.

name: lepidosteoid scale
definition: Multi-layer ganoid scale composed of ganoine and cellular bone.

name: ganoid scale
definition: Thick, rhomboid-shaped integumentary skeletal element composed of multiple tissues including ganoine and bone.

name: vacuolated notochordal tissue
definition: Connective tissue that is matrix-poor with large number of vacuolated cells.

name: polypteroid scale
definition: Multi-tissue structure composed of ganoine, dentine, elasmodine and cellular bone.

name: avascular GAG-rich matrix
definition: Proteinaceous extracellular matrix that is avascular and consists primarily of glycosaminoglycans.

name: elasmoid scale
definition: Multi-tissue integumentary element composed dentine, elasmodine, and hypermineralized tissue.

name: palaeoniscoid scale
definition: Multi-tissue structure composed of ganoine, dentine and bone; not known in extant taxa.

name: chondroid tissue
definition: Skeletal tissue that is mineralized, has large chondrocyte-like cells, sparse extracellular matrix, and minimal perichondrium; develops from non-mineralized chondroid tissue.

name: keratin-based scale
definition: Fold or elevation of the epidermis rich in keratin proteins; possibly calcified but does not contain skeletal elements.

name: cosmoid scale
definition: Multi-tissue integumentary element composed of enamel or enameloid, dentine and lamellar bone, and characterized by pore-canal system.

name: secondary cartilage tissue
definition: Cartilage tissue that is part of the exoskeleton, deposited adjacent to bone after bone formation.

name: mineralized cartilage tissue
definition: Cartilage tissue that is mineralized.

name: integumentary skeleton
definition: Skeletal subdivision that is part of the extra-oral dermal skeletal system that develops and remains invested within the integument, primarily the dermis.

name: orthodentine
definition: Odontoid tissue that typically contains tubules and is acellular.

name: ganoine
definition: Odontogenic tissue that is hypermineralized acellular, noncollagenous, covered by an epidermis and often deposited in multiple layers.

name: limiting layer of elasmoid scale
definition: Hypermineralized tissue lacking collagen (except Sharpey's fibres), developing in close proximity to the basal cells of the overlying epithelium.

name: vasodentine
definition: Dentine tissue that lacks dentine tubules and that is penetrated by blood capillaries.

name: elasmodine
definition: Odontogenic tissue that consists of multiple layers of collagen fibers organized in orthogonal or twisted arrangements.

name: non-mineralized hyaline cartilage tissue
definition: Hyaline cartilage tissue that is not mineralized.

name: mineralized hyaline cartilage tissue
definition: Hyaline cartilage tissue that is mineralized.

name: mineralized bone tissue
definition: Bone tissue mineralized with hydroxyapatite.

name: cellular bone tissue
definition: Mineralized bone tissue that always includes non-terminally differentiated osteoblasts and osteocytes.

name: non-mineralized avascular GAG-rich matrix
definition: Avascular GAG-rich matrix that is not mineralized.

name: mineralized avascular GAG-rich matrix
definition: Avascular GAG-rich matrix that is mineralized.

name: acellular bone tissue
definition: Mineralized bone tissue that has terminally differentiated osteoblasts but lacks osteocytes.

name: odontode tissue
definition: Skeletal tissue that is avascular tubular mineralized matrix, primarily made of dentine that is deposited by odontoblasts that are excluded from the matrix; develops from pre-dentine tissue.

name: ossified tendon
definition: Sesamoid that develops within a tendon, distal to an articulation or joint.

name: ligamentous replacement element
definition: Replacement element that forms as a replacement of a ligament.

name: transient cartilaginous element
definition: Chondrogenic element that is composed of cartilage during development and has the potential to become replaced by another tissue.

name: ossified ligament
definition: Sesamoid that develops within a ligament, distal to an articulation or joint.

name: anocleithrum
definition: Dermal bone of pectoral girdle that is dorsal to and articulates with the cleithrum.

name: median fin
definition: Fin that is an unpaired fin located in the sagittal plane of the organism.

name: anal fin
definition: Median fin that is located posterior to the anus.

name: caudal fin
definition: The caudal fin is the most posterior median fin. It is composed of a complex of modified centra and modified neural and hemal arches and spines.

name: anal fin skeleton
definition: Median fin skeleton that is located posterior to the anus.

name: caudal fin skeleton
definition: Median fin skeleton supporting the caudal fin.

name: dorsal fin skeleton
definition: Median fin skeleton located on the dorsal surface of the organism.

name: median fin skeleton
definition: Postcranial axial skeleton that is unpaired and located on the sagittal plane of the organism.

name: scapular complex
definition: Skeletal subdivision of dermal bones that may include the anterolateral plate (AL), the spinal process (Sp), and anteroventral plate (AV) and other dermal bones that are part of the pectoral girdle.

name: lepidotrichium
definition: Dermal bone that is rod-like, formed and usually contained in a fin membrane, and jointed to or adjacent to distal radials. Lepidotrichia are formed from paired hemitrichia surrounding actinotrichia. There are usually two more lepidotrichia than distal radials.

name: pelvic fin lepidotrichium
definition: Lepidotrichium that is part of the pelvic fin skeleton.

name: caudal fin lepidotrichium
definition: Lepidotrichium that is part of the caudal fin skeleton.

name: pectoral fin lepidotrichium
definition: Lepidotrichium that is part of the pectoral fin skeleton.

name: anal fin lepidotrichium
definition: Lepidotrichium that is part of the anal fin skeleton.

name: dorsal fin lepidotrichium
definition: Lepidotrichium that is part of the dorsal fin skeleton.

name: suprabranchial fin
definition: Paired fin that is a bilaterally paired anterior outgrowth located high on the side of the animal, not far behind the orbit, with the posterior extremity corresponding with the expected posterior end of the branchial region.

name: skeletal element projection
definition: Anatomical projection that is composed of bone or cartilage tissue.

name: articular surface
definition: Anatomical surface that is part of a skeletal element and articulates with another skeletal element.

name: ischial peduncle
definition: Bony projection (peduncle) that is located on the posterior portion of the ilium, posterior to the acetabulum.

name: second phalanx
definition: Second most proximal phalanx in manual or pedal digits.

name: parasternal process
definition: Posterior projection of the interclavicle that extends betwen and sometimes beyond the clavicles.
synonyms_exact: posterior stalk of intercalvicle|posterior stem of interclavicle

name: pectoral articular facet
definition: Facet of scapulocoracoid with which the pectoral fin radial(s) articulates. Facet of scapulocoracoid with which the pectoral fin radial(s) articulates. Based on Goujet and Young (1995).

name: pedal digit 7 phalanx
definition: Phalanx of the 7th pedal digit.

name: post-glenoid process
definition: Distinct notch ventral to the glenoid.

name: postacetabular buttress
definition: A bony process at the distal margin of the acetabulum formed by the ischium and/or the ischial peduncle of the ilium.

name: postacetabular zone
definition: Region of the ilium posterior and dorsal to the acetabulum.

name: postcoracoid
definition: The posterior of the two coracoid elements found in basal tetrapods. Corresponds directly to the 'coracoid' of synapsids.

name: posterior dorsal fin
definition: Dorsal fin located posterior to the anterior dorsal fin.

name: posterior process of ilium
definition: A posteriorly directed bony projection from the ilium that is the attachment site of the iliofibularis muscle (see Sumida, 1997).

name: parasphenoid flange
definition: Lateral expansion of the parasphenoid.

name: hemipenal sheath
definition: Soft tissue sheath covering the hemipenis.

name: radial facet
definition: Facet to accommodate the radius on the distal end of the humerus.

name: dermal intracranial joint
definition: Hinge in the skull skeleton to allow for kinetic movement of different parts.

name: anterior distal condyle of femur
definition: Anatomical projection in the distal region of the femur.

name: spiracular notch
definition: Soft tissue notch/opening lying on a spiracle.

name: posterior distal condyle of femur
definition: Anatomical projection in the posterior/distal region of the femur.

name: presacral rib
definition: Rib located anterior to the sacral region.

name: trunk rib
definition: Rib located in the trunk (ribcage) area (i.e. excluding cervical and caudal axial series.

name: extratemporal bone
definition: Extratemporal bone: Skull bone in the posterior half of the cranium, bordering the squamosal and opercular.

name: thagomizer
definition: The distinctive arrangement of four to ten spikes on the tails of stegosaurid dinosaurs. These spikes are believed to have been a defensive measure against predators.

name: medial blade of ilium
definition: The medial surface of the iliac blade. Origin site of the iliofemoralis internus muscle and its homologues.

name: postpubis
definition: The region of the pubis posterior to the acetabulum.

name: coracoid plate
definition: Broad, convex expansion of the coracoid bone below the level of the glenoid. Based on Romer 1956.

name: archipterygial fin
definition: A type of pectoral fin in which the endoskeletal elements have a main axis that runs through the center of the fin. This creates a bilaterally symmetrical fin. (Modified from Kardong 2012).

name: intertrochanteric fossa
definition: Depression on the ventreal side of the femoral head. Associated with the pubioischiofemoralis externus muscle.

name: infraglenoid buttress
definition: An anatomical projection ventral to the glenoid fossa on the scapulocoracoid that abuts on the cliethrum (if present).

name: transverse pelvic ridge
definition: The transverse pelvic ridge is a short crest directly anterior to, and not extending posterior to, the prominent supra-acetabular buttress  from Pawley and Warren 2006.

name: inter-clavicle joint
definition: Joint that articulates left and right clavicles.

name: hypochordal lepidotrichium
definition: Caudal fin lepidotrichium located ventral to the notochord.

name: ventral humeral ridge
definition: A distinct bony ridge on ventralsurface of the humeral shaft that corresponds to the attachment site of the pectoralis muscle.

name: pedal centrale
definition: A centrale found in the pes.

name: ectepicondylar flange
definition: Flange present of the distal region of the humerus, associated with extensor musculature of forelimb.

name: flexor surface
definition: Surface of a long bone that possess the flexor muscle attachment sites.

name: lateral tuber of ulna
definition: Projection on the lateral side of proximal part of the ulna.

name: inner digits of foot
definition: The medial most digits of the pes.

name: postbranchial lamina
definition: Medial facing projection or surface on the anterior ( cranial) region of the cleithrum that is often textured or denticled. This process has two primary functions: 1) its shape enhances the vertical strength of the cleithrum and 2) it forms the edge of the gill chamber and helps to direct water after it has passed over the gills (modified from Clack 2012).

name: calcaneal tuber
definition: An enlargement of the distal region of the calcaneum that corresponds to the attachment site for the foot extensor muscles.

name: preacetabular process
definition: Process on ilium located anteriorly to acetabulum.

name: suprascapular fossa
definition: Fossa on the medial surface on the scapula above the glenoid.

name: astragalus-calcaneum unit
definition: Osteological unit consisting of the astragalus and calcaneum.

name: extracleithrum
definition: Narrow bone that lies ventral to the level of insertion of the pectoral fin and is sutured to the posterior edges of both the clavicle and cleithrum. Based on Forey 1998.

name: anterior dorsal fin
definition: A dorsal fin located anterior to posterior dorsal fin.

name: ascending process of the astragalus
definition: Flattened process of the dorsl surface of the astragalus which contacts the tibia anteriorly.

name: supraglenoid foramen
definition: Foramen that perforates supraglenoid buttress.

name: supraglenoid buttress
definition: A bony projection dorsal to the glenoid articulation on the scapulocoracoid.

name: adductor blade
definition: A prominent ridge in basal tetrapods on the ventral side of the femur that includes the fourth trochater, internal trochanter and the adductor crest (based on Coates, 1996).

name: adductor crest
definition: A bony crest on venteral side of femur that is the attachment site for the adductor muscles.

name: antitrochanter
definition: Raised surface at the posterior portion of the acetabulum (see Nesbitt, 2011).

name: caudalipuboischiotibialis
