definition: Muscle that is associated with tail flexion. Orginates on one of the first post sacral vertebrae posteriorly and inserts on the posterior edge of the m.puboischiotibialis. (modified from Duellman and Trueb 1994).

name: clavicle blade
definition: Expanded and flattened ventral region of clavicle bone.

name: cleithrum head
definition: Expanded dorsal region of the cleithrum.

name: cnemial crest
definition: Longitudnal bony ridge on tibia, attachment site of the major extensor muscle of the hind limb.

name: internal trochanter
definition: A boney projection on the internal diaphysis of the femur anterior or medial to the intertrochanteric fossa, below the femoral head. Muscle attachment site for ventral muscle mass notably the puboischiofemoralis externus. Modified from Romer 1956.

name: supinator process
definition: A bony process that corresponds to the attachment site for the forelimb supinator muscles in tetrapods, distal to the deltopectoral crest and anterior to the radial condyle.

name: subscapular fossa
definition: A marked depression on the medial side of the scapula blade, often opposite the glenoid region.

name: supraacetabular buttress
definition: A bony protuberance dorsal to the acetabulum on the ilium, confluent with the supraacetabular crest (when present). Acts as a bone brace to prevent excessive femoral abduction and the origin site for part of the M. iliofemoralis.

name: acrocoracoid process
definition: Anatomical process located in the proximal region of the coracoid in avian theropods, that is hook-shaped.

name: aponeurosis palmaris
definition: The palmar aponeurosis is a fibrotendinous complex that functions as the tendinous extension of the palmaris longus, when present, and as a strong stabilizing structure for the palmar skin of the hand. It has five longitudinal slips that project into the base of each digit and a deeper transverse portion that crosses the palm at the proximal end of the metacarpals bones (from Wikipedia).

name: brevis shelf
definition: Anatomical projection on the ilium, anchoring caudal muscles.

name: brevis fossa
definition: Fossa located on the brevis shelf.

name: articular surface for the calcaneum on the astragalus
definition: Contact surface between the calcaneum and the astragalus located on the astragalus.

name: articular surface for the astragalus on the calcaneum
definition: Contact surface between the calcaneum and the astragalus located on the calcaneum.

name: astragalo-calcaneal canal
definition: The astragalo-calcaneal canal forms a foramen between the articulated astragalus and calcaneum when the canal is ossified (Nesbitt, 2011).

name: attachment site
definition: Morphological structure denoting the extent of an attachment site for a soft tissue on a skeletal element.

name: bicipital crest
definition: Anatomical projection that is an expansion on the proximal region of the humerus.

name: cartilago sesamoides
definition: A sesamoid found in the found in the ligamentum calcanei of a wide variety of frogs. (based on Nussbaum, R. A. 1982.

name: cotyla
definition: A cup shaped articular surface on a bone.

name: cotyloid notch
definition: A notch or opening in the ventral part of the acetabular rim.

name: crista tibiofibularis
definition: Tuberosity on the posterior surface of the lateral femoral condyle.

name: diphycercal tail
definition: An internally and externally symmetrical tail (caudal) fin.

name: heterocercal tail
definition: Type of tail (caudal) fin in which the vertebral column turns upwards into the upper lobe which is longer than the lower. Asymmetrical externally as well as internally.

name: homocercal tail
definition: Type of tail fin in which the vertebrae generally turn upward at the hind end of the column, but which is externally symmetrical. The fin rays of the caudal are supported by hypaxial elements.

name: hypocercal tail
definition: Type of tail fin where the lower lobe is the longer and is supported by the vertebral column. Asymmetrical externally as well as internally.

name: ectepicondylar foramen
definition: Formen present on the ectepicondyle of the humerus.

name: epicercal tail
definition: Tail fin in which the the caudal part of the notochord tapers posterodorsally. Based on Pradel et al. 2007.

name: epichordal lepidotrichium
definition: Caudal fin lepidotrichium located upon or above the notochord.

name: ectocondylar tubercle
definition: Posteriorly projecting bony tubercle that is located proximal to the lateral condyle of the femur.

name: prepubic element
definition: A small plate of cartilage synchondrotically united with the pubis. Modified from Baez and Harrison 2005.

name: sternal keel
definition: The vertical plate of bone or cartilage attached to the median line of the sternum. Modified from Baumel et al. 1993.

name: median fin spine
definition: Fin spine that is part of a median fin.

name: fin spine
definition: A spine that is part of some fin.

name: trunk armor pectoral fenestra
definition: An opening in the dermal armour of basal gnathostomes that encloses the pectoral fins. (modified from Young 2010).

name: clavicular facet
definition: A notch for the articulation of the clavicle on other girdle elements.

name: dorsal iliac process
definition: Posteriordorsal process of the ilium.

name: fibular crest
definition: A bony projection on the lateral side of the tibia, allowing contact between the later and the fibula.

name: hypocleideum
definition: Zone of bone organ located on the flat ventral side of the distal region of the furcula, serving as attachment region for pectoral muscles.

name: postaxial centrale
definition: Centrale in the postaxial region of the mesopodium.

name: preaxial centrale
definition: Centrale in the preaxial side of the mesopodium.

name: iliac neck
definition: A constricted region of the ilium which is dorsal to the acetabulular region. Prior to the expansion of the iliac blade.

name: iliac peduncle
definition: Bony projection that is part of the dorsal surface of the ischim, where it articulates with the ilium.

name: iliac peduncle of the pubis
definition: Bony projection that is part of the dorsal surface of the pubis where it meets the ilium.

name: fibular facet of the calcaneum
definition: Articular surface on calcaneum for the fibula.

name: fibular facet of the astragalus
definition: Articular surface on the astragalus for the fibula.

name: ethomosphenoid region
definition: Region consisitng of the ethmoid and sphenoid bones.

name: flexor tubercle of ungual
definition: Eminence on the proximo-dorsal surface of the ungual, for attachment of flexor muscles.

name: inner digits of hand
definition: The medial most digit of the manus skeleton.

name: infraspinous process
definition: Process on infraspinous (region below the spine) of scapula.

name: intercondylar fossa
definition: The deep fossa between the femoral condyles in which the cruciate ligaments are attached. From Medilexicon.com.
synonyms_exact: femoral groove|femoral sulcus|femoropatellar groove|patellar groove|patellar sulcus|patellar surface of femur|patellofemoral groove|trochlea of femur|trochlear groove of femur|trochlear sulcus of femur|trochlear surface of femur

name: intermediate spine
definition: Spine ventrally located on the body and not part of the pectoral, pelvic or anal fins.

name: ischial foot
definition: Expansion of the distal region of the ischium.

name: lateral extrascapular
definition: The most lateral of the paired series of extrascapular bones and is the bone where the intersection of the otic, postotic and extrascapular or supratemporal canals occur.

name: latissimus dorsi process
definition: A bony process on the dorsal side of the proximal region of the humerus which corresponds to the insertion site of the Latissimus dorsi muscle.

name: m.scapulotriceps
definition: Muscle that represents one branch of the larger triceps brachii, origination site near the glenoid fossa on the scapula.

name: median dorsal plate
definition: Dermal armour plate that is situated behind the head and constitute the dorsal most portion of the dermal shoulder girdle. Modified from Brazeau 2009, Young 2010.

name: median extrascapular
definition: The medial of the the paired series of extrascapular bones which carries the extrascapular or supratemporal canal.

name: metacarpal extensor pit
definition: Pits located on the proximodorsal part of metacarpals denoting the attachemnt sites for ligaments.

name: nerve foramen
definition: Opening and/or passageway for nerve(s) in bone.

name: muscle scar
definition: A distinct region on a skeletal element that demarcates the attachment area of a muscle or tendon. Often associated with rugosity or tubercles.

name: obturator process of ischium
definition: Process located on the ventral shaft of the ischium that denotes the attachment site of the pubio-ischio-femoralis externus.

name: outer digit of hand
definition: The flanking digit of the manus.

name: outer digits of pes
definition: The flanking digit of the pes.

name: prepectoral spine
definition: Spine located anterior to the pectoral fin.

name: prepelvic fin spine
definition: Spine located anterior to the pelvic fin and posterior to the pectoral fin.

name: prepectoral space
definition: A triangular, anteroventrally facing area developed between the preaxial margin of the humerus and the proximal limb of the ventral humeral ridge. Based on Callier et al. 2009 .

name: prepubic process
definition: Elongate process forming the anteriormost part of the pubis.

name: presupracleithrum
definition: An skeletal element of the upper pectoral girdle overlapped by the opercular and posttemporal bones.

name: pteroid
definition: Slender bone connected to the carpus in pterosaurs. The bone, which may have pointed forward, supports the propatagium, a membrane located between the carpus and pectoral region.

name: pubic boot
definition: Anteroposterior expansion of the distal region of the pubis.

name: pubic peduncle
definition: Bony projection on the anterior portion of the ilium, anterior to the acetabulum that articulates with the pubis.

name: pubis-ischium contact
definition: Contact zone between the pubis and the ischium.

name: puboischiadic plate
definition: A broad expnase of bone incorperating both the pubis and the ischium. Origin site for ventral limb muscle including the pubioishciofemoralis externus. Modified from Romer 1956 .

name: puboischiotibialis muscle
definition: A muscle that originates from the puboischaidic plate and inserts on the tibia. Acts to adduct the hindlimb. Is anterior to cloacal gland in males. Modified from De luliis and Pulera.

name: pubotibialis
definition: Originates in on the pubic cartillage and inserts on the tibia, acts to adduct the hindlimb. Modified from De luliis and Pulera.

name: scapular process
definition: The dorsal extension of the scapulocoracoid above the level of the glenoid region in basal gnathostomes. Modified from Brazeau 2009.

name: sternal trabecula
definition: Anatomical projections that are  elongate processes in the mid and posterior regions of the sternum.

name: supraacetabular crest
definition: Anatomical projection (crest) located dorsaly to the acetabulum.

name: supraacetabular rim
definition: Bony rim that is part of the supraacetabular region.

name: suprascapula foramen
definition: The route through which structures pass between the base of the neck and the posterior scapular region. It is formed by the suprascapular notch of the scapula and the superior transverse scapular ligament. From http://medical-dictionary.thefreedictionary.com/suprascapular+foramen.

name: synarcual region of vertebral column
definition: Series of fused cervical vertebrae or vertebral elements. Based on Jeffrey C. Carrier. Biology of Sharks and Their Relatives, 2012. CRC Press.

name: synarcual region
definition: Axial subdivision that includes a series of fused cervical vertebrae or vertebral elements. Based on Jeffrey C. Carrier. Biology of Sharks and Their Relatives, 2012. CRC Press.

name: tibial facet of astragalus
definition: Facet for the articulation of the tibia on the astragalus (talus).

name: trochanteric shelf
definition: Anatomical projection on the anterolateral region of the proximal end of the femur.

name: crest
definition: A ridge or similar projection rising above the surface of an anatomical structure.

name: antimere
definition: A part in the body of an organism that corresponds to an opposite symmetrical part.

name: puboischiadic bar
definition: A transverse flattened or cylindrical plate in the posterior body wall opposite the anterior ends of the pelvic fins, in front of the vent and at the posterior end of the body cavity, that supports a few anterior pelvic radials and a basal cartilage, the basipterygium.  from  Leonard J. V. Compagno. 2001. Sharks of the World: An Annotated and Illustrated Catalogue of Shark Species Known to Date. Volume 2.

name: triphycercal tail
definition: A caudal fin with three lobes.

name: palatoquadrate element
definition: Endochondral element that is part of the suspensorium sometimes ossifying distally as the quadrate bone and linking the basal section of the braincase to the lower jaw.

name: prepollical element
definition: Is a endochondral element that is part of the mesopodial skeleton and is contained within the prepollex which in some taxa appears as a pre-axial digit-like projection anterior to the first digit of the hand.

name: prehallical element
definition: Is a endochondral element that is part of the mesopodial skeleton and is contained within the prehallux which in some taxa appears as a pre-axial digit-like projection anterior to the first digit of the foot.

name: accessory foramen
definition: Foramen found on the humerus of tetrapodomorphs beyond the entepicondyle and ectepicondyle foramen. Often denoted as foramen 'c' and 'd' after Jarvik 1996.

name: intertarsale sesamoid
definition: Sesamoid bone in the tarsal region.

name: ventral ridge system
definition: A collection of attached ridges on the ventrl surface of the femur consisting of the internal and fourth trochanters plus the adductor blade and crest. Most notible in early amniotes (based on Romer 1956).

name: mesomere (fin)
definition: The median series of bones supporting the pectoral fin of sarcopterygian fish. See Dipnomorpha. In the pectoral fin, the first mesomere is the humerus, the second the ulna, and the third probably the intermedium. The radius is the first preaxial radial. All other homologies are suspect. from http://palaeos.com/vertebrates/glossary.

name: basal scute
definition: A scute parte of the basal surface of the fin in Sarcopterygian fish.

name: hindlimb interepipodial space
definition: The space between the bones of the tibia and the fibula.

name: process 2 of entepicondyle
definition: Process on the humerus of basal tetrapods, anterior to the entepicondyle and associated with subscapularis muscle (based on Coates 1996).

name: process 3 of entepicondyle
definition: Process on the humerus of basal tetrapods, anterior to the entepicondyle and adjacent to process 4 of entepicondyle (see Coates 1996).

name: process 4 of entepicondyle
definition: Process on the humerus of basal tetrapods, anterior to the entepicondyle and adjacent to process 3 of entepicondyle (see Coates 1996).

name: distal condyle of humerus
definition: The area encompassing the radial and ulnar condyles of the humerus.

name: ascending process of clavicle
definition: A bony dorsal extension of the clavicle.

name: semilunate carpal
definition: The moon shaped fusion of distal carpals 1 and 2 found in some theropod dinosaurs, permitting greater wrist mobility.

name: astragalus head
definition: The region of the astragalus/ talus that carries the articular surface for the navicular or central metatarsal.

name: bicipital tuberosity
definition: The rough eminence which is on the anterior inner aspect of the neck of the radius and into which the tendon of the biceps is inserted. From http://www.merriam-webster.com/medical.

name: ulnar tuberosity
definition: His roughened area of bone sits distomedially at the base of the coronoid process. It is the attachment site for the brachialis muscle. From http://www.anatomyexpert.com/.

name: entepicondyle fossa
definition: A fossa on the distal humerus proximal to the entepicondyle.

name: zygosphene
definition: An articular process on anterior surface of neural arch of vertebrae which fits into zygantrum. Modified from Henderson's dictionary of Biological terms 12th Edition.

name: posterodorsal process of ilium
definition: Anatomical project part of the blade of the ilium that projects posteriorly.

name: intercentrum
definition: The anteriormost of the two possible elements found in the tetrapod centrum (when the centrum is not a single element).

name: pleurocentrum
definition: The posteriormost of the two possible elements found in the tetrapod centrum (when the centrum is not a single element).

name: atlas intercentrum
definition: The intercentrum unit of the atlas vertebra.

name: anterior humeral ridge
definition: Ridge or keel at the proximal end of the humerus. (see Laurin 1998).

name: incisor process
definition: Process that is part of the mandible that is in close proximity to the incisor teeth.

name: sallet sensory system
definition: Ciliary restraint system in the inner ear that uses sallets instead of the tectorial membrane.

name: humeral facet on the ulna
definition: Facet on the ulna for articulation with the ulnar condyle of the humerus.

name: humeral facet on radius
definition: Facet on the radius for articulation with the radial condyle of the humerus.

name: internal rim of coracoid foramen
definition: The internal part of the rim denoting the coracoid foramen.

name: external rim of the coracoid foramen
definition: The external wall of the rim denoting the coracoid foramen.

name: pectoral fin intermediate radial bone
definition: Radial bone found in between the proximal and distal radial bones.

name: postaxial process of the ulnare
definition: A projection on the postaxial region of the ulnare.

name: postaxial process of the femur
definition: A projection on the postaxial region of the femur.

name: postaxial process of the fibula
definition: A projection on the postaxial region of the fibula.

name: epipodial facet
definition: Facets for the articulation of the epipodial (zeugopodial) elements.

name: suture
definition: Line of junction between two parts immovably connected. Modified from Henderson's Dictionary of Biological Terms.

name: fibula facet of femur
definition: Facet on the femur for the fibula.

name: tibial facet of femur
definition: Facet on the femur for the tibia.

name: musculotendinous bundle
definition: A collection of muscle and tendinous tissue.

name: growth line
definition: Distinct layer that indicate the growth of an organism.

name: distal groove of humerus
definition: Groove along the distal margin of the humerus, ventral to the radial and ulnar condyle.

name: foramen C
definition: Foramen located on the scapulocoracoid, located just behind the cleithral anteroventral process(the articulation with the cleithrum). Modified from Coates 1996.

name: columnar area
definition: Modified from Garvey et al. 2005. ' Between the dorsal ridge and the caput humeri is a futher recessed area......that clearly separates the two structures and is slightly separted from the dorsal surface of the entepicondyle, and more specifically from the unfinished bone of the entepicondyle, by a narrow ridge.'.

name: scapulohumeralis muscle
definition: Muscle found primarily in basal sarcopterygians that runs between teh scapulocoracoid and the humerus. Its exact homologies with more derived shoulder muscles in Tetrapoda is unclear.

name: anteroventral process of cleithrum
definition: A ramus of the celithrum that descend along the girdle. Its rounded outer surface forms the articulation surface for the clavicle while its anterior surface overlaps with the anterior process of the scapulocoracoid.

name: surface of bone
definition: An anatomical surface that is part of a bone.

name: unfinished bone surface
definition: A bone surface that is not smooth and periosteal.  The usual implication is that the bone was still growing, was covered in cartilage, or both. From Paleos.com.

name: finished bone surface
definition: A smooth periosteal bone surface.

name: dorsal clavicular process
definition: A process, extending dorsally from the clavicular plate, that attaches to the cleithrum. Modified from Clack 2012 and Coates 1996.

name: surangular pit line
definition: ...a v-shaped pair of ridges, each carrying three or four smallpores Modified from Ahlberg et al. 2005.

name: parasymphysial plate
definition: Bone, often with tooth attachments, on the lingual side of the anterior of the lower jaw.

name: meckelian bone
definition: The ossification of the Meckel's cartilage.

name: palatine prong
definition: A process on the palatine that projects outward and upward and articulates with a depression (maxillary saddle) in the proximal end of the maxilla [Gosline WA et al, 1966; Baldwin, CC and Johnson GD. 1996. Interrelationships of Aulopiformes. Pages 355-404 in MLJ Stiassny, LR Parenti, and DG Johnson, (eds.), Interrelationships of fishes. Academic Press, San Diego, CA.].

name: urodermal bone
definition: Paired, thin dermal bones at the rear of the caudal fin skeleton, derived from scales.

name: scale pocket
definition: A continuous flap of skin with scales implanted in pockets or invaginations [Baldwin, CC and Johnson GD. 1996. Interrelationships of Aulopiformes. Pages 355-404 in MLJ Stiassny, LR Parenti, and DG Johnson, (eds.), Interrelationships of fishes. Academic Press, San Diego, CA.].

name: aphakic space
definition: The space in the pupil, which is not occupied by the lens. A rostral aphakic space may enhance the forward binocular field of vision.

name: scale row
definition: A series of scales in alignment with each other along some axis of the body.

name: medial pelvic process
definition: Process that is posteriorly oriented and medially located on the basipterygium. It is a paired projection. [PHENOSCAPE:bf].

name: epipleural series
definition: Anatomical cluster that consists of the epipleurals.

name: clavus
definition: A rudder-like lobe formed from extensions of dorsal and anal fin rays.

name: pelvic cartilage
definition: Cartilage element associated with the pelvic fin in aulopiform fishes.

name: rostrodermethmoid
definition: Dermal bone formed by the fusion of dermethmoids and rostral bones [Fink, W L Weitzman, S H. 1982. Relationships of the stomiiform fishes (Teleostei), with a description of Diplophos Bulletin of The Museum of Comparative Zoology 150:31-93. http://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/part/28697].

name: ventral marginal cartilage
definition: In the clasper skeleton, a flat semicylindrical cartilage that is partially fused to the lateral edge of the axial cartilage, and forms the lateral wall of the clasper groove [Compagno, L. 2001. Sharks of the World: An Annotated and Illustrated Catalogue of Shark Species Known to Date. Volume 2].

name: dorsal fin basal cartilage (elasmobranchs)
definition: The large cartilage of the dorsal fin, on which the radials articulate distally [Compagno 2001. Sharks of the World: An Annotated and Illustrated Catalogue of Shark Species Known to Date. Volume 2].

name: anal fin basal cartilage
definition: The large cartilage of the anal fin, on which the radials articulate distally [Compagno 2001. Sharks of the World: An Annotated and Illustrated Catalogue of Shark Species Known to Date. Volume 2].

name: anterolateral plate
definition: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderm fishes.

name: anteroventral plate
definition: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderms, located in the ventral armour adjacent to the interolateral (IL) and anterior ventrolateral (AVL) plates.

name: interolateral plate
definition: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderms, and located anterior to the anterior ventrolateral (AVL) plate.

name: spinal plate
definition: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderms, and located lateral to the anterior ventrolateral (AVL) plate.

name: posterior dorsolateral plate
definition: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderms, located posterior to the main components of the complex.

name: anterior ventrolateral plate
definition: Dermal bone that is part of the ventral region of scapular complex in placoderms (see also posterior ventrolateral plate). In most placoderms with a long ventral armour, the ventral wall is typically composed of two large paired lateral plates (anterior and posterior ventrolaterals).

name: posterior ventrolateral plate
definition: Dermal bone that is part of the ventral region of scapular complex in placoderms (see also anterior ventrolateral plate). In most placoderms with a long ventral armour, the ventral wall is typically composed of two large paired lateral plates (anterior and posterior ventrolaterals).

name: dermal neck joint
definition: Dermal articulation between skull and shoulder girdle localized to paired dermal neck-joint between anterior dorsolateral plate (ADL) and paranuchal (PNu) plates in placoderms.

name: fin web
definition: Membrane that connects the lepidotrichia or ceratotrichia of a fin.

name: posterior dorsal fin basal cartilage (elasmobranchs)
definition: The large cartilage of the posterior dorsal fin, on which the radials articulate distally.

name: anterior dorsal fin basal cartilage (elasmobranchs)
definition: The large cartilage of the anterior dorsal fin, on which the radials articulate distally.

name: antorbital cartilage
definition: Cartilage element on the neurocranium of sawsharks and batoids, separate cartilages attached to the sides of the nasal capsules that support the sides or front of the head. [Compagno, L.J.V. Sharks of the world. An annotated and illustrated catalogue of shark species known to date. Volume 2. Bullhead, mackerel and carpet sharks (Heterodontiformes, Lamniformes and Orectolobiformes). FAO Species Catalogue for Fishery Purposes. No. 1, Vol. 2. Rome, FAO. 2001. 269p. ISBN 92-5-104543-7].

name: supraneural element
definition: Endochondral element that is median and located in the dorsal skeletogenous septum between the cranium and the dorsal fin.

name: bony fin ray
definition: Fin ray that is composed of bone tissue.

name: facet
definition: A small smooth area on a bone or other firm structure.  A worn spot on a tooth, produced by chewing or grinding.

name: X bone
definition: The x bone is a detached neural spine anterior to the neural spine of preural centrum 2.

name: Y bone
definition: The y bone is a detached neural spine anterior to the haemal spines of preural centrum 2.

name: anal fin pterygiophore 1
definition: Anal fin pterygiophore that is the anteriormost of the series.

name: anal fin spine 1
definition: Anal fin spine that is the anteriormost element of the series.

name: anal fin spine 2
definition: Anal fin spine that is located posteriorly adjacent to the first anal fin spine.

name: dorsal fin ceratotrichial spine (elasmobranchs)
definition: A small to large enameloid-covered, dentine-cored spine located on the anterior margins of one or both of the dorsal fins, found on bullhead sharks (Heterodontiformes), many dogfish sharks, fossil (but not living) batoids, chimaeroids, but lost entirely or buried in the fin bases of other shark-like fishes [Compagno, Sharks of the World].

name: postcleithral scale
definition: Scale that is posteriorly adjacent to the pectoral girdle [Cloutier and Arratia 2004, character 183].

name: rudimentary pectoral fin ray
definition: Pectoral fin lepidtrichium that is small, unbranched and unsegmented.

name: ectocoracoid bone
definition: A paired dermal bone in Gasterosteiformes connected with the coracoid and extending posteriorly. Has also been applied to the element below the scapula and applied to the coracoid in Dipnoi. Dictionary of Ichthyology.

name: caudal vertebra 1
definition: Caudal vertebra that is the anteriormost element of the series.

name: ventral limb of posttemporal
definition: Zone of bone organ that is the ventral extension of the posttemporal.

name: lepidotrichial segment
definition: Zone of bone organ that is part of a lepidotrich and connected to other segments by collagen fibers. These segments lend flexibility to the lepidtrich.

name: proximal segment of caudal ray
definition: Lepidotrichial segment that is part of the proximal region of a caudal fin ray.

name: lateral ethmoid element
definition: Endochondral element that separates the olfactory region from the orbit, extends medially to meet its fellow medially below the frontal bones and is bordered by the mesethmoid anteriorly. It may articulate with the autopalatine and infraorbital 1 laterally. The lateral ethmoid is paired.

name: distal segment of caudal ray
definition: Lepidotrichial segment that is part of the distal region of a caudal fin ray.

name: pelvic sucking disc
definition: An adhesive disk modified from the pelvic fins in, for example, clingfishes (Gobiesocidae), gobies (Gobiidae) and snailfishes (Liparidae).
synonyms_exact: adhesive disc|pelvic fin sucking disc|ventral sucking disc

name: sucking disc
definition: Distinctive first dorsal fin taking the form of a modified oval sucker-like organ with slat-like structures that open and close to create suction and take a firm hold against the skin of larger marine animals.

name: dorsal fin ray
definition: Soft ray that is part of the dorsal fin.

name: pelvic fin ray
definition: Soft ray that is part of the pelvic fin.

name: glenoid region
definition: Region surrounding the glenoid fossa on the scapulocoracoid.

name: spinous region of dorsal fin
definition: Region of dorsal fin that is composed of spinous rays (vs soft rays).

name: zygantrum
definition: A fossa on the posterior median part of the neural arch of a vertebra (as of a snake) that accommodates the zygosphene of the next vertebra.

name: pre-axial region
definition: Anatomical region lying to the anterior or dorsal side of the metapterygial axis.

name: axis intercentrum
definition: The intercentrum unit of the axis vertebra. .

name: dorsal iliac ridge
definition: Ridge that is part of the ilium.

name: tectorial restraint system
definition: Tectorial restraint system is a type of ciliary restraint system for hair cells in the inner ear.  In tectorial restraint systems, the tectorial membrane restrains the cilia of the hair cells by attaching either directly to ciliary tufts or indirectly through various kinds of fibrous structure (simple fibers, fibrous strands, finger-like processes, tectorial plates) [Phylogenetic Relationships of the Lizard Families: Essays Commemorating Charles L. Camp. 1988. Eds. R Estes, GK Pregill. Stanford University Press].

name: nuchal crest
definition: Bony protuberance on the external surface of the occipital bone.[PHENOSCAPE:AD].

name: sacral rib
definition: Elements of the sacrum joining true sacral vertebrae to pelvis [12th edition of Henderson's Dictionary of Biological terms].

name: dorsal pelvic gland
definition: Cloacal glands that secrete into the dorsal roof of the cloacal tube and or the anterior cloacal chamber. Found in male salamanders.

name: glossopharyngeal nerve foramen
definition: Foramen for the passage of the glossopharyngeal nerve IX.

name: upper jaw symphyseal region
definition: The region of the upper jaw on or near the midline.

name: lateral commissure
definition: Region of the braincase which bears the facets for the hyomandibula in fishes. This region disappears in the origin of tetrapods and the space it occipied comes to contribute to the fenestra vestibulii. Clack, JA, 2001. Ch. 23, The otoccipital region. In Major Events in Early Vertebrate Evolution. Per Ahlberg editor.

name: upper jaw symphyseal tooth
definition: Tooth of the upper jaw that is adjacent to the upper jaw symphysis.

name: lingual region
definition: The region of an anatomical structure (such as a tooth or jaw bone) facing the tongue.

name: labial region
definition: The region of an anatomical structure, such as a tooth or jaw bone, facing the lips.[PHENOSCAPE:WD].

name: posterolingual region
definition: The region of an anatomical structure, such as a tooth or jaw bone, oriented posteriorly and facing the lips.

name: mesial region
definition: The region of an anatomical structure, such as a tooth or jaw bone, facing the midline of the jaw.

name: internal carotid foramen
definition: Foramen for the passage of the internal carotid artery.

name: profundus foramen
definition: Foramen for the profundus or ophthalmic nerve.

name: pectoral fin base
definition: Subdivision of organism that is the basal region of the pectoral fin.

name: gill membrane
definition: Membrane organ that is usually supported by branchiostegal rays and forms the ventral and posterior wall of the gill cavity.

name: pelvic intercleithral cartilage
definition: Cartilage element that lies between processes of the cleithrum and pelvic girdle in gobioid fishes. Posterodorsal to the ventral end of each cleithrum is a posteriorly projecting process. The pelvic intercleithral cartilage (an unpaired, median structure) forms a bridge between the processes (From Springer, 1983).

name: accessory nasal sac
definition: Accessory nasal sacs are found in a variety of teleosts (Webb, 1993) and likely assist in ventilating the olfactory epithelium by transmitting pressure fluctuations associated with gill irrigation from theoral cavity to the nasal (or sensory) sac (Jakubowski,1975; Webb, 1993; Belanger et al., 2003). [def from Eastman, J. T. and Lannoo, M. J. (2004)].

name: Sharpey's fiber
definition: Sharpey's fibres (bone fibres, or perforating fibres) are a matrix of connective tissue consisting of bundles of strong collagenous fibres connecting periosteum to bone. They are part of the outer fibrous layer of periosteum, entering into the outer circumferential and interstitial lamellae of bone tissue.

name: procurrent spur
definition: A ventrally projecting spur on the posteriormost ventral procurrent caudal ray overlapping ventrally the preceding ray in various percomorphs (Johnson, 1975).

name: pectoral splint
definition: Unpaired bone that covers the base of the first pectoral ray. [Filleul and Lavoué 2001].

name: midshaft
definition: Region in the middle of the shaft of a long bone (e.g. humerus, femur etc).

name: pectoral fin bud
definition: A paired fin bud that develops into a pectoral fin.

name: pelvic fin bud
definition: A paired fin bud that develops into a pelvic fin.

name: actinopterygian pyloric caecum
definition: A finger-like out-pocketing of the intestine where it meets the end of the stomach (pylorus). Also spelled cecum (ceca). Serves to aid digestion.

name: procumbent dorsal fin spine
definition: Fin spine that precedes the dorsal fin, oriented anteriorly towards the head of the fish.

name: parietal branch of the supraorbital canal
definition: Branch of supraorbital sensory canal that extends to the parietal.

name: replacement tooth row
definition: Tooth row consisting of replacement teeth.

name: inner tooth row of dentary
definition: Dentary tooth row that is lingual in position relative to other tooth rows.

name: inner tooth row of premaxilla
definition: Tooth row on the premaxilla that is lingually located relative to other tooth rows.

name: isthmus
definition: The fleshy throat region of a fish which extends forward from the ventral part of the chest and narrows anteriorly, and externally separating the two gill chambers; that narrowed portion of the breast which lies between the gill chambers and separates them.

name: posterior sclerotic cartilage
definition: Sclerotic cartilage that is located posterior to the eye.

name: anterior sclerotic cartilage
definition: Sclerotic cartilage that is located anterior to the eye.

name: neural spine 5
definition: Neural spine that is associated with the fifth vertebra.

name: neural spine 6
definition: Neural spine that is associated with the sixth vertebra.

name: neural spine 7
definition: Neural spine that is associated with the seventh vertebra.

name: terminal scale
definition: The posteriormost scale in a scale series.

name: parapophysis 3
definition: Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the third centrum. Parapophysis 3 is bilaterally paired.

name: claustrum element
definition: Postcranial axial skeletal element and Weberian ossicle that is located dorsal to the scaphium. The claustrum skeletal element is bilaterally paired.

name: branched pelvic fin ray
definition: Pelvic fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched and segmented.

name: unbranched anal fin ray
definition: Anal fin lepidotrichium that is not distally branched.

name: photophore
definition: A light-emitting organ which appears as luminous spots on various marine animals, including fish and cephalopods.

name: rostral tubule
definition: Consists of a set of tubuli occupying the space between the external dermal bones above the dorsal and anterior wal of the nasal capsule below. Thomson and Campbell (1971).

name: Westoll line
definition: More or less concentric lines of discontinuity in the cosmine of Dipnoi, probably due to cyclic resorption and redeposition during growth occurring on the bases of individual scales and also as large structures between headshield plates.[Fishbase].

name: epichordal radial
definition: Radial found above the vertebral column.

name: postsplenial
definition: Dermal bone of the lower jaw.

name: postparietal shield
definition: Dermal bones (postparietals, supratemporals, intertemporals, extrascapulars) posterior to the intracranial joint. Forey 1997.

name: subepiotic fossa
definition: Fossa for epaxial musculature inserting on the braincase. Forey et al. 1996.

name: endoskeletal cranial joint
definition: The braincase of most plesiomorphic sarcopterygians is divided by the intracranial point into ethmosphenoid and otic-occipital portions each covered by dermal bones. The function of the joint is presumably to increase the gape of the mouth rapidly during opening phases. (Forey 1997).

name: tectum orbitale
definition: The dorsal portion of the endocranium that covers the orbital region. Hanken and Hall (1993).

name: palato-maxillary ligament
definition: Ligament between the palatine and maxilla [Stiassny 1986].

name: mandibulo-lacrimal ligament
definition: Ligament that connects the ventromedial end of the lacrimal to the anguloarticular (or 'mandible'). Parenti (2008).

name: submandibular series
definition: A series of plate like bones found ventrally to the jaw.

name: transversus epibranchialis 2
definition: Dorsal gill-arch muscle connecting right and left epibranchial 2s. Springer and Johnson (2015).

name: lateral plate
definition: Body plates on the lateral sides of the body that occur as single bilateral rows and their number is highly heritable. Bell and Richkind (1981).

name: acrodin
definition: Odontoid tissue forming a cap on teeth found in teeth of actinopterygian fishes.

name: supraneural 1 element
definition: Postcranial axial skeletal element located dorsal to vertebra 1.

name: supraneural 2 element
definition: Postcranial axial skeletal element located dorsal to vertebra 2.

name: supraneural 3 element
definition: Postcranial axial skeletal element located dorsal to vertebrae 3 and 4.

name: supraneural 4 element
definition: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 4.

name: supraneural 5 element
definition: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 5.

name: supraneural 6 element
definition: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 6.

name: supraneural 7 element
definition: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 7.

name: supraneural 8 element
definition: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 8.

name: supraneural 9 element
definition: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 9.

name: axilar scale
definition: Scale that is adjacent to the pelvic fin and aligned with the origin of the pelvic fin. It is typically an elongate scale.[Mattox and Toledo-Piza 2012].

name: precaudal vertebra
definition: Vertebral bone lacking hemal spines (Weitzman, 1962), refers generally to the anterior vertebral region bounding the abdominal cavity. Alternate but not quite synonymous terms are abdominal or trunk vertebrae, which bear parapophyses and ribs. In many actinopterygians dorsal to the posterior abdominal cavity there are transitional vertebrae lacking ribs but also without hemal spines or sometimes even enclosed hemal arches. The primary definition would identify these vertebrae as precaudal. Bird and Mabee, 2003.

name: precaudal vertebra endochondral element
definition: Vertebral elements lacking hemal spines (Weitzman, 1962), refers generally to the anterior vertebral region bounding the abdominal cavity. Alternate but not quite synonymous terms are abdominal or trunk vertebrae, which bear parapophyses and ribs. In many actinopterygians dorsal to the posterior abdominal cavity there are transitional vertebrae lacking ribs but also without hemal spines or sometimes even enclosed hemal arches. The primary definition would identify these vertebrae as precaudal.(Bird and Mabee, 2003).

name: precaudal vertebra cartilage element
definition: Vertebral cartilage elements lacking hemal spines (Weitzman, 1962), refers generally to the anterior vertebral region bounding the abdominal cavity. Alternate but not quite synonymous terms are abdominal or trunk vertebrae, which bear parapophyses and ribs. In many actinopterygians dorsal to the posterior abdominal cavity there are transitional vertebrae lacking ribs but also without hemal spines or sometimes even enclosed hemal arches. The primary definition would identify these vertebrae as precaudal.(Bird and Mabee, 2003).

name: forelimb bud mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a forelimb bud.

name: hindlimb bud mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a hindlimb bud.

name: pectoral fin bud mesenchyme
definition: Mesechyme that is part of a pectoral fin bud.

name: pelvic fin bud mesenchyme
definition: Mesechyme that is part of a pelvic fin bud.

name: forelimb wing bud
definition: A wing bud that develops into a wing.

name: forelimb wing bud mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a forelimb wing bud.

name: mammiliform tooth
definition: Calcareous tooth with a hyptertrophied base.

name: scale sheath
definition: Series of scales in which each scale envelopes or overlaps an adjacent scale.

name: spinoid scale
definition: A cycloid scale bearing a serrated margin; superficially similar to ctenoid scales but having spines as outgrowths of the scale as oppose to true ctenii.

name: rib of vertebra 7
definition: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the seventh centrum.

name: rib of vertebra 8
definition: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the eighth centrum.

name: hind flipper
definition: Hindlimb that is used to propel an animal through water.

name: rostral ossicle
definition: Ossicle that surrounds the sensory canals of the snout when passing from the ethmoidal commissure to the infraorbital series and have first been noticed by Nybelin [14] in Elops. From: Filleul and Lavoué. (2001). Basal teleosts and the question of elopomorph monophyly. Morphological and molecular approaches. Comptes rendus de l'Académie des sciences. Série III, Sciences de la vie. 324. 393-9. 10.1016/S0764-4469(00)01302-0.

name: ethmoid commissure
definition: Sensory canal that traverses the rostral bone.

name: lateral line scale 6
definition: The sixth scale in the lateral line series.

name: premaxillary tooth 2
definition: Premaxillary tooth that is the second tooth in a premaxillary tooth series, and positioned adjacent to the symphyseal tooth.

name: premaxillary tooth 3
definition: Premaxillary tooth that is the third tooth in a premaxillary tooth series, and positioned adjacent to the second tooth.

name: dentary tooth 2
definition: Dentary tooth that is the second tooth in a dentary tooth series, and positioned adjacent to the symphyseal tooth.

name: dentary tooth 3
definition: Dentary tooth that is the third tooth in a dentary tooth series, and positioned adjacent to the symphyseal tooth.

name: fused hypural 1 and 2

name: insect trunk mesoderm
definition: The mesoderm of segments T1-A9. It first becomes morphologically distinct during ventral furrow formation. Following invagination during stages 6 and 7, it remains a coherent structure with no morphologically apparent subdivisions, apart from transient metamery during stage 9, until stage 11. It undergoes a number of morphological changes during this period: as its cells divide following invagination, it loses its epithelial integrity and by stage 9 has rearranged into a monolayer of cuboidal cells. A further division happens during stage 10 leading to two distinct layers by stage 11.

name: insect embryonic/larval lymph gland
definition: Hematopoietic organ of the larva, located along the dorsal vessel, behind the brain. It produces the plasmatocytes, crystal cells and lamellocytes which are released at the end of the larval instar and onset of metamorphosis. It is composed of 3 pairs of bilateral lobes: an anterior primary lobe, a posterior secondary lobe and the most posterior lobe (or multiple lobes), the tertiary lobe. Each lobe is separated by pericardial cells. In the late embryo, the lymph gland consists of a single pair of lobes (primary lobes) containing around 20 cells each that flank the dorsal vessel. By the second larval instar, the lymph gland is composed of two or three new pairs of posterior lobes, and the primary lobes have increased in size to contain around 200 cells. During the first and early second larval instars, the lymph gland comprises only the hematopoietic progenitor population. The lymph gland increases in size ten-fold by the late third instar, and at this stage the progenitor cells (prohemocytes) become restricted to the medial region (medullary zone) of the primary lobe and become quiescent. The differentiated hemocytes are found in the periphery (cortical zone) of the primary lobe and these cells proliferate extensively. The posterior signalling center is a group of about 30 cells at the posterior tip of the primary lobe that secretes several signalling molecules and functions as a stem-cell niche. The secondary and tertiary lobes contain prohemocytes, and rarely a differentiated cell. Lymph glands are eliminated at metamorphosis.

name: insect ring gland
definition: A closely associated cluster of three neuroendocrine glands located anterior to the aorta and dorsal to the esophagus. At embryonic stage 17 and in larva it is found anterior to the brain and is formed by the corpus cardiacum ventrally, the prothoracic gland laterally and the corpus allatum dorsally. The adult ring gland is located anterior to the proventriculus and is formed by the corpus cardiacum ventrally, the corpus allatum dorsally and the hypocerebral ganglion posterior to the corpus cardiacum. It is innervated by neurons of the nervus corporis cardiaci (NccI-III).
