definition: Imaginal disc that is a precursor of dorsal thoracic structures of the adult.

name: insect wing disc
definition: Dorsal imaginal disc of the mesothorax. Precursor of dorsal mesothoracic structures of the adult including the postnotum, scutum, scutellum, wing, wing hinge and part of the notal pleura.

name: insect haltere disc
definition: Dorsal imaginal disc of the metathorax. Precursor of structure of the adult dorsal metathorax including the haltere.

name: insect ventral thoracic disc
definition: Imaginal disc that is a precursor of ventral thoracic structures of the adult.

name: insect prothoracic leg disc
definition: Imaginal disc of the ventral prothoracic segment. Precursor of structures of the adult ventral prothorax including the prothoracic (1st) leg.
synonyms_exact: 1st leg disc|T1 leg disc|ventral prothoracic disc

name: insect genital disc
definition: Imaginal disc that gives rise to the internal and external genitalia, analia and adult hind gut (Cohen, 1993).

name: insect male genital disc
definition: Genital disc that gives rise to the penis and external genitalia, sperm pump, ejaculatory duct, paragonia and vas deferens, anal plates and adult hindgut (Cohen, 1993).

name: insect female genital disc
definition: Genital disc that gives rise to the vagina and vaginal plates, uterus, parovaria, spermatheca, seminal recepticle, oviducts, female analia and hindgut. (Cohen, 1993).

name: insect histoblast nest
definition: One of several groups of cells in the larval abdomen that gives rise to the adult external abdomen.

name: insect embryonic/larval digestive system
definition: Digestive system of the insect embryo or larva.

name: insect cephalopharyngeal skeleton
definition: A group of connected sclerites of the anterior embryonic/larval digestive system (atrium, pharynx and dorsal pouch). The cibarial dilator muscles connect to the cephalopharyngeal skeleton to lift the roof of the pharynx and thereby widen its lumen (Jurgens, 1986).

name: insect epipharyngeal sclerite
definition: Unpaired sclerite to which the median tooth (labrum) posteriorly merges, and bears the cuticular pores of the labral sense organ.

name: insect embryonic/larval nervous system
definition: Nervous system of the embryo/larva.

name: insect embryonic/larval central nervous system
definition: Central nervous system of the embryo/larva.

name: insect embryonic/larval brain
definition: Brain of the embryo/larva.

name: insect embryonic/larval protocerebrum
definition: Protocerebrum of the embryo/larva.

name: insect larval sense organ
definition: Any sense organ that is part of some larva.

name: insect embryonic/larval ocular segment sensillum
definition: Any embryonic/larval sense organ (UBERON:6002639) that is part of some larval ocular segment (UBERON:6001731).

name: insect adult tagma
definition: Any tagma (UBERON:6000002) that is part of some adult (UBERON:6003004).

name: insect adult head
definition: Head of the adult organism.

name: insect adult head segment
definition: Segment of the adult head.

name: insect adult procephalic segment
definition: Any procephalic segment (UBERON:6000007) that is part of some adult head (UBERON:6003007).

name: insect adult labral segment
definition: Any labral segment (UBERON:6000008) that is part of some adult head (UBERON:6003007).

name: insect adult antennal segment
definition: Any antennal segment (UBERON:6000009) that is part of some adult head (UBERON:6003007).

name: insect adult thorax
definition: Thorax of the adult.

name: insect adult thoracic segment
definition: Any segment (UBERON:6000003) that is part of some adult thorax (UBERON:6003018).

name: insect adult prothoracic segment
definition: Any prothoracic segment (UBERON:6000017) that is part of some adult thorax (UBERON:6003018).

name: insect adult mesothoracic segment
definition: Any mesothoracic segment (UBERON:6000018) that is part of some adult thorax (UBERON:6003018).

name: insect adult abdomen
definition: Abdomen of the adult.

name: insect adult abdominal segment
definition: Any abdominal segment (UBERON:6000021) that is part of some adult abdomen (UBERON:6003023).

name: dorsal trunk of insect trachea
definition: Longitudinal tracheal branch of the insect tracheal system, dorsal to the lateral trunk.

name: insect adult muscle system
definition: Muscle system of the adult.

name: insect adult somatic muscle
definition: Muscle attached to the inner surface of the adult body wall, extending between articulated or flexibly joined areas, that serves to move the parts of the exoskeleton.

name: insect adult nervous system
definition: Nervous system of the adult insect.

name: insect adult central nervous system
definition: Central nervous system of the adult.

name: insect adult brain
definition: Brain of the adult.

name: insect supraesophageal ganglion
definition: The pre-oral neuropils of the brain located above and some of it below the esophagus, comprising three fused ganglia (protocerebrum, deutocerebrum, and tritocerebrum) in the head.

name: insect protocerebrum
definition: The most anterior of the segmental subdivisions of the insect CNS; thought to represent the first pre-oral segment of the brain. The protocerebrum comprises many discrete neuropil regions including the central body complex and mushroom bodies.

name: insect adult central complex
definition: A midline crossing complex of 4 synaptic neuropil domains of the adult brain: the ellipsoid body, the fan-shaped body, the paired noduli, and the protocerebral bridge. It is closely associated with another paired synaptic neuropil domain, the lateral complex. It lies in the middle of the brain between the pedunculi of the mushroom bodies and is bounded ventrally by the esophagus, dorsally by the pars intercerebralis and laterally by the antenno-glomerular tracts.

name: insect sex comb
definition: A row of darkly pigmented, male specific chaetae located on the prothoracic metatarsal segment of the prothoracic leg. The number of chaetae (teeth) per sex comb varies between individuals, e.g.- Hannah-Alava and Stern report 10-13.

name: insect wing hair
definition: The posteriorly oriented trichome of a cell of the wing blade. Each cell makes one of these trichomes at its posterior vertex.

name: insect sclerite
definition: A region of integument whose external cuticular part is a hard, sclerotized plate.

name: insect tergite
definition: The dorsal plate (sclerite) of an adult abdominal segment.

name: insect sternite
definition: An adult ventral sclerite.

name: insect arista
definition: Highly specialised, slender sixth segment of the antenna covered in bristle-like outgrowths known as laterals. It extends laterally from the dorsal region of the third segment of the antenna.

name: insect clypeus
definition: The anterior part of the head between the frons and the labrum, which occasionally may fuse with either one to form the frontoclypeus and the clypeolabrum. In the context of Drosophila refers to a round structure on the center of the frontal adult external head.

name: insect proboscis
definition: The trunk-like extension of adult head, forming a protrusible sucking proboscis for the ingestion of liquid food (pg 425 Miller et al., 1950; pg 383, Ferris et al., 1950).

name: insect adult external thorax
definition: External structures that make up the adult insect thorax.

name: insect tergum
definition: The upper, originally unpaired plate of the segmented insect body, which either independently or fused with a ventral plate covers the body dorsally, specifically that of the thorax.

name: insect mesothoracic tergum
definition: The dorsal sclerites (tergites) of the mesothorax.

name: insect tarsal segment
definition: A segment of the tarsus of the adult leg. The first tarsal segment, the metatarsus, is proximally connected to the tibia. Tarsal segments are covered in 8 longitudinal rows of bristles, with row 1 being the most ventral.

name: insect metatarsus
definition: The first of the tarsal segments of the adult leg. It is located between the tibia and the second tarsal segment and is longer than the other tarsal segments. It has 8 longitudinal rows of bristles around the circumference.
synonyms_exact: 1st tarsal segment|basitarsus|first segment of the tarsus|first tarsal segment|tarsal segment 1

name: insect prothoracic leg
definition: Leg of the prothoracic segment.

name: insect prothoracic tarsal segment
definition: Tarsal segment of the adult prothoracic leg.

name: insect prothoracic metatarsus
definition: First tarsal segment of the prothoracic leg. Proximally, it articulates with the tibia and distally with the second tarsal segment. Its surface is covered with eight longitudinal rows of bristles and with transverse rows of bristles (TR) in the anterior compartment, between proximo-distal rows 7 and 8. There is sexual dimorphism in the number of TRs (transverse row bristles, TR). In males, 2 TRs are replaced by the sex comb and one central bristle.
synonyms_exact: prothoracic basitarsus|prothoracic tarsal segment 1|T1 tarsal segment 1|T1 Ts1

name: insect analia
definition: The set of external structures of adult abdominal segment(s) that makes up the anal apparatus.

name: insect trichome
definition: Non-innervated projection of the cuticle around an actin-rich cellular process of an underlying epidermal cell.

name: insect imaginal precursor
definition: Structure that proliferates to produce a larval imaginal disc and which gives rise to adult tissues (Bate and Martinez Arias, 1991).

name: insect tracheal pit
definition: Deep and narrow pit formed by the invagination of a tracheal placode in a late extended germ band embryo. Invagination of the placode begins during stage 11. Branches begin to bud from the pit during stage 11, with a dorsal and ventral stem being apparent by mid-stage 12. The pit closes over during stage 13. There are 10 pairs of tracheal pits - one pair in each tracheal metamere (each segment from T2 to A8). Pits are located in the central one third of each parasegment, with the most anterior in parasegment 4 and the most posterior in parasegment 14.

name: insect tracheal primordium
definition: Primordium of a single tracheal metamere of the embryonic/larval tracheal system from its appearance as a placode during stage 11 to the completion of fusion with adjacent tracheal metameres in stage 15/16. There are 10 pairs of tracheal primordia - one pair in each segment from T2 to A8. Each tracheal primordium originates as a slight depression in the lateral ectoderm during stage 10 known as a tracheal placode. During stage 11, these placodes invaginate to form tracheal pits that elongate and branch. These pits close over during stage 13. Fusion of tracheal primordia begins at stage 14 with fusion of the dorsal trunk primordia and is complete by early stage 16.

name: insect trachea
definition: Cuticle-lined epithelial tube that forms part of the insect tracheal system.

name: insect spiracle
definition: Opening of the tracheal system on the surface of the body.

name: insect stomatogastric nervous system
definition: A group of small, interconnected ganglia situated posterior to and between the two brain hemispheres and associated with the pharynx, esophagus and aorta.

name: insect chaeta
definition: A sensillum with a long, unicellular, setiform outgrowth that is strongly chitinized.

name: insect wing margin
definition: The border or edge of the wing. It separates the dorsal and ventral compartments.

name: insect pharynx
definition: Section of the insect foregut anterior to the esophagus.

name: insect lymph gland primordium
definition: Primordium of the insect embryo that gives rise to the embryonic/larval lymph gland.

name: insect ventral ectoderm
definition: Ventral part of the insect trunk ectoderm.

name: insect presumptive embryonic/larval tracheal system
definition: The sum of all the structures in the embryo that will develop into the embryonic/larval tracheal system. This corresponds to the tracheal primordia and their component tracheal branch primordia along with primordia of the spiracles.

name: insect Bolwig organ
definition: Visual organ of the larva. It consists of a dense cluster of 12 ciliated photoreceptor neurons.
synonyms_exact: Bolwig's organ|embryonic Bolwig's organ|embryonic visual system|larval Bolwig's organ

name: insect Bolwig organ primordium
definition: Primordium of the insect embryo that gives rise to the larval Bolwig organ.

name: insect arista lateral
definition: A bristle-like, non-innervated outgrowth of the arista. Each lateral is formed from the outgrowth of a single polyploid central core cell.

name: insect pharate adult
definition: The developing adult after pupal-adult apolysis, i.e. from stage P8 (when yellow eye color first becomes visible through the pupal case), to eclosion.

name: insect mesothoracic tergum primordium
definition: Region of the dorsal mesothoracic disc that will develop into the mesothoracic tergum.

name: insect metatarsus of male prothoracic leg
definition: First tarsal segment of the male prothoracic leg. In contrast to females, it has a sex comb, central bristle and 5 to 6 transverse rows of bristles (TR).

name: insect trunk ectoderm
definition: The region of the ectoderm posterior to the cephalic furrow.

name: insect dorsal ectoderm derivative
definition: An insect embryonic structure that develops from the dorsal ectoderm.

name: insect centro-posterior medial synaptic neuropil domain
definition: A synaptic neuropil domain of the larval brain located posterior to the medial lobe of the mushroom body. It is separated from the centro-lateral compartment by the peduncle, and from the centro-posterior intermediate compartment by the antenno-cerebral tract to which it is connected via a branch.
synonyms_exact: centro-posterior medial neuropil|centro-posterior medial synaptic neuropil domain|larval central complex

name: insect presumptive embryonic/larval system
definition: The sum of all the developing presumptive components of a specific embryonic/larval system in an embryo.

name: insect adult protocerebrum
definition: Protocerebrum of the adult brain.

name: segment of antenna
definition: Any appendage segment that is part of some antenna.

name: insect segment of leg
definition: Any appendage segment that is part of some leg.

name: insect external sensillum
definition: Sensillum which is embedded in the body wall and has a specific cuticular structure involved in the transduction of some sensory signal as a part.

name: insect eo-type sensillum
definition: Sensillum with innervated external cuticular sensory structure consisting of one or more bipolar sensory neurons, and 3 support cells: a trichogen cell which makes the external cuticular sensory structure, a thecogen cell which makes the socket that holds the base of the external sensory structure and a tormogen cell which makes the cuticular matrix (cap) at the tip of the innervating dendrite(s).

name: insect internal sensillum
definition: Sensillum that is internal to the animal - i.e. having no part that is part of the cuticle.

name: insect embryonic/larval sensillum
definition: Any sensillum (UBERON:6007152) that is part of some larva (UBERON:6001727).

name: insect embryonic/larval head sensillum
definition: Any sensillum (UBERON:6007152) that is part of some larval head (UBERON:6001730).

name: insect chorionic specialization
definition: Specialized structure of the chorion of the egg.

name: insect embryonic/larval head sense organ
definition: Any sense organ (UBERON:6005155) that is part of some larval head (UBERON:6001730).

name: insect region of integument
definition: A region of cuticle and its underlying epidermis.

name: insect segmental subdivision of integument
definition: A segmental subdivision of the integument of the whole animal.

name: insect segmental subdivision of organ system
definition: The part of some organism that is part of some specified segment.

name: insect internal sense organ
definition: Sense organ that is internal to the animal - i.e. having no part that is part of the cuticle.

name: insect epithelial furrow
definition: A region of an epithelium that folds inwards from the epithelial plane to form a furrow.

name: insect abdominal histoblast primordium
definition: A primordium of the insect embryo that gives rise to the larval abdominal histoblast nests.

name: insect abdominal histoblast anlage
definition: A population of cells of the insect epidermis primordium that give rises to the abdominal histoblast primordium.

name: insect anterior ectoderm derivative
definition: An insect embryonic structure that develops from the anterior ectoderm.

name: insect ventral ectoderm derivative
definition: An insect embryonic structure that develops from the ventral ectoderm.

name: insect trunk mesoderm derivative
definition: An insect embryonic structure that develops from the trunk mesoderm.

name: insect visceral mesoderm derivative
definition: An insect embryonic structure that develops from the visceral mesoderm.

name: insect non-connected developing system
definition: The sum of all the anlagen and primordia that will develop into a single system.

name: insect synaptic neuropil
definition: The part of the neuropil consisting largely of synapsing neuron projections.

name: insect synaptic neuropil domain
definition: Region of synaptic neuropil whose boundaries are largely discontinuities in the density of presynaptic terminals: high density in the synaptic neuropil domain, lower or zero density outside this region. These boundaries often correspond to a boundary with glial sheath, tract neuropil or cortex.

name: insect synaptic neuropil block
definition: A closely associated group of synaptic neuropil domains.

name: insect sensilla row
definition: A row of sensilla.

name: insect adult cerebral ganglion
definition: The pre-oral neuropils of the adult brain located above, around and partially below the esophagus, including the optic lobes. It excludes the gnathal ganglion. Developmentally, it comprises three fused neuromeres: protocerebrum, deutocerebrum, and tritocerebrum.

name: insect presumptive prothoracic metatarsus
definition: Region of the prothoracic leg disc that will develop into the prothoracic metatarsus.

name: insect presumptive arista
definition: Region of the antennal disc that will develop into the arista.

name: proximal-most point of head of femur
definition: The proximal-most point of the head of a femur.

name: proximal-most point of head of humerus
definition: The proximal-most point of the head of a humerus.

name: proximal-most point of ventral tubercle of humerus
definition: The proximal-most point of the ventral tubercle of a humerus.

name: proximal-most point of greater trochanter of femur
definition: The proximal-most point of the greater trochanter of a femur.

name: lower fourth secondary molar tooth
definition: The molar tooth of the lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 4.

name: lower fourth secondary premolar tooth
definition: The premolar tooth of the lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 4.

name: lower third secondary premolar tooth
definition: The premolar tooth of the lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 3.

name: molar tooth 4
definition: The molar tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 4.

name: premolar 3
definition: The premolar tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 3.

name: upper fourth secondary molar tooth
definition: The molar tooth of the upper jaw that is phylogenetically number 4.

name: upper fourth secondary premolar tooth
definition: The premolar tooth of the upper jaw that is phylogenetically number 4.

name: upper third secondary premolar tooth
definition: The premolar tooth of the upper jaw that is phylogenetically number 3.

name: trochlear ridge of humerus
definition: The ridge of the trochlea on a humerus lies in the middle of the distal end of a humerus on the lateral side of the trochlea and the medial side of the capitulum (capitellum).

name: tibial tuberosity
definition: The tibial tuberosity is on the anterior side of a tibia and is where a patella ligament attaches.

name: trochlea of talus
definition: The articular surface of a talus that interacts with a tibia. It has a deep depression that forms the trochlear groove and is bounded by the medial and lateral condyles.
synonyms_exact: trochlea for tibia|trochlea of astragalus|trochlea tali

name: trochlear groove of talus
definition: The furrow between the lateral and medial condyles of the trochlea of talus.

name: condyle of talus
definition: An articular prominence of a talus that engages with the tibia.

name: medial condyle of talus
definition: The medial condyle of talus is an articular prominence of bone on medial side of the trochlea of a talus, which engages with the tibia.

name: lateral condyle of talus
definition: The lateral condyle of talus is an articular prominence of bone on the lateral side of the trochlea of a talus, which engages with the tibia.

name: ridge of medial condyle of talus
definition: The crest of the medial condyle of a talus.
synonyms_exact: ridge of medial condyle of astragalus

name: ridge of lateral condyle of talus
definition: The crest of the lateral condyle of a talus.
synonyms_exact: ridge of lateral condyle of astragalus

name: sulcus tali
definition: A depression that runs between the two facets of a talus that interact with a calcaneum.
synonyms_exact: sulcus for flexor hallucis longus tendon

name: rostrum
definition: An anatomical structure that protrudes from the head region. In vertebrates, this includes the part of the cranium (skull) in front of the zygomatic arches that also holds the teeth, palat, and nasal cavity. In invertebrates it is the forward extension of the carapace and/or the piercing mouthparts.

name: left nasal bone
definition: Nasal bone on the left side of an organism when in anatomical position.

name: right nasal bone
definition: Nasal bone on the right side of an organism when in anatomical position.

name: left zygomatic arch
definition: Zygomatic arch on the left side of an organism when in anatomical position.

name: right zygomatic arch
definition: Zygomatic arch on the right side of an organism when in anatomical position.

name: styloid process of radius
definition: A condyle on the distal end and lateral side of a radius.

name: ulnar notch of radius
definition: A condyle on the distal end and medial side of a radius that interacts with the ulna.

name: articular surface for carpals
definition: The articular surface on the distal end of a radius that interacts with carpals.

name: articular surface for the tibia on the talus
definition: Contact surface between the tibia and the talus located on the talus.

name: greater palatine foramen
definition: A foramen of the skull found at either posterior angle of the hard palate, for the transmission of the descending palatine vessels and greater palatine nerve.

name: lesser palatine foramen
definition: A foramen of the skull found at either posterior angle of the hard palate behind the greater palatine foramen. One or more lesser palatine foramina perforate the pyramidal process of the palatine bone and carry the lesser palatine nerve.

name: endodontium
definition: A pulp-dentin complex or endodont that is part of a calcareous tooth.

name: posterior articular facet for talus of calcaneus
definition: Posterior-most facet on the proximal surface of the calcaneus for the articulation of the talus bone.

name: middle articular facet for talus of calcaneus
definition: Middle facet on the proximal surface of the calcaneus for the articulation of the talus bone.

name: anterior articular facet for talus of calcaneus
definition: Anterior-most facet on the proximal surface of the calcaneus for the articulation of the talus bone.

name: calcaneal body
definition: The calcaneus body is the part of the bone not used for articulation with other bones.

name: tubercle of calcaneus
definition: A raised projection on the calcaneus.

name: lateral tubercle of calcaneus
definition: A raised projection on the lateral side of a calcaneus.

name: medial tubercle of calcaneus
definition: A raised projection on the medial side of a calcaneus.

name: antorbital notch
definition: The antorbital notch is a prominence of bone located anterolaterally of the antorbital fenestra.

name: preorbital bone region
definition: Part of the orbital plate formed by the jugal (part of the zygomatic), lacrimal (which is sometimes fused), sometimes nasal (typically in species with elongated rostra), and maxilla bones anterior to the orbit.

name: preorbital fossa
definition: A hollow (fossa) in the preorbital region, typically lying on the maxillary bone, although sometimes can touch nasal bones (e.g., modern Equus).

name: coracoid process of calcaneus
definition: At the dorsal part of the base of the calcaneal tuberoisty is a pointed process called the coracoid process.

name: hormion
definition: A craniometric point at the junction of the posterior midline border of the vomer with the sphenoid bone on the sphenovomerine suture.

name: sphenovomerine suture
definition: A suture joining a sphenoid bone with the alae of a vomer to form a schindylesis type of joint.

name: cheek tooth
definition: Any of the post-canine teeth, which are the multicuspidate molars or premolars used for shearing and grinding food in mammals.

name: basion
definition: An anatomical point on the antero-ventral margin of foramen magnum in the median plane.

name: synsphenion
definition: A craniometric point on the ventral surface of the intersphenoid suture, along the midline of the skull.

name: intersphenoid suture
definition: A suture joining the basisphenoid bone and the presphenoid bone of a sphenoid bone.

name: prosthion
definition: A craniometric point that is the most anterior point in the midline on the alveolar process of the maxilla between the incisors (premaxilla bone).

name: akrokranion
definition: The most dorsoanterior point on the supraoccipital crest in the medial plane.

name: cheek tooth row
definition: An anatomical row consisting of adjacent cheek teeth.

name: sagittal crest
definition: A ridge or similar projection rising above the surface of an anatomical strucuture along the sagittal (midline) plane.

name: opisthocranion
definition: A craniometric point which is the furthest point from the glabella along the midline.

name: opisthion
definition: A craniometric point at the posterior margin of the foramen magnum along the midline.

name: ectorbitale
definition: An anatomical point on the most lateral point of the frontal bone of tetrapods on the occipital side of the orbit.

name: zygion
definition: The most lateral anatomical point of the zygomatic arch.

name: paroccipital process
definition: A process of bone extending downward from the jugular process of the occipital bone.

name: incisor tooth 3
definition: The incisor tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 3.

name: incisor tooth 4
definition: The incisor tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 4.

name: incisor tooth 5
definition: The incisor tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 5.

name: molar tooth 5
definition: The molar tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 5.

name: otion
definition: The most lateral anatomical point on the mastoid process of temporal bone.

name: cranial temporal crest
definition: A ridge or similar projection connected to the temporal lines and nuchal crest on the squamous part of the occipital bone. It bounds the posteroventral part of the temporal fossa.

name: first instar larva stage
definition: The first stage of instar larva stage.

name: second instar larva stage
definition: The second stage of instar larva stage.

name: third instar larva stage
definition: The third stage of instar larva stage.

name: fourth instar larva stage
definition: The fourth stage of instar larva stage.

name: central retina
definition: Region of retina around the fovea that extends approximately for 6 mm. Central retina is considerably thick due to increased density of photoreceptors, particularly cones and their associated bipolar and ganglion cells.

name: Henle's fiber layer
definition: This layer contains bundles of unmyelinated cone and rod photoreceptor axons terminating in the pedicles and spherules that synapse in the retinal outer plexiform layer (OPL).
synonyms_exact: Henle fiber layer|HFL|nerve fiber layer of Henle

name: left side of back
definition: Left part of the organism dorsal to a horizontal plane and bounded on one side by the same transverse plane.

name: right side of back
definition: Right part of the organism dorsal to a horizontal plane and bounded on one side by the same transverse plane.

name: cementocyte lacuna
definition: The small cavity within the cellular cementum that is occupied by a cementocyte cell body.

name: Purkinje fiber network
definition: A collection of Purkinje fibers that receives signals from the right and left bundle branches and innervates the ventricular cardiac muscle. The Purkinje fiber network creates synchronized contractions of the heart ventricles.

name: copepodite stage 1
definition: A development stage of copepods which immediately follows the nauplius stage. It is characterized by the presence of 2 swimming legs.

name: copepodite stage 2
definition: A development stage of copepods which immediately follows copepodite stage 1. It is characterized by the presence of 3 swimming legs.

name: copepodite stage 3
definition: A development stage of copepods which immediately follows copepodite stage 2. It is characterized by the presence of 4 swimming legs.

name: copepodite stage 4
definition: A development stage of copepods which immediately follows copepodite stage 3. It is characterized by the presence of 5 swimming legs.

name: copepodite stage 5
definition: A pre-adult stage of copepods which immediately follows copepodite stage 4. It is characterized by enlargement of the urosome and development of sexual organs.

name: copepodite stage 6
definition: A fully formed stage of copepods which immediately follows copepodite stage 5. It is characterized by the complete development of the fifth swimming leg.

name: skin of scalp
definition: A zone of skin that is part of a scalp.
synonyms_exact: adult scalp zone of skin|scalp skin|scalp zone of skin|zone of skin of adult scalp|zone of skin of scalp

name: right forelimb
definition: A forelimb that is on the right side of a pectoral complex.

name: left forelimb
definition: A forelimb that is on the left side of a pectoral complex.

name: right hindlimb
definition: A hindlimb that is on the right side of a pelvic complex.

name: left hindlimb
definition: A hindlimb that is on the left side of a pelvic complex.

name: hepatic acinus zone 1
definition: The region of the hepatic acinus that is closest to the arterial blood supply and has the highest oxygen concentration. Zone 1 is located in the periportal region of the liver lobule, closest to the portal triad. Hepatocytes in this region are primarily involved in oxidative energy metabolism.

name: hepatic acinus zone 3
definition: The region of the hepatic acinus immediately surrounding the central veins. This region has the lowest oxygen concentration in the acinus. Zone 3 is located in the centrilobular region of the liver lobule, closest to the central vein. Hepatocytes in this region are the primary location for the biotransformation of drugs.
synonyms_exact: hepatic acinus centrilobular zone|hepatic acinus pericentral zone|hepatic acinus perivenous zone

name: hepatic acinus zone 2
definition: The region of the hepatic acinus in between zones 1 and 3. Blood in this region has an intermediate oxygen concentration relative to the other two zones of the hepatic acinus. Zone 2 is located in the midzonal region of the liver lobule. Hepatocytes in this region have mixed functionality in comparison with those in zones 1 and 3.

name: metabolic zone of liver
definition: Any of the metabolic zones found in the liver. Liver tissue is heterogenous at the level of morphometry and histochemistry. This heterogeneity is linked to the position of a cell within the functional unit of the tissue, which, in turn, is related to the blood supply: cells located in the upstream zone differ from those in the downstream zone with respect to subcellular structures, key enzymes, translocators, and receptors and, therefore, have different metabolic capacities. This is the basis for 'metabolic zonation', a concept first proposed in mammals for carbohydrate metabolism and later expanded to include amino acid and ammonia metabolism, xenobiotic metabolism, protective metabolism, and formation of plasma proteins.

name: liver lobule periportal region
definition: The region of the liver lobule that is closest to the portal triad. The functionally-defined hepatic acinus zone 1 is generally found in this region.

name: liver lobule centrilobular region
definition: The region of the liver lobule that is closest to the central vein. The functionally-defined hepatic acinus zone 3 is generally found in this region.

name: liver lobule midzonal region
definition: The region of the liver lobule that is between the periportal and centrilobular regions. The functionally-defined hepatic acinus zone 2 is generally found in this region.

name: liver serosa
definition: Hepatic serous coat; peritoneal covering of the liver, enclosing almost all except for a triangular area on its posterior surface (the 'bare area of the liver') and a smaller area where the liver and gallbladder are in direct contact.

name: liver subserosa
definition: Subserosal tissue of liver. A zone of areolar connective tissue lying beneath the serous coat of the liver and distinguished with difficulty from the fibrous capsule of Glisson.
synonyms_exact: hepatic subserosa|subserosal tissue of liver|subserous layer of liver|tela subserosa (hepar)|tela subserosa hepatis

name: subcapsular region of liver
definition: Region of liver parenchyma immediately below the capsule. This region is frequently specified in pathology diagnoses.
synonyms_exact: liver subcapsular region|liver subcapsular tissue|subcapsular tissue of liver

name: duodeno-jejunal junction
definition: The anatomical junction between the duodenum and the jejunum.

name: small intestine venule
definition: Venule of villus of small intestine.

name: small intestine lymphatic vessel
definition: A lymphatic vessel that supplies the small intestine.

name: ductal plate
definition: In human, ductal plate is a double-layered cylindrical structure of bile duct epithelium that surrounds the portal ramifications by the eighth gestational week. After approximately the 12th gestational week, remodelling of ductal plate begins, and maturity is attained by the end of gestation or early postnatal period.

name: small intestine arteriole
definition: Arteriole of villus of small intestine.
synonyms_exact: arteriole of small intestine|arteriole of villus of small intestine|small intestine villus arteriole

name: transitional glandular epithelium of anorectum
definition: Glandular epithelium of the anal transition zone. The anal transition zone is defined loosely as the tissue interposed between the uninterrupted squamous epithelium of the anoderm and the uninterrupted mucosal epithelium of the anal canal in the anorectum.
synonyms_exact: anorectum transitional glandular epithelium|glandular epithelium of anal transition zone|glandular epithelium of the anal transition zone

name: submucous nerve plexus of anorectum
definition: Submucous nerve plexus that is located in the anorectum.

name: myenteric nerve plexus of anorectum
definition: Myenteric nerve plexus that is located in the anorectum.

name: venule of anorectum
definition: A venule that is located in the anorectum.

name: arteriole of anorectum
definition: An arteriole that is located in the anorectum.

name: fimbria of fallopian tube
definition: A fringe of tissue around the ostium of the fallopian tube, in the direction of the ovary.
synonyms_exact: fimbria of uterine tube|fimbriae of fallopian tube|fimbriae of uterine tube

name: myenteric nerve plexus of appendix
definition: Myenteric nerve plexus that is located in the vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: myenteric nerve plexus of appendix vermiformis|myenteric nerve plexus of vermiform appendix

name: submucous nerve plexus of appendix
definition: Submucous nerve plexus that is located in the vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: submucous nerve plexus of appendix vermiformis|submucous nerve plexus of vermiform appendix

name: afferent lymphatic vessel valve
definition: A valve in an afferent lymphatic vessel. It manages the flow of lymphatic fluid into the lymph node carrying immune cells and is essential for the correct flow of fluid through the lymphatic system.

name: efferent lymphatic vessel valve
definition: A valve in an efferent lymphatic vessel. It manages the flow of lymphatic fluid out of the lymph node carrying immune cells and is essential for the correct flow of fluid through the lymphatic system.

name: arteriole of colon
definition: An arteriole located in the colon.

name: descending sigmoid junction
definition: The anatomical junction between the descending colon and the sigmoid colon.

name: left colic vein
definition: A portal vein that drains the descending colon. It is a tributary of the inferior mesenteric vein, and follows the path of its corresponding artery, the left colic artery.

name: right colic vein
definition: A portal vein that drains the ascending colon. It is a tributary of the superior mesenteric vein, and travels with its corresponding artery, the right colic artery.

name: jejuno-ileal junction
definition: The area where the jejunum ends and the ileum part of the intestine begins. Although there is no clear distinct section, the ileum is narrower and has smaller villi than the jejunum.

name: venule of appendix
definition: A venule located in the vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: venule of vermiform appendix|vermiform appendix venule

name: inguinal region skin
definition: The skin covering the inguinal region between the abdomen and the thigh on either side of the pubic bone.
synonyms_exact: groin skin|inguinal skin|skin of groin|skin of inguinal region|zone of skin of groin|zone of skin of inguinal region

name: left colic artery
definition: The first branch of the inferior mesenteric artery (IMA) is the left colic artery. The left colic artery supplies blood flow to the distal third of the transverse colon and the entirety of the descending colon. Once diverging from the IMA, the left colic artery runs anterior to the left ureter, left internal spermatic vessels (males), and psoas major before branching into its ascending and descending segments.

name: right colic artery
definition: The right colic artery may arise directly from the superior mesenteric artery (SMA) but often arises from a common trunk with the ileocolic artery or middle colic artery. It supplies the ascending colon.

name: intestinal junction
definition: An anatomical junction between two parts of the intestine.

name: transition zone of prostate
definition: The region of the prostate gland anterior to the central and peripheral zones, surrounding the proximal urethra. It is the zone of the human prostate gland that grows the most throughout life, and is responsible for benign prostatic hypertrophy.

name: peripheral zone of prostate
definition: The region of the prostate that is located posterior to the central and transition zones, surrounding the distal urethra. It is the zone of origin for the vast majority of human prostatic cancers.

name: central zone of prostate
definition: The region of the prostate gland that is located between the peripheral and transition zones, surrounding the ejaculatory ducts. It gives rise to a very small percentage of human prostate cancers, often aggressive and invading the seminal vesicles.

name: arteriole of appendix
definition: An arteriole located in the vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: appendix vermiformis arteriole|arteriole of appendix vermiformis|arteriole of vermiform appendix|vermiform appendix arteriole

name: lymphatic capillary of appendix
definition: A lymphatic capillary that is located in the vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: lymphatic capillary of appendix vermiformis|lymphatic capillary of vermiform appendix

name: lymphatic vessel of appendix
definition: A lymphatic vessel located in the vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: lymphatic vessel of appendix vermiformis|lymphatic vessel of vermiform appendix

name: muscularis mucosae of appendix
definition: A muscularis mucosa that is part of a vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: muscularis mucosae of appendix vermiformis|muscularis mucosae of vermiform appendix

name: trabecular sinus of lymph node
definition: The trabecular sinus is the lymph-filled space outside the trabeculae between lobules of the lymph node. This is a continuation of the subcapsular sinus which receives the afferent vessels and is present beneath the capsule. This space is traversed by both reticular fibers and cells in the lymph.

name: lymph node vein
definition: A vein where lymph node venules condense and which exits at the lymph node hilum. It is also called hilar vein.
synonyms_exact: hilar vein of lymph node|vein of lymph node

name: lymph node artery
definition: An artery that enters the lymph node at the hilum and branches into smaller arterioles.
synonyms_exact: artery of lymph node|hilar artery of lymph node

name: medullary arteriole of lymph node
definition: An arteriole that arises from the hilar artery of a lymph node and radiates centrifugally, branching in the medulla.
synonyms_exact: arteriole of medulla of lymph node

name: medullary venule of lymph node
definition: Medullary venules are a continuation of high endothelial venules which condense repeatedly in the interfollicular cortex and peripheral deep cortical unit and then transition to medullary venules at the corticomedullary junction. The medullary venules condense and return centripetally to the hilar vein.
synonyms_exact: venule of medulla of lymph node

name: high endothelial venule
definition: High endothelial venules are specialized blood vessels adapted for lymphocyte trafficking. They form a spatially organized network, which controls both the type of lymphocyte and the site of entry into lymphoid tissues. Uniquely, high endothelial venules express vascular addressins that regulate lymphocyte entry into lymphoid organs. They perform this function in all lymphoid organs except the spleen.

name: high endothelial venule of lymph node
definition: A high endothelial venule that is part of a of lymph node.

name: high endothelial venule of appendix
definition: A high endothelial venule that is located in the vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: appendix high endothelial venule|high endothelial venule of appendix vermiformis|high endothelial venule of vermiform appendix

name: high endothelial venule of small intestine Peyer's patch
definition: A high endothelial venule that is located in a Peyer's patch in the small intestine.
synonyms_exact: high endothelial venule of Peyer's patch of small intestine

name: venule of lymph node
definition: A venule that is part of a lymph node.

name: arteriole of lymph node
definition: An arteriole that is part of a lymph node.

name: bronchus submucosal gland
definition: A submucosal gland located in a bronchus.
synonyms_exact: bronchial submucosal gland|submucosal bronchial gland|submucosal bronchus gland

name: vein of appendix
definition: A vein that is part of a vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: vein of appendix vermiformis|vein of vermiform appendix

name: artery of appendix
definition: An artery that is part of a vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: artery of appendix vermiformis|artery of vermiform appendix

name: appendix smooth muscle circular layer
definition: A circular muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a vermiform appendix smooth muscle.
synonyms_exact: smooth muscle circular layer of appendix|smooth muscle circular layer of appendix vermiformis|smooth muscle circular layer of vermiform appendix

name: appendix smooth muscle longitudinal layer
definition: A longitudinal muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a vermiform appendix smooth muscle.
synonyms_exact: smooth muscle longitudinal layer of appendix|smooth muscle longitudinal layer of appendix vermiformis|smooth muscle longitudinal layer of vermiform appendix

name: venule of colon
definition: A venule located in the colon.

name: serosal nerve fiber of appendix
definition: A nerve fiber that is located in the serosa of vermiform appendix.
synonyms_exact: nerve fiber of serosa of appendix|nerve fibre of serosa of appendix|serosal nerve fiber of appendix vermiformis|serosal nerve fiber of vermiform appendix|serosal nerve fibre of appendix|serosal nerve fibre of appendix vermiformis|serosal nerve fibre of vermiform appendix

name: anorectum
definition: A subdivision of the digestive tract in humans that includes the rectum, the anal canal and the anus.

name: lymphatic vessel of colon
definition: A lymphatic vessel located in the colon.

name: lymph node germinal center light zone
definition: Lymph node germinal centers contain two microenvironments: the light zone and the dark zone. The light zone is sparsely populated with B cells and includes additional cell types such as follicular dendritic cells, lymph node tingible macrophages and T follicular helper cells.
synonyms_exact: light zone of lymph node germinal center

name: lymph node germinal center dark zone
definition: Lymph node germinal centers contain two microenvironments: the light zone and the dark zone. The dark zone is densely populated with B cell blasts and reticular cells.
synonyms_exact: dark zone of lymph node germinal center

name: lymphatic capillary of colon
definition: A lymphatic capillary located in the colon.

name: lymphatic capillary of anorectum
definition: A lymphatic capillary located in the anorectum.

name: capillary of anorectum
definition: A capillary that is part of the anorectum.

name: capillary of colon
definition: A capillary that is part of the colon.

name: myenteric nerve plexus of colon
definition: Myenteric nerve plexus that is located in the colon.

name: submucous nerve plexus of colon
definition: Submucous nerve plexus that is located in the colon.

name: colon smooth muscle circular layer
definition: A circular muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a colon smooth muscle.
synonyms_exact: smooth muscle circular layer of colon

name: colon smooth muscle longitudinal layer
definition: A longitudinal muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a colon smooth muscle.
synonyms_exact: smooth muscle longitudinal layer of colon

name: parasympathetic cholinergic nerve
definition: A parasympathetic nerve that releases acetylcholine.

name: myenteric nerve plexus of small intestine
definition: Myenteric nerve plexus that is part of the small intestine.

name: submucous nerve plexus of small intestine
definition: Submucous nerve plexus that is located in the small intestine.

name: lymph node follicle marginal zone
definition: Histologically, the marginal zone pattern of the lymph node is characterized by lymphoid follicles with three distinct layers. The inner layer is composed of follicular center zones, the middle layer of darkly stained mantle zones, and the outer layer of marginal zones. However, the marginal zone pattern is rarely seen in reactive lymph nodes except for mesenteric lymph nodes. Lymph node marginal zones are populated by marginal zone B cells which express CD19 and CD20 and have the phenotypic features of memory B cells.
synonyms_exact: marginal zone of lymph node follicle

name: lymph node paracortex
definition: The lymph node paracortex is the middle layer of the lymph node and is mostly populated by T cells and dendritic cells. The paracortex also contains specialised blood vessels called high endothelial venules which allow lymphocytes to enter the node.

name: lymph node interfollicular cortex
definition: Follicules in the lymph node are surrounded and separated by the interfollicular cortex. Together with the lymph node follicle, the interfollicular cortex of the lymph node lobule make up the superficial cortex of the lymph node. Capillaries empty into the high endothelial venules located in the interfollicular cortex. The interfollicular cortex also serves as transit corriders for lymphocytes migrating between the B and T cell areas.

name: capillary of small intestine
definition: A capillary that is part of a small intestine.
synonyms_exact: blood vessel capillary of small intestine|small intestine capillary

name: lymphoid nodule
definition: Lymphoid tissue found in some birds and similar, but not identical, to mammalian lymph nodes.

name: levator costarum
definition: A chest muscle with a role in forceful inspiration. In human, there are twelve levatores costarum on either side of the chest; they are small tendinous and fleshy bundles arising from the ends of the transverse processes of the seventh cervical and upper eleven thoracic vertebrae. They pass obliquely downward and laterally, like the fibers of the intercostales externi, and each is inserted into the outer surface of the rib immediately below the vertebra from which it takes origin, between the tubercle and the angle (levatores costarum breves). Each of the four lower muscles divides into two fasciculi, one of which is inserted as above described; the other passes down to the second rib below its origin (levatores costarum longi).
synonyms_exact: levator costarum muscle|levatores costarum|levatores costarum muscles|musculi levatores costarum

name: subcapsular sinus ceiling
definition: The section of the lymph node capsule that faces the subcapsular sinus. In human, it's characterized by specific protein markers.
synonyms_exact: ceiling of subcapsular sinus of lymph node|floor of capsule of lymph node|subcapsular sinus of lymph node ceiling

name: subcapsular sinus floor
definition: The section of the lymph node cortex that faces the subcapsular sinus. In human, it's characterized by specific protein markers.
synonyms_exact: ceiling of cortex of lymph node|floor of subcapsular sinus of lymph node|subcapsular sinus of lymph node floor

name: medullary region of kidney
definition: A part of the kidney that comprises kidney pyramids and renal columns.

name: lymph node paracortical sinus
definition: A lymph node sinus intimately associated with paracortical cords that originate in the interfollicular cortex and extend into the medullary cords.

name: lymph node paracortical cord
definition: Lymph node paracortical parenchyma containing dense networks of T cells, B cells, fibroblastic reticular cells, and dendritic cells.

name: glomus coccygeum
definition: A glomus-like dermal microanatomical structure found in human and placed in front of, or immediately below, the tip of the coccyx. Each glomus consists of one or more arterial segments that branch into a number of glomic arterioles surrounded by rows of round, uniform, epithelioid contractile cells, that drain into a collecting venous plexus.
synonyms_exact: coccygeal body|coccygeal gland|coccygeal glomus|gland of Luschka|glands of Luschka|glomus body|Luschka's gland

name: airway submucosal gland
definition: A submucosal gland found in a respiratory tract.
synonyms_exact: respiratory tract submucosal gland|submucosal gland of respiratory tract

name: right lymphatic duct
definition: A great lymphatic vessel that empties lymph into one of the subclavian veins. In humans, there are two lymph ducts in the body: the right lymphatic duct and the thoracic duct. The right lymphatic duct drains lymph from the right upper limb, right side of thorax and right halves of head and neck. The thoracic duct drains lymph into the circulatory system at the left brachiocephalic vein between the left subclavian and left internal jugular veins.

name: red bone marrow of iliac crest
definition: Red bone marrow located in an iliac crest.

name: red bone marrow of sternum
definition: Red bone marrow located in the sternum.

name: blood microvessel
definition: Any of the smallest blood vessels where blood circulates within organ tissues. Microvessels include terminal arterioles, metarterioles, capillaries, and venules (but exclude lymphatic capillaries). Arterioles carry oxygenated blood to the capillaries, and blood flows out of the capillaries through venules into veins.

name: hair of scalp
definition: Hair that grows on the scalp.

name: ethmoidal vein
definition: A vein that accompanies an ethmoidal artery and drains the ethmoidal cells.

name: anterior ethmoidal vein
definition: An ethmoidal vein that accompanies an anterior ethmoidal artery. The anterior ethmoidal vein normally drains into the inferior root of the superior ophthalmic vein.

name: posterior ethmoidal vein
definition: An ethmoidal vein that accompanies a posterior ethmoidal artery. The posterior ethmoidal vein often drains into a venous network under the orbital roof.

name: cortical layer II/III
definition: A laminar subdivision of the neocortex that is comprised of a part of layer II and a part of layer III.

name: cortical layer IV/V
definition: A laminar subdivision of the neocortex that is comprised of a part of layer IV and a part of layer V.

name: cortical layer V/VI
definition: A laminar subdivision of the neocortex that is comprised of a part of layer V and a part of layer VI.

name: cortical layer VIb
definition: The deepest layer of the neocortex. While layer 6b is considered part of layer 6, it is distinct morphologically, genetically, and developmentally from the rest of layer 6. Neurons in L6b project to cortical targets and higher-order thalamus and develop from a precursor population that arises from the subplate.

name: laminar subdivision of the cortex
definition: One or a subset of adjacent layers of the neocortex.

name: rostral periventricular region of the third ventricle
definition: A functional anatomical construct containing the key estrogen-regulated inputs to gonadotropin-releasing hormone expressing (GnRH) neurons necessary for estrogen positive feedback. The rostral periventricular region of the third ventricle contains a population of neurons, scattered through the nuclei of the anteroventral periventricular (AVPV), periventricular preoptic (PVpo), and median preoptic (MEPO), that project directly to GnRH neurons and express ER-alpha.

name: periventricular hypothalamic nucleus, anterior part
definition: The anterior part of the periventricular hypothalamic nucleus.

name: periventricular hypothalamic nucleus, intermediate part
definition: The intermediate part of the periventricular hypothalamic nucleus.

name: Brodmann (1909) area 17
definition: A subdivision of the cytoarchitecturally defined occipital region of cerebral cortex in the human. Defined by the band of Gennari, which gives it the name striate (furrowed) area, it occupies the banks of the calcarine sulcus which are located in the cuneus and the lingual gyrus of the occipital lobe. Cytoarchitecturally it is bounded by the area 18 of Brodmann (human) which surrounds it ( Brodmann-1909 ). In the mouse ( Paxinos-2001 ) and the rat ( Swanson-1998 ) it is located on the dorsolateral surface of the cerebral hemisphere[BrainInfo].
synonyms_exact: area 17 of Brodmann-1909|b09-17|BA17|Brodmann area 17|Brodmann area 17, striate|primate striate cortex

name: cortical visual area
definition: The part of the cortex that is responsible for processing visual information.

name: cerebral nuclei
definition: One of three components of the cerebrum that is a composite structure of the endbrain defined on the basis of origin from the ventricular ridge of the embryonic Encephalon. It consists of the extended striatum and the extended pallidum.

name: fasciola cinerea
definition: A small paired band that passes around the splenium of the corpus callosum from the lateral longitudinal stria to the dentate gyrus. The FC exhibits clear anatomical borders with the distalmost region of the CA1.

name: ventrolateral preoptic nucleus
definition: A small cluster of neurons situated in the anterior hypothalamus, sitting just above and to the side of the optic chiasm in the brain of humans and other animals.
synonyms_exact: intermediate nucleus of the preoptic area (IPA)|VLPO

name: noradrenergic cell groups
definition: Collections of neurons in the central nervous system that have been demonstrated by histochemical fluorescence to contain the neurotransmitter norepinephrine (noradrenalin).

name: noradrenergic cell group A1
definition: A group of cells in the vicinity of the lateral reticular nucleus of the medullary reticular formation that label for norepinephrine in primates.

name: noradrenergiccell group A2
definition: A group of cells in the vicinity of the dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus nerve in the medulla that label for norepinephrine in primates and rodents.

name: noradrenergic cell group A4
definition: A group of cells exhibiting noradrenergic fluorescence that, in the rat, are located in the Tegmen ventriculi quarti (roof of the fourth ventricle) ventral to the cerebellar nuclei, and in the macaque, are found at the edge of the lateral recess of the fourth ventricle caudally, extending to beneath the floor of the ventricle where they merge with the noradrenergic group A6, the locus ceruleus.

name: noradrenergic cell group A5
definition: A group of cells in the vicinity of the superior olivary complex in the pontine tegmentum that label for norepinephine in primates, rodents, and other mammals.

name: noradrenergic cell group A7
definition: A group of cells fluorescent for norepinephrine that is located in the pontine reticular formation ventral to the superior cerebellar peduncle of the pons in rodents and in primates.

name: noradrenergic cell group A6sc
definition: A group of cells fluorescent for norepinephrine that are scattered in the nucleus subceruleus of the macaque.

name: noradrenergic cell group Acg
definition: A group of cells fluorescent for norepinephrine that are located in the central gray of the midbrain at the level of the trochlear nucleus in the squirrel monkey (Saimiri) and to a lesser degree in the macaque.

name: visceral area
definition: A cortical area between the agranular insular cortex and the supplemental somatosensory area in rats and mice. The VISC is the architectonically equivalent structure granular insula in humans.

name: parapyramidal nucleus
definition: A small group of cells located lateral to the pyramid of the medulla in the rat and the mouse that functionally it belongs to the reticular formation of the subcortical motor system.

name: parapyramidal nucleus, deep part
definition: The part of the parapyramidal nucleus that is closely adjacent to the inner surface of the pyramidal tract.

name: parapyramidal nucleus, superficial part
definition: The part of the parapyramidal nucleus that is located on the ventral surface of the medulla lateral to the pyramidal tract.

name: Perihypoglossal nuclei
definition: A group of neurons in the floor of the fourth ventricle, in close proximity to the nucleus of the hypoglossal nerve in the gray substance of the medulla oblongata, all of which contain cells with characteristics suggestive of reticular connections.
synonyms_exact: nuclei perihypoglossales|perihypoglossal complex|perihypoglossal nuclear complex|PHY|satellite nuclei

name: rubroreticular tract
definition: Nerve fibers that originate in the magnocellular red nucleus, cross to the other side of the midbrain, and descend in the lateral part of the brainstem tegmentum in the midbrain, and travel through the lateral funiculus of the spinal cord, coursing adjacent to the lateral corticospinal tract.

name: striatum-like amygdalar nuclei
definition: A part of the striatum which is primarilly composed of amygdalar areas. The sAMY is composed of the anterior amygdalar area, central amygdalar nucleus, intercalated amygdalar nucleus, medial amygdalar nucleus, and the bed nucleus of the accessory olfactory tract.

name: medial corticohypothalmic tract
definition: The main route taken by fibers from the ventral subiculum to the hypothalamus, where they innervate the medial preoptic area, “shell” of the ventromedial nucleus, dorsomedial nucleus, ventral premammillary  nucleus, and cell-poor zone around the medial mammillary nucleus.

name: prelimbic area
definition: A region in the medial prefrontal cortex that is dorsal to the infralimbic area important in expression of conditioned reward and fear behaviour.

name: infralimbic area
definition: A region in the medial prefrontal cortex that is ventral to the prelimbic area important in supression of conditioned reward and fear behaviour.

name: bulbocerebellar tract
definition: A subdivision of inferior cerebellar peduncle that connects the medulla to the cerebellum.

name: sublaterodorsal nucleus
definition: A region in the dorsal pons that plays a central role in inducing motor suppression during REM sleep.

name: supratrigeminal nucleus
definition: A premotoneuron pool in the trigeminal reflex arc that is a key structure of jaw movement control.

name: accessory facial motor nucleus
definition: A small cluster of neurons dorsal to the facial motor nucleus in the pontine tegmentum.

name: efferent vestibular nucleus
definition: A small region of neurons in the brainstem, dorsolateral to the genu of facial nerve, that have efferents to the vestibular periphery.

name: piriform-amygdalar area
definition: The cortical region between the cortical amygdalar area and the piriform area.

name: dorsal peduncular area
definition: A cytoarchitectonic area on the medial surface of the cerebral hemisphere rostral to the septum, ventral to the infralimbic area and dorsal to the tenia tecta in the mouse and rat.

name: tuberal nucleus (sensu Rodentia)
definition: A hypothalamic region in rodents that is homologous to the lateral tuberal nucleus in humans and higher primates and is involved in energy homeostasis.

name: nucleus lateralis tuberis system (sensu Teleostei)
definition: A prominent nucleus located in the ventral tuberal area of Teleostei that is anatomically homologous to the hypothalamic arcuate (infundibular)-median eminence (ME) system of tetrpods.

name: superior paraolivary nucleus
definition: A structure embedded in the superior olivary complex that is driven by input pathways from the octopus cells in the cochlear nucleus and the neurons of the medial nucleus of the trapezoid body.

name: upper layers of the cortex
definition: A laminar subdivision of the neocortex that is comprised of the more surface layers, commonly layers two through four.

name: second visual cortical area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret that is rostral to area 17, caudal to area 19 and also abuts PPc and area 20a.

name: third visual cortical area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret located rostral to area 18 and caudal to area 21.

name: fourth visual cortical area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret that is caudal to the suprasylvian visual areas and rostral to area 19.

name: temporal visual area a (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret that is posterior to area 20b and lies lateral to areas 17, 18, and 19.

name: temporal visual area b (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret that is posterior to area PS and anterior to 20a.

name: posterior parietal rostral cortical area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A multimodal area of the ferret involved in vision and somatosensation that lies between the medial wall of the hemisphere and the medial lip of the suprasylvian sulcus and is posterior to caudal somatosensory cortex (SIII) and anterior to PPc.
synonyms_exact: posterior parietal cortex, rostral part (sensu Mustela putorius furo)|PPr (sensu Mustela putorius furo)

name: lower layers of the cortex
definition: A laminar subdivision of the neocortex that is comprised of the deeper layers, commonly layers five and six, however, could also consist part of layer four.

name: posterior parietal caudal cortical area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret that  lies between the medial wall of the hemisphere and the medial lip of the suprasylvian sulcus and is posterior to PPr and anterior to area 18 (on the lateral gyrus) and area 21 (on the suprasylvian gyrus).
synonyms_exact: posterior parietal cortex, caudal part (sensu Mustela putorius furo)|PPc (sensu Mustela putorius furo)

name: anteromedial lateral suprasylvian visual area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret that lies medial to the fundus in the suprasylvian sulcus, posterior to the MRSS and anterior to the PMLS.

name: anterolateral lateral suprasylvian visual area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret that lies on the lateral bank of the suprasylvian sulcus, posterior to SIII, anterior to area PLLS and medial to A1.

name: dorsal lateral suprasylvian visual cortical area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret located in the lateral bank of the suprasylvian sulcus anterior to VLS and posterior to PLLS.

name: ventral lateral suprasylvian visual area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret located in the medial bank of the suprasylvian sulvus lateral to area PMLS.

name: posterior suprasylvian visual cortical area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret that is lateral to the occipital visual areas (area 17, 18, 19 and 21), medial to perirhinal cortex and anterior to area 20b.

name: anterior ectosylvian visual area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A multimodal area in the ferret responsive to visual, somatic, and auditory stimuli. name: spenial visual area (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A visual area in the ferret located on the dorsal bank of the splenial sulcus between the medial border of area 17 and the lateral borter of CVA.

name: A lamina of the lateral geniculate nucleus (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A major laminae of the lateral geniculate nucleus of the ferret receiving crossed retinal inputs, located medial to the C laminae and lateral to the A1 and P laminae.

name: A1 lamina of the lateral geniculate nucleus (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A major laminae of the lateral geniculate nucleus of the ferret receiving uncrossed retinal inputs, located medial to the C and A laminae (Linden, Guillery & Cucchiaro, 1981)

name: C lamina of the lateral geniculate nucleus (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: The most lateral laminae of the LGN of the ferret. The C laminae includes the C lamina, which is the innermost layer, followed by C1, C2, and C3 being the outermost lamina.

name: Perigeniculate lamina of the lateral geniculate nucleus (sensu Mustela putorius furo)
definition: A lamina of the LGN in the ferret located medial to the A lamina in the rostral regions of the visual thalamus ((Linden, Guillery & Cucchiaro, 1981; Dell, Innocenti, Hilgetag, & Manger, 2019).

name: lateral tegmental nucleus
definition: A nucleus of the brain that is embedded in the pontine tegmentum, it is defined on the basis of inputs from the lateral hypothalamic area and central amygdalar nucleus, it is located ventral to the locus ceruleus, dorsal to Barrington's nucleus, lateral to the laterodorsal tegmental nucleus, and medial to the midbrain trigeminal nucleus.

name: magnocellular reticular nucleus
definition: A nucleus of the brain that is the most ventral portion of the gigantocellular nucleus in the medullary reticular formation, between the lateral paragigantocellular nucleus and the midline or nucleus raphe magnus. Functionally it belongs to the reticular formation (functional) of the subcortical motor system.

name: interstitial nucleus of the vestibular nerve
definition: A cluster of large nerve cells distributed in the vestibular component of vestibulocochlear nerve fibers that functionally belong to the vestibulomotor regions of the behavioral control column.

name: gustatory cortex
definition: The part of the cerebral cortex that is responsible for the perception of taste.

name: somatomotor area
definition: A part of the cerebral cortex that comprises of the primary motor cortex and the premotor cortex.

name: rhinal incisure
definition: A fissure in the cerebral cortex that separates the tenia tecta rostrally from the orbital gyri and caudally from the infralimbic cortex

name: egg follicle
definition: An individual reproductive unit containing a single oocyte and one or several layers of support cells (Armstrong et al., 2020).

name: excretory system
definition: An anatomical system that eliminates waste products that arise as a result of metabolic activity.

name: embryonic craniocervical region
definition: A craniocervical region that is part of an embryo.

name: placental blood
definition: Blood located in the placenta.

name: sublumbar lymph node
definition: A lymph node with a lymph center located within the caudal abdomen and pelvis, on the ventral side of the lumbar region. Includes the medial iliac, internal iliac (previously termed hypogastric) and sacral lymph nodes.

name: moderator band
definition: A muscular trabecula in the right ventricle of the heart that connects the interventricular septum to the anterior wall and to the base of the anterior papillary muscle of the right ventricle.

name: perianal space
definition: An anatomical space located at the level of the anal orifice that is continuous with the ischioanal space laterally and superiorly and extends into the space between the external and internal sphincters.

name: deep post-anal space
definition: An anatomical space found at the front of the apex of the coccyx that is limited superiorly by the plate of the levator ani muscle and inferiorly by the anococcygeal raphe.

name: intersphincteric space
definition: An anatomical space located between the internal and external anal sphincters that continues inferiorly into the perianal space and superiorly into the rectum wall.

name: ischiorectal space
definition: An anatomical space that extends from the levator ani muscle to the perineum lateral to the anal canal.

name: skin of buttock
definition: A zone of skin that is part of the buttock.

name: supra levator space
definition: An anatomical space limited superiorly by the peritoneum, laterally by the pelvic wall, medially by the rectal wall, and inferiorly by the levator ani muscle.

name: perirenal space
definition: A retroperitoneal space that lies between the anterior and posterior renal fascia; it is a paired inverted cone shaped of tissue containing the kidney, the proximal portion of the collecting system, renal and perirenal vasculature, perirenal lymphatics, adrenal glands and variable amount of fat.

name: anterior pararenal space
definition: A space that is bounded anteriorly by the posterior parietal peritoneum, laterally by the lateroconal fascia and posteriorly by the anterior renal fascia; it contains the pancreatic gland, retroperitoneal segments of the duodenum, ascending and descending colon and the mesenteric root, as well as adipose tissue.

name: posterior pararenal space
definition: A space that is bound anteriorly by the posterior renal fascia and posteriorly by the transversalis fascia, and it only contains adipose tissue, lymphatics and blood vessels.

name: perirectal space
definition: An extraperitoneal space bounded laterally by the perirectal fascia, posteriorly by the posterior pelvic fascia, and anteriorly by the rectovesical fascia in the male and the rectovaginal fascia in the female.

name: perivesical space
definition: An extraperitoneal space circumscribed by the umbilicovesical fascia anterior and laterally, and rectovaginal (in females) or rectovesical (in males) septum posteriorly, it encounters the urachus, obliterated umbilical vessels, urinary bladder and the lower uterine segment or seminal vesicles.

name: prevesical space
definition: An extraperitoneal space anterior and lateral to the umbilicovesical fascia, and posterior to the trasversalis fascia. Prevesical space laterally communicates with the properitoneal space of the abdominal wall and flanks; posteroinferiorly it surrounds the lateral walls of the urinary bladder, and anteroinferiorly it forms the retropubic space (the space of Retzius).

name: piriform sinus
definition: A recess on either side of the laryngeal orifice, which is bounded medially by the aryepiglottic fold, laterally by the thyroid cartilage and thyrohyoid membrane. The pyriform sinus is involved in speech.

name: neck of pancreas

name: cervical transformation zone epithelium
definition: The area of epithelium that lies between the native and unaffected columnar epithelium of the endocervical canal and the native squamous epithelium deriving from the vaginal and ectocervical squamous epithelium.

name: meningeal myeloid tissue

name: Oka organ

name: ovarian fluid

name: testicular sheath

name: menstrual fluid

name: pelvic wall

name: long bone cartilage element

name: subiliac lymph node

name: mucosa of rumen

name: paraspinal region

name: pericardial region

name: femoral head cartilage

name: dorsal iris

name: secretory coil of eccrine sweat gland

name: labial gland

name: visceral transversely striated muscle tissue
