name: visceral obliquely striated muscle tissue
definition: A striated visceral muscle tissue that has an oblique striation.

name: subsegmental bronchus
definition: Branch of conducting airway between a segmental bronchus and a preterminal bronchiole.

name: bronchial submucosal gland ciliated duct
definition: A ciliated duct part of a bronchial submucosal gland.

name: tracheal submucosal gland ciliated duct
definition: A ciliated duct part of a tracheal submucosal gland.

name: submucosal gland acinus
definition: A spherical or tubular structure in a submucosal gland that produces and secretes mucus and other substances into the ducts leading to the surface epithelium.

name: submucosal gland collecting duct
definition: A non-secretory tubular structure in the submucosal gland where secretions are collected before flowing towards the surface epithelium.

name: submucosal gland ciliated duct
definition: A ciliated tubular structure in a submucosal gland connecting the submucosal gland collecting duct with the surface epithelium.

name: posterior sector of right lobe of liver
definition: The posterior sector of the right lobe of the liver.
synonyms_exact: lateral sector of right lobe of liver|right hepatic posterior sector

name: anterior sector of right lobe of liver
definition: The anterior sector of the right lobe of the liver.
synonyms_exact: medial sector of right lobe of liver|right hepatic anterior sector

name: bronchopulmonary segment
definition: A discrete anatomical unit of the lung that is composed of a segmental bronchus and the lung tissue supplied by that bronchus. A bronchopulmonary segment exhibits a pyramidal shape, with its apex pointing towards the center of the lung and its base toward the pleural surface.

name: neuroendocrine system
definition: A regulatory system of the body that integrates the nervous system and the endocrine system. This system is formed by specialized neuroendocrine cells located mainly in the nervous system and neuroendocrine glands. However, they can also be found as either single cells or small clusters of cells dispersed throughout the surface epithelium of different tissues. The neuroendocrine system functions through the release of neurotransmitters and neurohormones, enabling communication between the endocrine and nervous systems to govern vitally important processes that include growth, reproduction, metabolism and energy homeostasis, electrolyte and water balance, and responses to stress.

name: placental basal plate
definition: A maternal facing structure of the placental disc, adjacent to the intervillous space. Major components of the placental basal plate include decidua basalis, fibrinoid, connective tissue, extravillous trophoblasts, and residues of degenerating villi and maternal vessels.

name: placental septum
definition: An extension of the basal plate that protrudes into the intervillous space, creating a system of grooves which delimit elevated areas, also known as cotyledons or maternal lobes.

name: chorionic plate blood vessel
definition: A blood vessel that is part of the chorionic plate.

name: pulmonary interlobular septum
definition: A septum that surrounds and gives shape to the secondary pulmonary lobules, it is composed of connective tissue within which run the pulmonary veins and lymphatic vessels.

name: placental villous stroma
definition: A stroma that is part of a chorionic villus (placental villus). A placental villous stroma supports the fetal capillaries and villous trophoblast.

name: pulmonary venule
definition: A venule that is part of a lung and drains oxygenated blood from pulmonary capillaries. A pulmonary venule merges into a pulmonary vein branch that runs in the pulmonary interlobular septa.

name: intervillous space
definition: An anatomical space that separates the basal plate and the chorionic plate. The intervillous space is filled with endometrial gland secretions during early stages of the pregnancy and later perfused with maternal blood, bathing the chorionic villous tree.

name: chorionic villous tree
definition: A tree-like structure formed by chorionic villi that sprouts from the chorionic plate in the placental disc. The arborous shape of the chorionic villous tree provides maximal contact area with maternal blood in the intervillous space.

name: chorionic stem villus
definition: A chorionic villus that provides structural support to the villous tree. A chorionic stem villus is characterized by a condensed fibrous stroma in which fetal arteries, veins, arterioles, and venules are embedded. It represents a distributing framework for fetal chorionic circulation, supplying the floating villi. It can exhibit a diameter ranging from approximately 3000 μm (trunci near the chorionic plate) to 80 μm (smallest ramuli chorii).

name: chorionic mesenchymal villus
definition: The first generation of a tertiary villus that is derived from a syncytial sprout by the invasion of the mesenchyme, in which blood vessels differentiate through vasculogenesis, and gradually transforms into a new immature intermediate villus. A chorionic mesenchymal villus has a thick trophoblastic covering, and cytotrophoblast cells are interposed between syncytium and the trophoblastic basal lamina over 50–100% of the surface. The stroma is characterized by loosely arranged collagen fibers that enmesh mesenchymal and some villous macrophages. The fetal capillaries are poorly developed.

name: chorionic immature intermediate villus
definition: A bulbous, immature chorionic villus that is formed of loose connective tissue with few fetal vessels. A chorionic immature intermediate villus develops from a chorionic mesenchymal villus, and is the forerunner of a chorionic stem villus.

name: chorionic terminal villus
definition: The most distal part of a chorionic villus. A chorionic terminal villus is a grape-like structure characterized by a high degree of capillarization and highly dilated sinusoids. A terminal villus has less stroma and a discontinuous cytotrophoblast layer, and contains 4–6 fetal capillaries per cross section. It exhibits a diameter ranging from 40 to about 80 μm.

name: chorionic mature intermediate villus
definition: A slender branch of a chorionic stem villus. A chorionic mature intermediate villus lacks fetal arterioles and venules in the stroma, which is composed of slender fetal capillaries embedded into a loose connective tissue that is rich in cells but poor in fibers. It exhibits a diameter ranging from 60 to about 100 μm.

name: chorionic floating villus
definition: A chorionic villus that is not attached to the placental basal plate and it is immersed in maternal blood.

name: chorionic anchoring villus
definition: A distal smaller chorionic stem villus that is connected to the maternal side of the placenta (in early gestational stages to the decidua, and later to the developing basal plate) via a cytotrophoblast cell column. A chorionic anchoring villus stabilizes the position of the villous tree in the maternal intervillous bloodstream.

name: jejunum lamina propria
definition: A lamina propria that is part of a jejunum.
synonyms_exact: jejunal lamina propria|lamina propria of jejunum

name: ileum lamina propria
definition: A lamina propria that is part of an ileum.
synonyms_exact: ileal lamina propria|lamina propria of ileum

name: kidney loop of Henle long descending thin limb outer medulla
definition: A section of the long descending thin limb of the loop of Henle that is part of the outer medulla of the kidney.
synonyms_exact: long descending limb of the loop of Henle in the outer medulla

name: kidney loop of Henle long descending thin limb inner medulla
definition: A section of the long descending thin limb of the loop of Henle that is part of the inner medulla of the kidney.
synonyms_exact: long descending limb of the loop of Henle in the inner medulla

name: placental disc
definition: A disc-shaped structure that is part of the placenta. A placental disc supports fetal development through the exchange of nutrients between maternal and fetal bloodstreams. The placental disc is structured to keep the blood streams separate, while maximizing surface area for the transport of nutrients between them, to maintain an immunological barrier.

name: chorionic villous mesenchyme
definition: A mesenchyme that is part of a chorionic villus.

name: chorionic stem villous blood vessel
definition: A blood vessel that is part of a chorionic stem villus.

name: chorionic terminal villous capillary
definition: A capillary that is part of a chorionic terminal villus. This capillary is generally narrow, but displays sinusoidal dilations along its length, often at the points of acute bends. These dilations bring the capillary endothelium into close contact with the overlying syncytiotrophoblast to form a vasculosyncytial membrane.

name: endometrial lymphatic vessel
definition: A lymphatic vessel that is part of an endometrium.

name: lateral wall of urinary bladder
definition: A wall of the urinary bladder that is situated on the sides or flanks.

name: left lateral wall of urinary bladder
definition: A lateral wall of the urinary bladder that is located on the left side.

name: right lateral wall of urinary bladder
definition: A lateral wall of the urinary bladder that is located on the right side.

name: anterior wall of urinary bladder
definition: The most anterior wall of the urinary bladder.

name: posterior wall of urinary bladder
definition: The most posterior wall of the urinary bladder.

name: apex of urinary bladder
definition: The anterior angle of the superior surface of the urinary bladder. The apex of urinary bladder is connected to the umbilicus by the urachus in embryos, and by the median umbilical ligament, a remnant of urachus, in adults.

name: dome of urinary bladder
definition: The anterosuperior surface of the urinary bladder, with boundaries at the apex and fundus of the urinary bladder.

name: trophoblast island
definition: An accumulation of extravillous trophoblast cells at the tip of a floating villus or occasionally attached to the chorionic plate embedded in fibrin.

name: segmental pulmonary vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the main pulmonary veins and drains oxygenated blood from a segment of the lung.

name: subsegmental pulmonary vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the segmental pulmonary veins and drains oxygenated blood from a subsegment of the lung.

name: esophageal vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the azygos vein and drains blood from the esophagus.

name: supreme intercostal vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the superior intercostal vein and drains the first intercostal space.

name: atrioventricular nodal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the right coronary artery and supplies the atrioventricular node.
synonyms_exact: atrioventricular node branch of right coronary artery

name: lateral sacral vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the internal iliac vein and drains the anterior surface of the sacrum.

name: middle hemorrhoidal vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the internal iliac vein.

name: uterine vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the internal iliac vein and drains the uterus.

name: deep cervical vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of a vertebral vein and drains the suboccipital region, adjacent vertebral column, and deep muscles of the neck.

name: subsegmental pulmonary artery
definition: An artery that is a branch of the segmental pulmonary artery and supplies deoxyge blood to a smaller subsegment of the lung.

name: intra-acinar venule
definition: A venule that receives drainage from the capillary beds after blood has perfused the pulmonary alveoli, and is tributary of the pulmonary venules.

name: thyrocervical trunk
definition: An artery that branches from the subclavian artery and supplies the thyroid gland, neck, and upper back regions.

name: septal perforating artery
definition: An artery that branches from the left anterior descending artery and supplies the interventricular septum of the heart.

name: posterolateral artery
definition: An artery that branches from the right coronary artery or the circumflex artery and supplies the posterior and lateral walls of the left ventricle.

name: lateral femoral circumflex vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the femoral vein and drains blood from the front and middle areas of the thigh.
synonyms_exact: set of lateral circumflex femoral veins

name: basivertebral vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the anterior internal vertebral venous plexus and drains blood from the vertebral bodies.

name: bronchial venule
definition: A venule that is tributary of the bronchial veins and drains blood from the bronchi and bronchioles of the lungs.

name: mental vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the facial vein and drains blood from the chin and lower lip.

name: deep lingual vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the lingual vein and drains blood from the tongue.

name: dorsal lingual vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the lingual vein and drains blood from the dorsum of the tongue, and the sides of the tongue.

name: sublingual vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the lingual vein and drains blood from the ventral (inferior) surface of the tongue and the sublingual glands.

name: glandular venous plexus
definition: A venous plexus tha connects the middle and superior thyroid veins.

name: circumflex humeral vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the axillary vein and drains blood from the region around the neck of the humerus.

name: thoracoacromial vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the axillary vein and drains blood from the thoracoacromial region, including the pectoral, shoulder, and clavicular regions.

name: transverse cervical vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the external jugular vein and drains blood from the superficial muscles of the back, mainly the trapezius muscle.

name: suboccipital venous plexus
definition: A venous plexus that is tributary of the deep cervical veins and drains blood from the suboccipital region.

name: pulmonary arteriole
definition: An arteriole that branches from the pulmonary arteries and supplies deoxygenated blood to the pulmonary capillaries and alveolar capillaries of the lungs.

name: ascending pharyngeal artery
definition: An artery of the neck that branches from the external carotid artery and supplies the pharynx.

name: dural artery
definition: An artery that branches from the internal carotid artery and supplies the anterior clinoid process of the dura mater.

name: pericardial artery
definition: An artery that branches from the descending thoracic aorta and supplies the dorsal portion of the pericardium.

name: percardiacophrenic artery
definition: An artery that branches from the internal thoracic artery and supplies the pericardium and the diaphragm.

name: superficial iliac circumflex vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the great saphenous vein and drains blood from the inguinal region and the anterior abdominal wall.

name: fibular vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the posterior tibial vein and drains blood from the lateral compartment of the leg.

name: prostatic venule
definition: A venule that is tributary of the prostatic venous plexus and drains blood from the prostate gland.

name: hepatic portal venule
definition: A venule that branches from the hepatic portal vein to transport nutrient-rich blood from the gastrointestinal tract and spleen to supply the liver. The hepatic portal venule is tributary of the hepatic sinusoids.

name: incisor artery
definition: An artery that branches from the inferior alveolar artery and supplies the roots and pulp of the teeth of the lower jaw. It forms anastomoses with its contralateral partner.

name: external nasal vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the angular vein and drains blood from the superficial tissues and skin of the dorsum (bridge) and ala (wings) of the nose.

name: supratrochlear vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the angular vein and drains blood from the muscles and skin of the forehead.

name: transverse nasal root vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the angular veins and drains blood from the bridge of the nose.

name: hypophyseal vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the cavernous sinus and drains blood from the pituitary gland.

name: inferior anastomotic vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the transverse sinus and drains blood from the adjacent cortical regions of the temporal lobe. The inferior anastomotic vein forms an anastomosis (connection) between the superficial middle cerebral vein anteriorly and the transverse sinus posteriorly.

name: radial vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the brachial vein and drains blood from the lateral structures of the forearm, carpal and metacarpal bones, joints of the hand, and lateral forearm muscles.

name: ulnar vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the brachial vein and drains blood from the hand and medial and posterior aspect of forearm.

name: intra-acinar arteriole
definition: An arteriole that branches from the pulmonary arteriole and supplies deoxygenated blood to the pulmonary capillaries in the alveoli of the lungs.

name: ascending palatine artery
definition: An artery that branches from the facial artery, and branches to supply the soft palate and the palatine tonsil.

name: submental artery
definition: An artery that branches from the facial artery that runs forward under the mouth, then turns upward upon reaching the chin.

name: deep lingual artery
definition: An artery that branches from the lingual artery and supplies blood to the tongue itself, particularly the body and tip of the tongue. The deep lingual artery travels superiorly in a tortuous course along the under (ventral) surface of the tongue, below the longitudinalis inferior, and above the mucous membrane.

name: dorsal lingual artery
definition: An artery that branches from the lingual artery and supplies the soft palate, tonsils, epiglottis, palatoglossal arch, and adjacent mucous membrane. The dorsal lingual artery runs along the upper border of the hyoid bone and anastomises with its fellow of the opposite side.

name: accessory meningeal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the maxillary artery and supplies the meninges. The accessory meningeal artery ascends through the foramen ovale to enter the cranial cavity and supply the dura mater of the floor of the middle cranial fossa and of the trigeminal cave, and to the trigeminal ganglion.

name: artery of pterygoid canal
definition: An artery that branches from the maxillary artery and supplies blood to structures in the auditory tube, tympanic cavity, and upper pharynx. The artery of the pterygoid canal courses through the pterygoid canal, a small bony canal located in the sphenoid bone of the skull.

name: descending palatine artery
definition: An artery that branches from the maxillary artery and supplies the hard and soft palate.

name: left anterior descending artery
definition: An artery that branches from the left coronary artery and supplies the anterior wall of the left ventricle, the interventricular septum, and the apex of the heart.
synonyms_exact: anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery

name: anterior internal vertebral venous plexus
definition: A venous plexus that is tributary of the basivertebral veins and internal vertebral veins, draining blood from the vertebrae and spinal cord. The anterior internal vertebral venous plexus is located within the vertebral canal.

name: intervertebral vein
definition: A vein that drains blood from the vertebral column and intervertebral discs. In the neck, it is tributary of into the vertebral veins. In the thorax, it is tributary of the posterior intercostal veins. In the lumbar and sacral regions, it is tributary of the lumbar and lateral sacral veins

name: lumbar vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the inferior vena cava and drains blood from the posterior abdominal wall and lumbar region.

name: anterior humeral circumflex artery
definition: An artery that branches from the axilliary artery and supplies the deltoid, biceps brachii, and coracobrachialis muscles, the glenohumeral joint, the proximal humeral head, and the skin overlying the anterior aspect of the proximal humerus. This artery courses laterally across the anterior surface of the humerus and anastomoses with the posterior humeral circumflex artery.

name: posterior humeral circumflex artery
definition: An artery that branches from the axilliary artery and supplies the deltoid, teres major, teres minor, and long and lateral heads of the triceps brachii muscles, glenohumeral joint, and the cutaneous supply to the area posterolateral to the proximal humerus. This artery courses posteriorly with the axillary nerve, through the quadrangular space, to the posterior aspect of the humerus and anastomoses with the anterior humeral circumflex artery.

name: proximal ureter
definition: A segment of the ureter that extends from the renal pelvis to the common iliac artery bifurcation (to form the internal and external iliac arteries).

name: distal ureter
definition: A segment of the ureter that extends from the common iliac artery bifurcation to the bladder. From there, the ureter curves back and follows the lateral pelvic wall inferiorly to connect with the posterolateral bladder wall.

name: intramural ureter
definition: The terminal segment of the ureter that is continuous with the distal ureter, lies where the ureter enters the bladder and extends within the bladder wall. The intramural ureter is aperistaltic, serving as a reflux-preventing mechanism, preventing the backflow of urine from the bladder into the ureters.

name: right distal ureter
definition: A distal ureter that is part of the right ureter.

name: left distal ureter
definition: A distal ureter that is part of the left ureter.

name: right proximal ureter
definition: A proximal ureter that is part of the right ureter.

name: left proximal ureter
definition: A proximal ureter that is part of the left ureter.

name: right intramural ureter
definition: An intramural ureter that is part of the right ureter.

name: left intramural ureter
definition: An intramural ureter that is part of the left ureter.

name: antimesosalpinx
definition: A posterior free border of a mesosalpinx.
synonyms_exact: anti-mesosalpinx|posterior free border of mesosalpinx|posterior free edge of mesosalpinx

name: aorta-gonad-mesonephros
definition: A transient organ in the developing embryo composed of the dorsal aorta, developing gonads, and embryonic kidney. This structure is located in the embryonic mesoderm and serves as the primary site for the generation of definitive hematopoietic stem cells.

name: follicle associated epithelium
definition: A specialized epithelial layer overlying the luminal surface of lymphoid follicles in gut-associated lymphoid tissue. It is found in Peyer's patches of the small intestine and appendix in humans and in the intestine and caecal patches in mice. This layer contains specialised M cells and has fewer goblet cells compared to surrounding tissue. This layer plays a crucial role in mucosal immune surveillance.

name: stratum spinosum of esophageal epithelium
definition: The second deepest layer of the stratified squamous epithelium lining the esophagus, positioned directly above the stratum basale. It consists of multiple layers of keratinocytes connected by strong intercellular junctions called desmosomes, giving the cells a characteristic \

name: lumen of pulmonary alveolus
definition: An anatomical cavity that is part of the alveolus of the lung
synonyms_exact: cavity of pulmonary alveolus|pulmonary alveolar cavity

name: sensory corpuscle
definition: A mechanosensory complex in the terminal end of some nerves that forms a corpuscle. It consists of one or more neuronal terminations and associated non-neuronal cells.
